14.9.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
kedāramiti vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām .. 1 ..
14.9.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
केदारमिति विख्यातं सर्वपापहरं नृणाम् .. 1 ..
14.9.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the sacred ford renowned throughout the three worlds, / celebrated as Kedāra, which takes away all sins of mortals,

14.9.s:
yatra mandākinī puṇyā sarasvatyā samāgatā ..
tatra snāto naro rājanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ .. 2 ..
14.9.d:
यत्र मन्दाकिनी पुण्या सरस्वत्या समागता ..
तत्र स्नातो नरो राजन्मुच्यते सर्वकिल्बिषैः .. 2 ..
14.9.m: where the holy Mandākinī joins with the Sarasvatī. / A man who bathes there, O king, is freed from all sins.

14.9.s:
śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttamitihāsa purātanam ..
ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītamarbude parvatottame .. 3 ..
14.9.d:
शृणु राजन्यथावृत्तमितिहास पुरातनम् ..
ऋषिभिर्बहुधा गीतमर्बुदे पर्वतोत्तमे .. 3 ..
14.9.m: Hear, O king, an ancient narrative as it occurred, / sung in many ways by the seers on the excellent mountain Arbuda.

14.9.s:
ajapālo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ ..
saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ sa pāti nātra saṃśayaḥ .. 4 ..
14.9.d:
अजपालो नृपश्रेष्ठः सूर्यवंशसमुद्भवः ..
सप्तद्वीपवतीं पृथ्वीं स पाति नात्र संशयः .. 4 ..
14.9.m: Ajapāla was the best of kings, born in the solar dynasty; / he protected the earth with its seven continents—there is no doubt about this.

14.9.s:
na hastino na pādātā na cāśvāstasya bhūpateḥ ..
na rathāśca mahārāja na kośāśca tathāvidhāḥ .. 5 ..
14.9.d:
न हस्तिनो न पादाता न चाश्वास्तस्य भूपतेः ..
न रथाश्च महाराज न कोशाश्च तथाविधाः .. 5 ..
14.9.m: There were no elephants, no foot-soldiers, and no horses for that lord of the earth; / and there were no chariots, O great king, nor treasuries of such a kind.

14.9.s:
na gṛhṇāti karaṃ rājanprajābhyothādhikaṃ nṛpa ..
rājyaṃ sa īdṛśaṃ cakre sarvalokahite rataḥ ..6..
14.9.d:
न गृह्णाति करं राजन्प्रजाभ्योथाधिकं नृप ..
राज्यं स ईदृशं चक्रे सर्वलोकहिते रतः ..6..
14.9.m: He took no tax from his subjects beyond [what was just], O king; / he conducted such a rule, intent upon the welfare of all people.

14.9.s:
jātāparādho bhūpṛṣṭhe jāyate cetkathaṃcana ..
taṃ gatvā nigrahaṃ tasya cakruḥ śastrāṇi tatkṣaṇāt .. 7 ..
14.9.d:
जातापराधो भूपृष्ठे जायते चेत्कथंचन ..
तं गत्वा निग्रहं तस्य चक्रुः शस्त्राणि तत्क्षणात् .. 7 ..
14.9.m: If any transgressor ever arose on the face of the earth, / the weapons went of their own accord and instantly subdued him.

14.9.s:
evamasya narendrasya varttamānasya bhūtale ..
sukhena ramate loko rājye nihatakaṃṭake .. 8 ..
14.9.d:
एवमस्य नरेन्द्रस्य वर्त्तमानस्य भूतले ..
सुखेन रमते लोको राज्ये निहतकंटके .. 8 ..
14.9.m: While this ruler of men was thus abiding on the earth's surface, / people lived in happiness, the thorns [of danger] having been destroyed in his kingdom.

14.9.s:
kāmaṃ varṣati parjanyaḥ sasyāni rasavaṃti ca ..
gāvaḥ prabhūtadugdhāśca vidyamāne narādhipe .. 9 ..
14.9.d:
कामं वर्षति पर्जन्यः सस्यानि रसवंति च ..
गावः प्रभूतदुग्धाश्च विद्यमाने नराधिपे .. 9 ..
14.9.m: The rain cloud rained at will, crops were full of sap, / and cows yielded abundant milk while that lord of men was present.

14.9.s:
kenacittvatha kālena vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ ..
tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tasya gehamupāgataḥ .. 7.3.9.10 ..
14.9.d:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन वसिष्ठो भगवान्मुनिः ..
तीर्थयात्राप्रसंगेन तस्य गेहमुपागतः .. 7.3.9.10 ..
14.9.m: Then, after some time, the venerable sage Vasiṣṭha / came to his house on the occasion of a pilgrimage to sacred fords.

14.9.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayāmāsa śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā ..
pratyutthānābhivādābhyāmarghyapādyādibhistathā .. 11 ..
14.9.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा पूजयामास शास्त्रदृष्टेन वर्त्मना ..
प्रत्युत्थानाभिवादाभ्यामर्घ्यपाद्यादिभिस्तथा .. 11 ..
14.9.m: Seeing him, he worshipped him according to the way prescribed in the scriptures, / by rising up to meet him, greeting him reverently, and offering water for the arghya and water for the feet.

14.9.s:
evaṃ saṃpūjitastena bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa ..
sukhopaviṣṭo viśrāṃto vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ ..
rājarṣīṇāṃ kathāścakre devarṣīṇāṃ tathaiva ca .. . .. 12 ..
14.9.d:
एवं संपूजितस्तेन भक्त्या परमया नृप ..
सुखोपविष्टो विश्रांतो वसिष्ठो मुनिसत्तमः ..
राजर्षीणां कथाश्चक्रे देवर्षीणां तथैव च .. . .. 12 ..
14.9.m: Thus worshipped by him with supreme devotion, O king, / seated comfortably and rested, Vasiṣṭha, the best of sages, / related stories of royal seers and likewise of divine seers.

14.9.s:
tataḥ kathāvasāne tu kasmiṃścinnṛpasattama ..
papraccha vinayopetastaṃ muniṃ śaṃsitavratam .. 13 ..
14.9.d:
ततः कथावसाने तु कस्मिंश्चिन्नृपसत्तम ..
पप्रच्छ विनयोपेतस्तं मुनिं शंसितव्रतम् .. 13 ..
14.9.m: Then, at the conclusion of a story, O best of kings, / endowed with humility, he questioned that sage of celebrated vows.

14.9.s:
.. ajapāla uvāca .. ..
atītānāgataṃ vipra varttamānaṃ tathaiva ca ..
tvaṃ vetsi sakalaṃ brahmaṃstapaścaryāprabhāvataḥ .. 14 ..
14.9.d:
.. अजपाल उवाच .. ..
अतीतानागतं विप्र वर्त्तमानं तथैव च ..
त्वं वेत्सि सकलं ब्रह्मंस्तपश्चर्याप्रभावतः .. 14 ..
14.9.m: Ajapāla said: / "O brahmin, the past, the future, and likewise the present— / you know it all, O holy one, by the power of the practice of austerity.

14.9.s:
kautukaṃ hṛdi me jātaṃ varttate munipuṃgava ..
prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ .. 15 ..
14.9.d:
कौतुकं हृदि मे जातं वर्त्तते मुनिपुंगव ..
प्रसादः क्रियतां मह्यं कथयस्व प्रसादतः .. 15 ..
14.9.m: Curiosity has arisen in my heart, O foremost of sages; / grant me your favor and tell me out of graciousness."

14.9.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca.. ..
brūhi pārthivaśārdūla yatte manasi varttate ..
kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham .. 16 ..
14.9.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच.. ..
ब्रूहि पार्थिवशार्दूल यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..
कथयिष्यामि तत्सर्वं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् .. 16 ..
14.9.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Speak, O tiger among kings, whatever is in your mind. / I will tell you everything, even if it is very difficult to obtain.

14.9.s:
.. rājovāca .. ..
kena karmavipākena mamaitadrājyamuttamam ..
niṣkaṇṭakaṃ sadā kṣemaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam .. 17 ..
14.9.d:
.. राजोवाच .. ..
केन कर्मविपाकेन ममैतद्राज्यमुत्तमम् ..
निष्कण्टकं सदा क्षेमं सर्वकामसमन्वितम् .. 17 ..
14.9.m:
The king said:
Through the ripening of what action is this excellent kingdom of mine / free from thorns, always secure, and endowed with all desires?

14.9.s:
na dīno na ca duḥkhārtto vyādhigrasto na ko'pi ca ..
vidyate mama rājye ca na daridro mahāmune .. 18 ..
14.9.d:
न दीनो न च दुःखार्त्तो व्याधिग्रस्तो न कोऽपि च ..
विद्यते मम राज्ये च न दरिद्रो महामुने .. 18 ..
14.9.m: No one is wretched, none stricken by grief, and none seized by disease; / neither is there any poor man in my kingdom, O great sage.

14.9.s:
nārīyaṃ mama sādhvī ca prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī ..
maccittā madgataprāṇā nityaṃ mama hite ratā ..
anayā ciṃtitaṃ brahmansarvaṃ vistarato vada .. 19 ..
14.9.d:
नारीयं मम साध्वी च प्राणेभ्योऽपि गरीयसी ..
मच्चित्ता मद्गतप्राणा नित्यं मम हिते रता ..
अनया चिंतितं ब्रह्मन्सर्वं विस्तरतो वद .. 19 ..
14.9.m: This virtuous woman, my wife, is dearer [to me] even than my life-breaths; / her mind is set on me, her life-breath devoted to me, always delighting in my welfare. / Tell me in detail, O brahmin, everything thought of by her.

14.9.s:
kiṃ dānasya prabhāvena vratayāgasya vā mune ..
tapaso vā muniśreṣṭha vratasya niyamasya ca .. 7.3.9.20 ..
14.9.d:
किं दानस्य प्रभावेन व्रतयागस्य वा मुने ..
तपसो वा मुनिश्रेष्ठ व्रतस्य नियमस्य च .. 7.3.9.20 ..
14.9.m: Is it through the power of gift, or of a vow or sacrifice, O sage, / or of austerity, O best of sages, or of a vow and restraint?

14.9.s:
janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me ..
kathayasva prasādena vistareṇa dvijottama .. 21 .. ..
14.9.d:
जन्मान्तरकृतं पुण्यं परं कौतूहलं हि मे ..
कथयस्व प्रसादेन विस्तरेण द्विजोत्तम .. 21 .. ..
14.9.m: The merit earned in another birth indeed arouses my supreme curiosity. / Tell [it] graciously in detail, O best of the twice-born!

14.9.s:
.. vasiṣṭha uvāca .. ..
śṛṇu sarvaṃ mahīpāla vistareṇa ca kathyate ..
na ca manyustvayā kāryo na ca vrīḍā mahāmate .. 22 ..
14.9.d:
.. वसिष्ठ उवाच .. ..
शृणु सर्वं महीपाल विस्तरेण च कथ्यते ..
न च मन्युस्त्वया कार्यो न च व्रीडा महामते .. 22 ..
14.9.m:
Vasiṣṭha said:
Listen to everything, O protector of the earth, as it is told in detail. / You must not feel anger nor shame, O noble-minded one.

14.9.s:
anyadehāṃtare rājañchūdrajātisamudbhavaḥ ..
śūdrajātiriyaṃ sādhvī tava patnī hyabhūtpurā .. 23 ..
14.9.d:
अन्यदेहांतरे राजञ्छूद्रजातिसमुद्भवः ..
शूद्रजातिरियं साध्वी तव पत्नी ह्यभूत्पुरा .. 23 ..
14.9.m: In another body, O king, you were born in the Śūdra caste; / and this virtuous woman, your wife, was formerly born in the Śūdra caste.

14.9.s:
kenacittvatha kālena durbhikṣe samupasthite ..
annakṣayānmahārāja sarva lokaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ .. 24 ..
14.9.d:
केनचित्त्वथ कालेन दुर्भिक्षे समुपस्थिते ..
अन्नक्षयान्महाराज सर्व लोकः क्षुधार्दितः .. 24 ..
14.9.m: Then, at a certain time, when a famine arose, / all people were afflicted by hunger through the loss of food, O great king.

14.9.s:
tatastvaṃ bhāryayā sārddhamanyadeśāṃtare gataḥ ..
samāruhya ca kṛcchreṇa kasmiṃścidgirinirjhare .. 25 ..
14.9.d:
ततस्त्वं भार्यया सार्द्धमन्यदेशांतरे गतः ..
समारुह्य च कृच्छ्रेण कस्मिंश्चिद्गिरिनिर्झरे .. 25 ..
14.9.m: Then you went together with your wife to another country; / and climbing with difficulty up to a certain mountain stream,

14.9.s:
tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ manohāri śubhaṃ paṃkajakānanam ..
tatra snātvā payaḥ pītvā pitṛdevāḥ pratarpitāḥ .. 26 ..
14.9.d:
त्वया दृष्टं मनोहारि शुभं पंकजकाननम् ..
तत्र स्नात्वा पयः पीत्वा पितृदेवाः प्रतर्पिताः .. 26 ..
14.9.m: a charming, auspicious lotus forest was seen by you. / Having bathed there and drunk the water, the ancestors and gods were propitiated.

14.9.s:
manasā ciṃtitaṃ hyetatpadmānyādāya karomyaham ..
vikrayaṃ yena cāhāro bhavenmama ca sarvathā .. 27 ..
14.9.d:
मनसा चिंतितं ह्येतत्पद्मान्यादाय करोम्यहम् ..
विक्रयं येन चाहारो भवेन्मम च सर्वथा .. 27 ..
14.9.m: Indeed, this was thought in your mind: "Taking the lotuses, / I shall make a sale, by which I may have food in every way."

14.9.s:
tataḥ padmāni bhūrīṇi gṛhītvā bhāryayā saha ..
gato yatra jano bhūri gataḥ pārthivasattama .. 28 ..
14.9.d:
ततः पद्मानि भूरीणि गृहीत्वा भार्यया सह ..
गतो यत्र जनो भूरि गतः पार्थिवसत्तम .. 28 ..
14.9.m: Then, taking many lotuses along with your wife, / you went, O best of kings, to where many people had gone.

14.9.s:
na ke'pi prati gṛhṇaṃti lokā durbhikṣapīḍitāḥ..
bhramitastvaṃ ca sarvatra śrāṃto vairāgyamāgataḥ .. 29 ..
14.9.d:
न केऽपि प्रति गृह्णंति लोका दुर्भिक्षपीडिताः..
भ्रमितस्त्वं च सर्वत्र श्रांतो वैराग्यमागतः .. 29 ..
14.9.m: Afflicted by the famine, none among the people took [them]. / You wandered everywhere and, being weary, fell into despondency.

14.9.s:
tato dināvasāne tu guhāmekāṃ samāśritaḥ ..
bhūmau padmāni nikṣipya kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ prasuptavān.. 7.3.9.30 ..
14.9.d:
ततो दिनावसाने तु गुहामेकां समाश्रितः ..
भूमौ पद्मानि निक्षिप्य क्षुधाविष्टः प्रसुप्तवान्.. 7.3.9.30 ..
14.9.m: Then, at the close of the day, you took shelter in a cave. / Having thrown the lotuses on the ground, overcome by hunger, you fell asleep.

14.9.s:
etasminneva kāle tu karṇayoste samāgataḥ ..
paṭhatāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ dhvanirvedapurāṇayoḥ .. 31 ..
14.9.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु कर्णयोस्ते समागतः ..
पठतां द्विजमुख्यानां ध्वनिर्वेदपुराणयोः .. 31 ..
14.9.m: At that very time, there came to your ears / the sound of the Vedas and Purāṇas being recited by foremost brahmins.

14.9.s:
taṃ śrutvā sahasotthāya jñātvā jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ ..
padmānyādāya tatraiva sabhāryaḥ śivamaṃdire .. 32 ..
14.9.d:
तं श्रुत्वा सहसोत्थाय ज्ञात्वा जागरणं ततः ..
पद्मान्यादाय तत्रैव सभार्यः शिवमंदिरे .. 32 ..
14.9.m: Hearing that and rising suddenly, realising there was a night vigil, / you took the lotuses and went right there to the temple of Śiva, along with your wife.

14.9.s:
tatra nāgavatī veśyā śivarātriparāyaṇā ..
kedāre parayā bhaktyā karoti niśi jāgaram .. 33 ..
14.9.d:
तत्र नागवती वेश्या शिवरात्रिपरायणा ..
केदारे परया भक्त्या करोति निशि जागरम् .. 33 ..
14.9.m: There a courtesan named Nāgavatī, devoted to Śivarātri, / was keeping a night vigil at Kedāra with supreme devotion.

14.9.s:
tasyāḥ pārśve sthitā dāsī tvayā pṛṣṭā nareśvara ..
devasya purato bāle kimarthaṃ rātrijāgaram .. 34 ..
14.9.d:
तस्याः पार्श्वे स्थिता दासी त्वया पृष्टा नरेश्वर ..
देवस्य पुरतो बाले किमर्थं रात्रिजागरम् .. 34 ..
14.9.m: A maidservant standing by her side was asked by you, O lord of men: / "O maiden, for what purpose is this night vigil in front of the god?"

14.9.s:
tayoktaṃ śivarātryāṃ vai veśyeyaṃ varavarṇinī ..
kurute nāgavatī nāma rātrau bhaktyā ca jāgaram .. 35 ..
14.9.d:
तयोक्तं शिवरात्र्यां वै वेश्येयं वरवर्णिनी ..
कुरुते नागवती नाम रात्रौ भक्त्या च जागरम् .. 35 ..
14.9.m: By her it was said: "Indeed, on Śivarātri this fair-complexioned courtesan, / Nāgavatī by name, keeps a vigil at night with devotion.

14.9.s:
yaḥ śraddhābhaktisaṃyuktaḥ kurute rātrijāgaram ..
pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam.. 36 ..
14.9.d:
यः श्रद्धाभक्तिसंयुक्तः कुरुते रात्रिजागरम् ..
पूजयित्वा महादेवं स याति परमं पदम्.. 36 ..
14.9.m: Whoever, endowed with faith and devotion, keeps a night vigil / after worshipping Mahādeva, attains the supreme abode.

14.9.s:
kṛtvopavāsaṃ padmairyyaḥ pūjayettryaṃbakaṃ naraḥ ..
sa yāti rudrasālokyaṃ sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ .. 37 ..
14.9.d:
कृत्वोपवासं पद्मैर्य्यः पूजयेत्त्र्यंबकं नरः ..
स याति रुद्रसालोक्यं सेव्यमानो ऽप्सरोगणैः .. 37 ..
14.9.m: A person who fasts and worships Tryambaka with lotuses / goes to the realm of Rudra, attended by hosts of apsarases.

14.9.s:
sakāmo labhate kāmāndevairapi sudurllabhān ..
sa tvaṃ padmāni me dehi kāṃcanaṃ ca palatrayam..
eteṣāṃ mūlyamādāya prāṇādhāraṃ samācara .. 38 ..
14.9.d:
सकामो लभते कामान्देवैरपि सुदुर्ल्लभान् ..
स त्वं पद्मानि मे देहि कांचनं च पलत्रयम्..
एतेषां मूल्यमादाय प्राणाधारं समाचर .. 38 ..
14.9.m: One with desires obtains desires very difficult even for the gods to obtain. / So you, give me the lotuses and, taking three palas of gold / as their price, maintain your life!"

14.9.s:
tatastvaṃ bhāryayā cokto gṛhyamāṇe ca kāṃcane ..
na grāhyaṃ mūlyameteṣāṃ tvayā nātha kathaṃcana .. 39 ..
14.9.d:
ततस्त्वं भार्यया चोक्तो गृह्यमाणे च कांचने ..
न ग्राह्यं मूल्यमेतेषां त्वया नाथ कथंचन .. 39 ..
14.9.m: Then you were addressed by your wife when the gold was about to be accepted: / "The price of these must not be accepted by you under any circumstances, O lord!

14.9.s:
upavāso balājjāto hyannābhāvādvayorapi ..
padmairebhirharaḥ pūjyo dvābhyāmevādya niścayam .. 7.3.9.40..
14.9.d:
उपवासो बलाज्जातो ह्यन्नाभावाद्वयोरपि ..
पद्मैरेभिर्हरः पूज्यो द्वाभ्यामेवाद्य निश्चयम् .. 7.3.9.40..
14.9.m: A fast has occurred by force for both of us due to the absence of food. / With these lotuses Hara must certainly be worshipped today by both of us!

14.9.s:
idaṃ tvayā'dya karttavyaṃ tyājyamasyāstu kāṃcanam..
bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā taiḥ padmaiḥ pūjitaḥ śivaḥ ..41..
14.9.d:
इदं त्वयाऽद्य कर्त्तव्यं त्याज्यमस्यास्तु कांचनम्..
भार्याया वचनं श्रुत्वा तैः पद्मैः पूजितः शिवः ..41..
14.9.m: This must be done by you today; her gold should be rejected!" / Hearing his wife's word, Śiva was worshipped with those lotuses.

14.9.s:
śraddhayā ca sabhāryeṇa jāgaraṃ ca śivāgrataḥ ..
kṛtaṃ tvayā mahārāja bhāryayā śivamaṃdire ..42..
14.9.d:
श्रद्धया च सभार्येण जागरं च शिवाग्रतः ..
कृतं त्वया महाराज भार्यया शिवमंदिरे ..42..
14.9.m: With faith, a vigil before Śiva / was kept by you, O great king, together with your wife in the temple of Śiva.

14.9.s:
purāṇaśravaṇaṃ jātaṃ tatra pārthivasattama ..
śivarātryāṃ mahārāja padmaistu pūjitaḥ śivaḥ ..43..
14.9.d:
पुराणश्रवणं जातं तत्र पार्थिवसत्तम ..
शिवरात्र्यां महाराज पद्मैस्तु पूजितः शिवः ..43..
14.9.m: Hearing of the Purāṇa took place there, O best of kings; / and on Śivarātri, O great king, Śiva was worshipped with lotuses.

14.9.s:
kedārasyāgrato bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā..
kṛtaṃ tvayā mahārāja ekāgreṇa ca cetasā..44..
tataḥprabhāte saṃjāte bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā ca pāraṇā ..
kṛtā tvayā mahārāja śivāgre saha bhāryayā ..44..
14.9.d:
केदारस्याग्रतो भक्त्या रात्रौ जागरणं तथा..
कृतं त्वया महाराज एकाग्रेण च चेतसा..44..
ततःप्रभाते संजाते भिक्षां कृत्वा च पारणा ..
कृता त्वया महाराज शिवाग्रे सह भार्यया ..44..
14.9.m:
Likewise, a vigil was kept at night before Kedāra / with devotion and a concentrated mind by you, O great king.
Then, when morning came, having begged alms, the breaking of the fast / was performed by you before Śiva, along with your wife, O great king.

14.9.s:
tataḥ kālāṃtareṇaiva kāladharmaṃ gato bhavān ..
bhāryeyaṃ ca tvayā sārdhaṃ saṃpraviṣṭā hutāśanam ..46..
14.9.d:
ततः कालांतरेणैव कालधर्मं गतो भवान् ..
भार्येयं च त्वया सार्धं संप्रविष्टा हुताशनम् ..46..
14.9.m: Then, in the course of time, you met your death; / and this wife of yours entered the fire along with you.

14.9.s:
tato jātā mahārāja daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā ..
vaidehe nagare rājā jātastvaṃ pārthivottama .. 47 ..
14.9.d:
ततो जाता महाराज दशार्णाधिपतेः सुता ..
वैदेहे नगरे राजा जातस्त्वं पार्थिवोत्तम .. 47 ..
14.9.m: Then, O great king, she was born as the daughter of the lord of Daśārṇa; / and you were born as the king in the city of Vaideha, O best of kings,

14.9.s:
ajapāla iti khyāto nāmnā ca dharaṇītale ..
sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tvaṃ ca vallabho nṛpasattama .. 48 ..
14.9.d:
अजपाल इति ख्यातो नाम्ना च धरणीतले ..
सर्वेषां प्राणिनां त्वं च वल्लभो नृपसत्तम .. 48 ..
14.9.m: known by the name Ajapāla on the surface of the earth; / and you are dear to all living beings, O best of kings.

14.9.s:
etasmātkāraṇājjātā bhāryeyaṃ prāṇasaṃmatā ..
bhūyo'pi tava saṃjātā yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ..49..
14.9.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाज्जाता भार्येयं प्राणसंमता ..
भूयोऽपि तव संजाता यन्मां त्वं परिपृच्छसि ..49..
14.9.m: For this reason, this wife, dear as life, was born / again as yours, about which you ask me.

14.9.s:
tasya devasya māhātmyātkedārasya mahīpateḥ ..
rājyaṃ te sukhadaṃ nṛṇāṃ tathā nihatakaṇṭakam .. 7.3.9.50 ..
14.9.d:
तस्य देवस्य माहात्म्यात्केदारस्य महीपतेः ..
राज्यं ते सुखदं नृणां तथा निहतकण्टकम् .. 7.3.9.50 ..
14.9.m: Through the māhātmya of that god Kedāra, O ruler of the earth, / your kingdom gives happiness to men and is free of thorns.

14.9.s:
prāptaṃ tvayā mahārāja kedārasya prasādataḥ ..
yena tvaṃ sainyahīno'pi pṛthivīṃ parirakṣasi .. 51 ..
14.9.d:
प्राप्तं त्वया महाराज केदारस्य प्रसादतः ..
येन त्वं सैन्यहीनोऽपि पृथिवीं परिरक्षसि .. 51 ..
14.9.m: It was obtained by you, O great king, through the grace of Kedāra, / by which you protect the earth even without an army.

14.9.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ ..
gamanāya matiṃ cakre kedāraṃ prati bhūmipaḥ .. 52 ..
14.9.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तस्य तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा स राजा विस्मयान्वितः ..
गमनाय मतिं चक्रे केदारं प्रति भूमिपः .. 52 ..
14.9.m:
Pulastya said:
Hearing that speech of his, that king, filled with wonder, / made up his mind to go to Kedāra, O ruler of the earth.

14.9.s:
sa gatvā parvate ramye pūjayitvā ca taṃ vibhum ..
śivarātriparaḥ samyagvarṣevarṣe babhūva ha .. 53 ..
14.9.d:
स गत्वा पर्वते रम्ये पूजयित्वा च तं विभुम् ..
शिवरात्रिपरः सम्यग्वर्षेवर्षे बभूव ह .. 53 ..
14.9.m: Going to that delightful mountain and worshipping that all-pervading lord, / he became fully devoted to Śivarātri year after year.

14.9.s:
putraṃ rājye ca saṃsthāpya tato'rbudamathāgamat ..
prāpto muktiṃ tato bhūyaḥ sabhāryastatprabhāvataḥ .. 54 ..
14.9.d:
पुत्रं राज्ये च संस्थाप्य ततोऽर्बुदमथागमत् ..
प्राप्तो मुक्तिं ततो भूयः सभार्यस्तत्प्रभावतः .. 54 ..
14.9.m: Having installed his son in the kingdom, he then went to Arbuda; / and through its power he, along with his wife, later attained liberation.

14.9.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kedārasya mahīpate ..
māhātmyaṃ śubhadaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarva pāpapraṇāśanam .. 55 ..
14.9.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं केदारस्य महीपते ..
माहात्म्यं शुभदं नृणां सर्व पापप्रणाशनम् .. 55 ..
14.9.m: All this māhātmya of Kedāra has been told to you, O lord of the earth, / granting auspiciousness to men and destroying all sins.

14.9.s:
māghaphālgunayormadhye kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī ..
śivarātririti khyātā bhūtale'sminmahāmate .. 56 ..
14.9.d:
माघफाल्गुनयोर्मध्ये कृष्णपक्षे चतुर्दशी ..
शिवरात्रिरिति ख्याता भूतलेऽस्मिन्महामते .. 56 ..
14.9.m: Between Māgha and Phālguna, on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight, / is that which is known as Śivarātri on this earth, O noble-minded one.

14.9.s:
tasyāṃ tu sarvathā rājanyātrāṃ tasya samācaret..
kedārasya mahārāja prakuryātpūjanaṃ nṛpa .. 57 ..
14.9.d:
तस्यां तु सर्वथा राजन्यात्रां तस्य समाचरेत्..
केदारस्य महाराज प्रकुर्यात्पूजनं नृप .. 57 ..
14.9.m: On that day, O king, one should certainly undertake a pilgrimage to him; / one should perform the worship of Kedāra, O great king, O ruler of men.

14.9.s:
māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra jāgaram ..
kṛtopavāso nṛpate śivalokaṃ sa gacchati .. 58 ..
14.9.d:
माघकृष्णचतुर्दश्यां यः कुर्यात्तत्र जागरम् ..
कृतोपवासो नृपते शिवलोकं स गच्छति .. 58 ..
14.9.m: Whoever keeps a vigil there on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha, / having observed a fast, O king, goes to the world of Śiva.

14.9.s:
snātvā gaṃgāsarasvatyoḥ saṃgame sarvakāmade ..
ye prapaśyanti kedāraṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim .. 59 ..
14.9.d:
स्नात्वा गंगासरस्वत्योः संगमे सर्वकामदे ..
ये प्रपश्यन्ति केदारं ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् .. 59 ..
14.9.m: Having bathed at the confluence of the Gaṅgā and Sarasvatī, which grants all desires, / those who behold Kedāra shall go to the supreme state.

14.9.s:
kuṇḍe kedārasaṃjñe yaḥ prapibedvimalaṃ jalam ..
saptapūrvānsapta parānpūrvajāṃstārayettu saḥ .. 7.3.9.60 ..
14.9.d:
कुण्डे केदारसंज्ञे यः प्रपिबेद्विमलं जलम् ..
सप्तपूर्वान्सप्त परान्पूर्वजांस्तारयेत्तु सः .. 7.3.9.60 ..
14.9.m: Whoever drinks the pure water in the pool named Kedāra / redeems seven preceding and seven succeeding ancestors.

14.9.s:
yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa ..
so'pi pāpairvimucyeta kedārasya prabhāvataḥ .. 61 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kedāramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 9 ..
14.9.d:
यश्चैतच्छृणुयान्नित्यं भक्त्या परमया नृप ..
सोऽपि पापैर्विमुच्येत केदारस्य प्रभावतः .. 61 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे केदारमाहात्म्यवर्णनं नाम नवमोऽध्यायः .. 9 ..
14.9.m:
And whoever hears this daily with supreme devotion, O king, / even he is freed from sins by the power of Kedāra.
Thus ends the ninth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Kedāra,' in the third section Arbuda, in the seventh section Prabhāsa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.10.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
kedāraṃ śrūyate brahmanparvate ca himācale ..
gaṃgā tasmādviniṣkrāntā praviṣṭā pūrvasāgaram .. 1 ..
14.10.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
केदारं श्रूयते ब्रह्मन्पर्वते च हिमाचले ..
गंगा तस्माद्विनिष्क्रान्ता प्रविष्टा पूर्वसागरम् .. 1 ..
14.10.m: Yayāti said: / O brahmin, Kedāra is heard to be on the Himālaya mountain. / From there the Gaṅgā issued forth and entered the eastern ocean.

14.10.s:
tathā sarasvatī devī cūtavṛkṣādvinirgatā ..
paścimaṃ sāgaraṃ prāptā gṛhītvā vaḍavānalam.. 2 ..
14.10.d:
तथा सरस्वती देवी चूतवृक्षाद्विनिर्गता ..
पश्चिमं सागरं प्राप्ता गृहीत्वा वडवानलम्.. 2 ..
14.10.m: Likewise, goddess Sarasvatī came forth from a mango tree, / and reached the western ocean, carrying the submarine fire.

14.10.s:
kathamatra samāyātaḥ kedāraścātra kautukam..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi vicitraṃ mama bhūsura .. 3 ..
14.10.d:
कथमत्र समायातः केदारश्चात्र कौतुकम्..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि विचित्रं मम भूसुर .. 3 ..
14.10.m: How did Kedāra arrive here? There is wonder in this. / Explain all this to me in full, O brahmin; it is wondrous to me.

14.10.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
satyametanmahārāja yanno'tra paripṛcchasi ..
śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yathā jātaṃ śrutaṃ tu vai .. 4 ..
14.10.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
सत्यमेतन्महाराज यन्नोऽत्र परिपृच्छसि ..
शृणुष्वावहितो भूत्वा यथा जातं श्रुतं तु वै .. 4 ..
14.10.m: Pulastya said: / This is true, O great king, what you ask us here. / Listen with attention to how it happened, just as it has been heard.

14.10.s:
gaṃgādyāni ca tīrthāni kedārādyā divaukasaḥ ..
mayā saha purā devāḥ śakrādyā nṛpasattamāḥ .. 5 ..
14.10.d:
गंगाद्यानि च तीर्थानि केदाराद्या दिवौकसः ..
मया सह पुरा देवाः शक्राद्या नृपसत्तमाः .. 5 ..
14.10.m: Formerly the gods, Śakra and others, along with me, O best of kings, / the sacred fords such as the Gaṅgā, and the gods such as Kedāra,

14.10.s:
brahmāṇaṃ prati rājendra gatāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ..
sarve tatra kathāścakrurdharmyā nānā pṛthakpṛthak .. 6 ..
14.10.d:
ब्रह्माणं प्रति राजेन्द्र गताः सर्वे महर्षयः..
सर्वे तत्र कथाश्चक्रुर्धर्म्या नाना पृथक्पृथक् .. 6 ..
14.10.m: went, O lord of kings, all the great seers, unto Brahmā. / There they all engaged in various discourses on dharma, each separately.

14.10.s:
samudāye ca devānāṃ sarvatīrthāni pārthiva ..
kṣetrāṇyupa sthitānyeva vanānyupavanāni ca .. 7 ..
14.10.d:
समुदाये च देवानां सर्वतीर्थानि पार्थिव ..
क्षेत्राण्युप स्थितान्येव वनान्युपवनानि च .. 7 ..
14.10.m: And in that assembly of the gods, O king, all the sacred fords, / the sacred fields, the forests, and the groves were present.

14.10.s:
tataḥ kathāprasaṃgena indraḥ prāha caturmukham ..
kautukena samāyuktaḥ papraccha nṛpasattama .. 8 .. ..
14.10.d:
ततः कथाप्रसंगेन इन्द्रः प्राह चतुर्मुखम् ..
कौतुकेन समायुक्तः पप्रच्छ नृपसत्तम .. 8 .. ..
14.10.m: Then, in the course of the conversation, Indra spoke to the four-faced one. / Filled with curiosity, O best of kings, he asked:

14.10.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
bhagavanpuṇyamāhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāṃpratam ..
pramāṇaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛtādīnāṃ pṛthagvidham .. 9 ..
14.10.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
भगवन्पुण्यमाहात्म्यं श्रोतुमिच्छामि सांप्रतम् ..
प्रमाणं चैव सर्वेषां कृतादीनां पृथग्विधम् .. 9 ..
14.10.m: Indra said: / O Lord, I wish to hear now the meritorious greatness / and the measure of each of all [the ages], beginning with Kṛta.

14.10.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
lakṣaṃ saptadaśa proktaṃ yugamānaṃ surādhipa ..
aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasraiḥ kṛtamucyate .. 7.3.10.10 ..
14.10.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
लक्षं सप्तदश प्रोक्तं युगमानं सुराधिप ..
अष्टाविंशतिभिः सार्द्धं सहस्रैः कृतमुच्यते .. 7.3.10.10 ..
14.10.m: Brahmā said: / Seventeen hundred thousand, O lord of the gods, / together with twenty-eight thousand, is declared to be the measure of the Kṛta age.

14.10.s:
lakṣadvādaśabhiḥ proktaṃ yugaṃ tretābhisaṃjñitam ..
ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaiścaiva sahasraiḥ parimāṇitam.. 11 ..
14.10.d:
लक्षद्वादशभिः प्रोक्तं युगं त्रेताभिसंज्ञितम् ..
षण्णवत्यधिकैश्चैव सहस्रैः परिमाणितम्.. 11 ..
14.10.m: The age named Tretā is declared to be twelve hundred thousand, / and measured with ninety-six thousand more.

14.10.s:
lakṣāṇyaṣṭau catuḥṣaṣṭisahasraiḥ parikīrtitam ..
tato vai dvāparaṃ nāma yugaṃ devaprakīrtitam .. 12 ..
14.10.d:
लक्षाण्यष्टौ चतुःषष्टिसहस्रैः परिकीर्तितम् ..
ततो वै द्वापरं नाम युगं देवप्रकीर्तितम् .. 12 ..
14.10.m: Eight hundred thousand with sixty-four thousand is proclaimed; / that, O god, is proclaimed as the age named Dvāpara.

14.10.s:
lakṣaiścaturbhirvikhyāto dvātriṃśadbhiḥ kalistathā..
sahasraiśca suraśreṣṭha yugamānamitīritam.. 13..
14.10.d:
लक्षैश्चतुर्भिर्विख्यातो द्वात्रिंशद्भिः कलिस्तथा..
सहस्रैश्च सुरश्रेष्ठ युगमानमितीरितम्.. 13..
14.10.m: And Kali is renowned as four hundred thousand / and thirty-two thousand, O best of gods. Thus is the measure of the ages declared.

14.10.s:
catuṣpadaḥ kṛte dharmaḥ śuklavarṇo janārdanaḥ..
na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhistasminbhavati vai kvacit .. 14 ..
14.10.d:
चतुष्पदः कृते धर्मः शुक्लवर्णो जनार्दनः..
न दुर्भिक्षं न च व्याधिस्तस्मिन्भवति वै क्वचित् .. 14 ..
14.10.m: In Kṛta, dharma has four legs, and Janārdana is white in color. / In that [age] there is never any famine, nor disease anywhere.

14.10.s:
kriyate ca tadā dharmo nākāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām ..
lāṃgalena vinā sasyaṃ bhūrikṣīrāśca dhenavaḥ .. 15 ..
14.10.d:
क्रियते च तदा धर्मो नाकाले मरणं नृणाम् ..
लांगलेन विना सस्यं भूरिक्षीराश्च धेनवः .. 15 ..
14.10.m: Dharma is practiced then, and there is no untimely death for men; / grain grows without the plow, and cows yield abundant milk.

14.10.s:
kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobho matsaraścābhyasūyatā ..
tasminyuge sahasrākṣa na bhavaṃti kadācana .. 16 ..
14.10.d:
कामः क्रोधो भयं लोभो मत्सरश्चाभ्यसूयता ..
तस्मिन्युगे सहस्राक्ष न भवंति कदाचन .. 16 ..
14.10.m: Lust, anger, fear, greed, envy, and malice, / O thousand-eyed one, never exist in that age.

14.10.s:
tatastretāyuge jātastripādo dharma eva ca ..
cirāyuṣo narāstasminraktavarṇo janārdanaḥ .. 17 ..
14.10.d:
ततस्त्रेतायुगे जातस्त्रिपादो धर्म एव च ..
चिरायुषो नरास्तस्मिन्रक्तवर्णो जनार्दनः .. 17 ..
14.10.m: Then, in the Tretā age, dharma came to have three legs; / men in it are long-lived, and Janārdana is red in color.

14.10.s:
tasminyajñāḥ pravarttaṃte prāṇināmiṣṭadāyinaḥ ..
na kāmādipravṛttiśca tasminsaṃjāyate nṛṇām.. 18 ..
14.10.d:
तस्मिन्यज्ञाः प्रवर्त्तंते प्राणिनामिष्टदायिनः ..
न कामादिप्रवृत्तिश्च तस्मिन्संजायते नृणाम्.. 18 ..
14.10.m: In it, sacrifices proceed, granting what is desired to living beings, / and no inclination toward lust or the like arises in men.

14.10.s:
tapasā brahmacaryeṇa snānairdānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ ..
tathā yajñairjapairhomaistatra vṛttirbhavennṛṇām .. 19 ..
14.10.d:
तपसा ब्रह्मचर्येण स्नानैर्दानैः पृथग्विधैः ..
तथा यज्ञैर्जपैर्होमैस्तत्र वृत्तिर्भवेन्नृणाम् .. 19 ..
14.10.m: Through austerity, celibacy, ritual ablutions, varied gifts, / and likewise through sacrifices, muttering of mantras, and oblations, men conduct their lives there.

14.10.s:
tatastu dvāparaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ yuga mucyate ..
dvipado dharmaḥ sañjātaḥ pītavarṇo janārddanaḥ .. 7.3.10.20 ..
14.10.d:
ततस्तु द्वापरं नाम तृतीयं युग मुच्यते ..
द्विपदो धर्मः सञ्जातः पीतवर्णो जनार्द्दनः .. 7.3.10.20 ..
14.10.m: Then the third age is called Dvāpara; / dharma has become two-legged, and Janārdana is yellow in color.

14.10.s:
phalākāṃkṣāpravṛttāni japayajñatapāṃsi ca ..
satyānṛtānvito loko dvāpare surasattama .. 21 ..
14.10.d:
फलाकांक्षाप्रवृत्तानि जपयज्ञतपांसि च ..
सत्यानृतान्वितो लोको द्वापरे सुरसत्तम .. 21 ..
14.10.m: Muttering of mantras, sacrifices, and austerities proceed with the desire for fruits; / the world is imbued with truth and falsehood in Dvāpara, O best of gods.

14.10.s:
tatrānyonyaṃ mahīpālā yuyudhurvasudhātale ..
supūtāśca divaṃ yāṃti yajñairiṣṭvā janārdanam .. 22 ..
14.10.d:
तत्रान्योन्यं महीपाला युयुधुर्वसुधातले ..
सुपूताश्च दिवं यांति यज्ञैरिष्ट्वा जनार्दनम् .. 22 ..
14.10.m: There kings fought with one another on the surface of the earth; / thoroughly purified, they went to heaven after worshipping Janārdana with sacrifices.

14.10.s:
tataḥ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ caturthaṃ tu prava rttate ..
ekapādo bhaveddharmaḥ saṃtrasto nityapūjane .. 23 ..
14.10.d:
ततः कलियुगं घोरं चतुर्थं तु प्रव र्त्तते ..
एकपादो भवेद्धर्मः संत्रस्तो नित्यपूजने .. 23 ..
14.10.m: Then the dreadful fourth age, Kali, sets in; / dharma becomes one-legged, terrified in daily worship.

14.10.s:
kṛṣṇavarṇo bhavedviṣṇuḥ pāpādhikyaṃ pravartate ..
māyā ca matsaraścaiva kāmaḥ krodhastathā bhayam .. 24 ..
14.10.d:
कृष्णवर्णो भवेद्विष्णुः पापाधिक्यं प्रवर्तते ..
माया च मत्सरश्चैव कामः क्रोधस्तथा भयम् .. 24 ..
14.10.m: Viṣṇu becomes black in color, and an abundance of sin prevails: / delusion and envy, and lust, anger, and fear.

14.10.s:
arthalubdhāstathā bhūpā lobhamohaśatānvitāḥ ..
alpāyuṣo narāstatra alpasasyā ca medinī .. 25 ..
14.10.d:
अर्थलुब्धास्तथा भूपा लोभमोहशतान्विताः ..
अल्पायुषो नरास्तत्र अल्पसस्या च मेदिनी .. 25 ..
14.10.m: Kings are greedy for wealth, filled with hundreds of forms of greed and delusion; / men there have short lives, and the earth has little grain.

14.10.s:
alpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ satyahīnā dvijātayaḥ ..
tatra māyāvino lokā jaihvyaupasthyaparāyaṇāḥ .. 26 ..
14.10.d:
अल्पक्षीरास्तथा गावः सत्यहीना द्विजातयः ..
तत्र मायाविनो लोका जैह्व्यौपस्थ्यपरायणाः .. 26 ..
14.10.m: Cows have little milk, and the twice-born are devoid of truth; / there people are deceitful, devoted to [the pleasures of] the tongue and genitals.

14.10.s:
satyahīnāstathā pāpā bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge ..
tatra ṣoḍaśame varṣe narāḥ palitakuntalāḥ .. 27 ..
14.10.d:
सत्यहीनास्तथा पापा भविष्यंति कलौ युगे ..
तत्र षोडशमे वर्षे नराः पलितकुन्तलाः .. 27 ..
14.10.m: In the Kali age they will be devoid of truth and sinful; / there, in their sixteenth year, men will have gray hair,

14.10.s:
nāryo dvādaśame varṣe bhaviṣyaṃti sugarbhitāḥ ..
bhaviṣyati kramādvarṇasaṃkaraśca surādhipa .. 28 ..
14.10.d:
नार्यो द्वादशमे वर्षे भविष्यंति सुगर्भिताः ..
भविष्यति क्रमाद्वर्णसंकरश्च सुराधिप .. 28 ..
14.10.m: and women in their twelfth year will bear pregnancies. / By degrees there will be confusion of the classes, O lord of the gods.

14.10.s:
ekākārā bhaviṣyaṃti sarvavarṇāśramāśca vai ..
nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti yajñāśca kuladharmaḥ sanātanaḥ .. 29 ..
14.10.d:
एकाकारा भविष्यंति सर्ववर्णाश्रमाश्च वै ..
नाशं यास्यंति यज्ञाश्च कुलधर्मः सनातनः .. 29 ..
14.10.m: All classes and stages of life will become uniform in conduct, / and sacrifices as well as the eternal duty of family lineages will perish.

14.10.s:
vyarthāni tatra tīrthāni mlecchaspṛṣṭāni sarvaśaḥ ..
bhaviṣyaṃti suraśreṣṭha prabhāvarahitāni ca .. 7.3.10.30 ..
14.10.d:
व्यर्थानि तत्र तीर्थानि म्लेच्छस्पृष्टानि सर्वशः ..
भविष्यंति सुरश्रेष्ठ प्रभावरहितानि च .. 7.3.10.30 ..
14.10.m: The sacred fords there, touched on all sides by foreigners, will become useless, / O best of the gods, and devoid of efficacy.

14.10.s:
etacchrutvā tato vākyaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ ..
tatra sthitāni tīrthāni brahmāṇamidamabruvan .. .. 31 ..
14.10.d:
एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो वाक्यं ब्रह्मणोऽव्यक्तजन्मनः ..
तत्र स्थितानि तीर्थानि ब्रह्माणमिदमब्रुवन् .. .. 31 ..
14.10.m: Having heard this speech of Brahmā, whose birth is unmanifest, / the sacred fords present there said this to Brahmā:

14.10.s:
.. tīrthānyūcuḥ .. ..
kathaṃ vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmaḥ saṃprāpte dāruṇe kalau ..
sthānaṃ no brūhi deveśa sthātavyaṃ ca sadaiva hi .. 32 ..
14.10.d:
.. तीर्थान्यूचुः .. ..
कथं वयं भविष्यामः संप्राप्ते दारुणे कलौ ..
स्थानं नो ब्रूहि देवेश स्थातव्यं च सदैव हि .. 32 ..
14.10.m: The sacred fords said: / How shall we fare when the dreadful Kali arrives? / Tell us of a place, O lord of gods, where we must always remain.

14.10.s:
.. brahmovāca .. ..
arbudaḥ parvataśreṣṭhaḥ kalistatra na vidyate ..
atastatra ca gaṃtavyaṃ tīrthairāyatanaiḥ saha .. 33 ..
14.10.d:
.. ब्रह्मोवाच .. ..
अर्बुदः पर्वतश्रेष्ठः कलिस्तत्र न विद्यते ..
अतस्तत्र च गंतव्यं तीर्थैरायतनैः सह .. 33 ..
14.10.m: Brahmā said: / Arbuda is the best of mountains; Kali is not present there. / Therefore, you must go there together with the sacred shrines.

14.10.s:
api kṛtvā mahatpāpamarbudaṃ prekṣate tu yaḥ ..
kalidoṣavinirmuktaḥ sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim ..34..
14.10.d:
अपि कृत्वा महत्पापमर्बुदं प्रेक्षते तु यः ..
कलिदोषविनिर्मुक्तः स यास्यति परां गतिम् ..34..
14.10.m: Even after committing great sin, he who gazes upon Arbuda, / freed from the evils of Kali, will go to the supreme state.

14.10.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā caturvaktro brahmalokaṃ gato nṛpa ..
tataḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni gatāni ca kalau yuge .. 35 ..
14.10.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा चतुर्वक्त्रो ब्रह्मलोकं गतो नृप ..
ततः सर्वाणि तीर्थानि गतानि च कलौ युगे .. 35 ..
14.10.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, the four-faced one went to Brahmā's world, O king; / then all the sacred fords departed in the Kali age.

14.10.s:
bhūmāvarbudaśailendre saṃsthitāni kalerbhayāt ..
gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva yamunā puṣkarāṇi ca .. 36 ..
14.10.d:
भूमावर्बुदशैलेन्द्रे संस्थितानि कलेर्भयात् ..
गंगा सरस्वती चैव यमुना पुष्कराणि च .. 36 ..
14.10.m: Out of fear of Kali they settled on earth, on Arbuda, the king of mountains: / the Gaṅgā, the Sarasvatī, the Yamunā, and the Puṣkaras,

14.10.s:
kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ ca brahmāvartaṃ tathaiva ca..
tisraḥkoṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca yāni tīrthāni bhūtale .. 37 ..
14.10.d:
कुरुक्षेत्रं प्रभासं च ब्रह्मावर्तं तथैव च..
तिस्रःकोट्योऽर्द्धकोटिश्च यानि तीर्थानि भूतले .. 37 ..
14.10.m: Kurukṣetra, Prabhāsa, and likewise Brahmāvarta, / and all the three and a half crores of sacred fords that exist on the face of the earth.

14.10.s:
teṣāṃ vāsaśca sañjātaḥ parvate'rbudasaṃjñike ..
evaṃ tatra samāpannā gaṃgā caiva sarasvatī .. 38 ..
14.10.d:
तेषां वासश्च सञ्जातः पर्वतेऽर्बुदसंज्ञिके ..
एवं तत्र समापन्ना गंगा चैव सरस्वती .. 38 ..
14.10.m: And their dwelling was established on the mountain named Arbuda; / thus both Gaṅgā and Sarasvatī arrived there. / 38

14.10.s:
tatra śāṃtā narāḥ samyakparaṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyuḥ ..
śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja svarge yāṃti ca pūrvajāḥ .. 39 ..
14.10.d:
तत्र शांता नराः सम्यक्परं निर्वाणमाप्नुयुः ..
श्राद्धं कृत्वा महाराज स्वर्गे यांति च पूर्वजाः .. 39 ..
14.10.m: There tranquil men properly attain supreme nirvāṇa; / having performed a śrāddha, O great king, their ancestors go to heaven. / 39

14.10.s:
śṛṇu tatrābhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahāmate ..
ṛṣirmaṃkaṇakonāma sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ .. 7.3.10.40 ..
14.10.d:
शृणु तत्राभवत्पूर्वं यदाश्चर्यं महामते ..
ऋषिर्मंकणकोनाम सरस्वत्यास्तटे स्थितः .. 7.3.10.40 ..
14.10.m: Hear what wonder occurred there of old, O highly intelligent one: / a seer named Maṅkaṇaka was residing on the bank of the Sarasvatī. / 7.3.10.40

14.10.s:
tapastepe sudharmātmā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ..
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kṣutamāsītkadācana .. 41 ..
14.10.d:
तपस्तेपे सुधर्मात्मा कामक्रोधविवर्जितः ..
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य क्षुतमासीत्कदाचन .. 41 ..
14.10.m: Endowed with great virtue, free from desire and anger, he performed tapas. / As he was continuing thus, he happened once to sneeze. / 41

14.10.s:
pittaṃ prapatitaṃ tatra tacca raktamayaṃ babhau ..
taddṛṣṭvā'tīva hṛṣṭaḥ sa maṃkaṇarṣirbabhūva ha .. 42 ..
14.10.d:
पित्तं प्रपतितं तत्र तच्च रक्तमयं बभौ ..
तद्दृष्ट्वाऽतीव हृष्टः स मंकणर्षिर्बभूव ह .. 42 ..
14.10.m: Bile fell out there, and it appeared full of blood. / Seeing that, the seer Maṅkaṇa became exceedingly delighted. / 42

14.10.s:
siddho'hamiti vijñāya tato nṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ ..
tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam .. 43 ..
14.10.d:
सिद्धोऽहमिति विज्ञाय ततो नृत्यं चकार सः ..
तस्यैवं वर्तमानस्य जगत्स्थावरजंगमम् .. 43 ..
14.10.m: Thinking, 'I have attained perfection,' he then danced. / As he was doing so, the world of the stationary and the moving / 43

14.10.s:
tatra saṃkṣobhamāpannaṃ sāgarā api cukṣubhuḥ ..
gṛhakṛtyāni saṃtyajya sarve vismayamā gatāḥ .. 44 ..
14.10.d:
तत्र संक्षोभमापन्नं सागरा अपि चुक्षुभुः ..
गृहकृत्यानि संत्यज्य सर्वे विस्मयमा गताः .. 44 ..
14.10.m: became agitated there, and even the oceans were churned; / abandoning their household duties, everyone fell into astonishment. / 44

14.10.s:
tasyaivaṃ nṛtyamānasya sarve lokā nṛpottama ..
nanṛtuḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha prabhāvāttasya sanmuneḥ .. 45 ..
14.10.d:
तस्यैवं नृत्यमानस्य सर्वे लोका नृपोत्तम ..
ननृतुः पार्थिवश्रेष्ठ प्रभावात्तस्य सन्मुनेः .. 45 ..
14.10.m: As he danced in this way, O best of kings, all the worlds / danced, O foremost of monarchs, through the power of that noble sage. / 45

14.10.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve gatvā kāmaniṣūdanam ..
yathā'yaṃ nṛtyate naiva tathā kuru maheśvara ..46..
14.10.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे गत्वा कामनिषूदनम् ..
यथाऽयं नृत्यते नैव तथा कुरु महेश्वर ..46..
14.10.m: Then all the hosts of gods approached the destroyer of Kāma: / 'O Maheśvara, act so that he does not dance.' / 46

14.10.s:
atha brāhmaṇarūpeṇa śaṃbhunokto dvijottamaḥ ..
tvayā brahmaṃstapastaptamadhunā nṛtyate katham .. .. 47 ..
14.10.d:
अथ ब्राह्मणरूपेण शंभुनोक्तो द्विजोत्तमः ..
त्वया ब्रह्मंस्तपस्तप्तमधुना नृत्यते कथम् .. .. 47 ..
14.10.m: Then Śambhu in the form of a brahmin said to that best of the twice-born: / 'O brahmin, you have performed tapas; why do you dance now?' / 47

14.10.s:
.. maṃkaṇa uvāca .. ..
kiṃ na paśyasi he brahmanraktaṃ pittaṃ ca me sthitam ..
saṃjātaṃ siddhimāpanno raktaṃ pittaṃ yato mama .. 48 ..
14.10.d:
.. मंकण उवाच .. ..
किं न पश्यसि हे ब्रह्मन्रक्तं पित्तं च मे स्थितम् ..
संजातं सिद्धिमापन्नो रक्तं पित्तं यतो मम .. 48 ..
14.10.m: Maṅkaṇa said: / 'Do you not see, O brahmin, that blood and bile have come forth from me? / It has happened! I have attained perfection, since blood and bile are mine!' / 48

14.10.s:
etasmātkāraṇāddharṣāddvija nṛtyaṃ karomyaham ..
evamuktastatastena devadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 49 ..
14.10.d:
एतस्मात्कारणाद्धर्षाद्द्विज नृत्यं करोम्यहम् ..
एवमुक्तस्ततस्तेन देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 49 ..
14.10.m: 'For this reason, O twice-born, I dance out of joy.' / When addressed thus by him, the god of gods, Maheśvara, / 49

14.10.s:
tarjanyā tāḍayāmāsa svāṃguṣṭhaṃ nṛpasattama ..
tatoṃguṣṭhādviniṣkrāṃtaṃ bhasma vai bisapāṃḍuram .. 7.3.10.50 ..
14.10.d:
तर्जन्या ताडयामास स्वांगुष्ठं नृपसत्तम ..
ततोंगुष्ठाद्विनिष्क्रांतं भस्म वै बिसपांडुरम् .. 7.3.10.50 ..
14.10.m: struck his own thumb with his forefinger, O best of kings; / then from his thumb emerged ash, pale white like a lotus stalk. / 7.3.10.50

14.10.s:
tato maṃkaṇakaṃ prāha paśya vipra karānmama ..
śubhraṃ bhasma viniṣkrāṃtaṃ paśya me dvija kautukam .. 51 .. ..
14.10.d:
ततो मंकणकं प्राह पश्य विप्र करान्मम ..
शुभ्रं भस्म विनिष्क्रांतं पश्य मे द्विज कौतुकम् .. 51 .. ..
14.10.m: Then he said to Maṅkaṇaka: 'Look, O vipra, from my hand / pure white ash has emerged; behold my marvel, O twice-born!' / 51

14.10.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
taddṛṣṭvā vismito vipro jñātvā taṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam ..
jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha ..52..
14.10.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा विस्मितो विप्रो ज्ञात्वा तं वृषभध्वजम् ..
जानुभ्यामवनिं गत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ..52..
14.10.m: Pulastya said: / Astonished at seeing that, and realizing that he was the bull-bannered lord, / the vipra dropped to the ground on his knees and spoke these words: / 52

14.10.s:
.. maṃkaṇa uvāca .. ..
nūnaṃ bhavānmahādevaḥ sākṣāddṛṣṭaḥ prasīda me ..
niścitaṃ tvaṃ mayā jñāta etanme hṛdi vartate .. 53 ..
14.10.d:
.. मंकण उवाच .. ..
नूनं भवान्महादेवः साक्षाद्दृष्टः प्रसीद मे ..
निश्चितं त्वं मया ज्ञात एतन्मे हृदि वर्तते .. 53 ..
14.10.m: Maṅkaṇa said: / 'Surely you are Mahādeva seen in person; be pleased with me! / I have truly recognized you; this is firmly in my heart. / 53

14.10.s:
nānyasyāyaṃ prabhāvaśca tvayā yo me pradarśitaḥ ..
māṃ samuddhara deveśa kṛpāṃ kṛtvā maheśvara .. 54 ..
14.10.d:
नान्यस्यायं प्रभावश्च त्वया यो मे प्रदर्शितः ..
मां समुद्धर देवेश कृपां कृत्वा महेश्वर .. 54 ..
14.10.m: This power which you have shown me belongs to no other; / deliver me, O lord of gods, showing mercy, O Maheśvara!' / 54

14.10.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
samyagjñāto'smi viprendra tvayā'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nṛtyādhikyaṃ yataḥ kṛtam .. 55 ..
14.10.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
सम्यग्ज्ञातोऽस्मि विप्रेन्द्र त्वयाऽहं नात्र संशयः ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते नृत्याधिक्यं यतः कृतम् .. 55 ..
14.10.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / 'I am properly recognized by you, O foremost among vipras; there is no doubt in this. / Choose a boon, may good befall you, since you performed an excess of dancing.' / 55

14.10.s:
.. maṃkaṇa uvāca .. ..
ye'tra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti sarasvatyāṃ samāhitāḥ ..
tvatprasādātphalaṃ teṣāṃ rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ .. 56 ..
14.10.d:
.. मंकण उवाच .. ..
येऽत्र स्नानं प्रकुर्वंति सरस्वत्यां समाहिताः ..
त्वत्प्रसादात्फलं तेषां राजसूयाश्वमेधयोः .. 56 ..
14.10.m: Maṅkaṇa said: / 'For those who take a ritual ablution here in the Sarasvatī with composed minds, / may the fruit of the Rājasūya and Aśvamedha sacrifices be theirs by your grace.' / 56

14.10.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti sarasvatyāṃ samāhitāḥ ..
te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 57 ..
14.10.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
येऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यंति सरस्वत्यां समाहिताः ..
ते यास्यंति परं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 57 ..
14.10.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / 'Those who will take a ritual ablution here in the Sarasvatī with composed minds / shall go to the supreme abode, free from old age and death. / 57

14.10.s:
atra gaṃgāsarasvatyoḥ saṃgame lokaviśrute ..
śrāddhaṃ kuryurdvijaśreṣṭha te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim .. 58 ..
14.10.d:
अत्र गंगासरस्वत्योः संगमे लोकविश्रुते ..
श्राद्धं कुर्युर्द्विजश्रेष्ठ ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् .. 58 ..
14.10.m: Here at the confluence of Gaṅgā and Sarasvatī, renowned in the world, / if they perform a śrāddha, O best of the twice-born, they shall attain the supreme state. / 58

14.10.s:
suvarṇaṃ ye'tra dāsyaṃti yathāśaktyā dvijottame ..
sarva pāpavinirmuktāste yāsyanti parāṃ gatim .. 59 ..
14.10.d:
सुवर्णं येऽत्र दास्यंति यथाशक्त्या द्विजोत्तमे ..
सर्व पापविनिर्मुक्तास्ते यास्यन्ति परां गतिम् .. 59 ..
14.10.m: Those who give gold here to an excellent twice-born according to their capacity, / freed from all sins, shall attain the supreme state.' / 59

14.10.s:
ityuktvāṃtardadhe rājandevadevo maheśvaraḥ .. 7.3.10.60 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe'rbudācale kaliyugapabhāvātsarvatīrthāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ .. 10 ..
14.10.d:
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे राजन्देवदेवो महेश्वरः .. 7.3.10.60 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डेऽर्बुदाचले कलियुगपभावात्सर्वतीर्थागमनवर्णनंनाम दशमोऽध्यायः .. 10 ..
14.10.m:
Having spoken thus, O king, the god of gods, Maheśvara, vanished. / 7.3.10.60
Thus ends the tenth chapter, titled 'Description of the Arrival of All Sacred Fords on Mount Arbuda through the Influence of the Kaliyuga,' in the third Arbuda Section of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the venerable Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses]. / 10

14.11.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha devaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyakparāṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt .. 1 ..
14.11.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ देवं कोटीश्वरं परम् ..
यं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सम्यक्परां सिद्धिमवाप्नुयात् .. 1 ..
14.11.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the supreme god Koṭīśvara, / seeing whom a human being would properly attain supreme perfection. / 1

14.11.s:
śṛṇu tatrābhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahīpate ..
dakṣiṇasyā munivarāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāpramāṇataḥ .. 2 ..
14.11.d:
शृणु तत्राभवत्पूर्वं यदाश्चर्यं महीपते ..
दक्षिणस्या मुनिवराः कोटिसंख्याप्रमाणतः .. 2 ..
14.11.m: Hear what wonder occurred there of old, O lord of the earth: / the foremost sages of the southern region, numbering one crore, / 2

14.11.s:
anyo'nyaṃ spardhayā sarve helayā'rbudamāgatāḥ ..
ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ prapaśyāmyacaleśvaram .. 3 ..
14.11.d:
अन्योऽन्यं स्पर्धया सर्वे हेलयाऽर्बुदमागताः ..
अहं पूर्वमहं पूर्वं प्रपश्याम्यचलेश्वरम् .. 3 ..
14.11.m: all came easily to Arbuda out of rivalry with one another, / saying, 'I shall see the Lord of the Mountain first! I first!' / 3

14.11.s:
āgamiṣyati yaḥ paścādbrāhmaṇaḥ śvā bhaviṣyati ..
pāpīyānbhaktirahitaḥ śraddhāhīno bhaviṣyati .. 4 ..
14.11.d:
आगमिष्यति यः पश्चाद्ब्राह्मणः श्वा भविष्यति ..
पापीयान्भक्तिरहितः श्रद्धाहीनो भविष्यति .. 4 ..
14.11.m: 'The brahmin who arrives later shall become a dog; / he shall become a sinner, devoid of devotion and lacking faith.' / 4

14.11.s:
ityevaṃ spardhamānāste helayā'rbudamāgatāḥ ..
tataḥ sarve yatātmānaḥ samyagvrataparāyaṇāḥ .. 5 ..
14.11.d:
इत्येवं स्पर्धमानास्ते हेलयाऽर्बुदमागताः ..
ततः सर्वे यतात्मानः सम्यग्व्रतपरायणाः .. 5 ..
14.11.m: Rivaling thus with one another, they came easily to Arbuda. / Then all those self-controlled ones, properly devoted to their vows, / 5

14.11.s:
śāṃtāstapasvinaḥ sarve vedavidyāviśāradāḥ ..
teṣāmīhitamājñāya samyakkāmaniṣūdanaḥ .. 6 ..
14.11.d:
शांतास्तपस्विनः सर्वे वेदविद्याविशारदाः ..
तेषामीहितमाज्ञाय सम्यक्कामनिषूदनः .. 6 ..
14.11.m: all tranquil ascetics skilled in the knowledge of the Vedas— / knowing their desire fully, the destroyer of Kāma, / 6

14.11.s:
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo bhaktibhāvānmaheśvaraḥ ..
koṭiṃ kṛtvā''tmaliṃgānāṃ tasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ .. 7 ..
14.11.d:
कृपया परयाविष्टो भक्तिभावान्महेश्वरः ..
कोटिं कृत्वा'ऽत्मलिंगानां तस्मिन्स्थाने व्यवस्थितः .. 7 ..
14.11.m: filled with supreme compassion because of their devotion, / became present in that place having made a crore of his own liṅgas. / 7

14.11.s:
ekasminneva kāle tu sarvairdṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ..
munibhiśca nṛpaśreṣṭha koṭisaṃkhyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak .. 8 ..
14.11.d:
एकस्मिन्नेव काले तु सर्वैर्दृष्टो महेश्वरः ..
मुनिभिश्च नृपश्रेष्ठ कोटिसंख्यैः पृथक्पृथक् .. 8 ..
14.11.m: At that very same moment Maheśvara was seen by all, / individually by the sages numbering one crore, O best of kings. / 8

14.11.s:
atha te munayaḥ sarve samaṃ dṛṣṭvā maheśvaram ..
vismayotphullanayanā sādhusādhviti cābruvan .. 9 ..
14.11.d:
अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे समं दृष्ट्वा महेश्वरम् ..
विस्मयोत्फुल्लनयना साधुसाध्विति चाब्रुवन् .. 9 ..
14.11.m: Then all those sages, having seen Maheśvara simultaneously, / their eyes wide with wonder, said, 'Excellent! Excellent!' / 9

14.11.s:
bhaktiyuktā dvijāḥ sarve'stuvaṃste vaidikaiḥ stavaiḥ ..
teṣāṃ tuṣṭastataḥ śaṃbhurvākyametaduvāca ha .. 7.3.11.10 .. ..
14.11.d:
भक्तियुक्ता द्विजाः सर्वेऽस्तुवंस्ते वैदिकैः स्तवैः ..
तेषां तुष्टस्ततः शंभुर्वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 7.3.11.10 .. ..
14.11.m: Endowed with devotion, all the twice-born praised him with Vedic hymns. / Then Śambhu, pleased with them, spoke these words: / 7.3.11.10

14.11.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
tuṣṭo'haṃ munayaḥ sarve śraddhayā parayā hi vaḥ ..
varaṃ vai vriyatāṃ śīghraṃ sarvaiścaiva pṛthakpṛthak ..11..
14.11.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
तुष्टोऽहं मुनयः सर्वे श्रद्धया परया हि वः ..
वरं वै व्रियतां शीघ्रं सर्वैश्चैव पृथक्पृथक् ..11..
14.11.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / 'I am pleased, O all you sages, by your supreme faith indeed; / choose a boon quickly, and each of you individually.' / 11

14.11.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdi varttitaḥ ..
yugapaddarśanāddeva jāyatāṃ phalamuttamam .. 12 ..
14.11.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एष एव वरोऽस्माकं सर्वेषां हृदि वर्त्तितः ..
युगपद्दर्शनाद्देव जायतां फलमुत्तमम् .. 12 ..
14.11.m: The seers said: / 'This very boon resides in the hearts of all of us: / from this simultaneous sight, O god, let the highest fruit arise.' / 12

14.11.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādviśeṣādbrāhmaṇasya ca ..
darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti teṣāṃ ca tīrthajaṃ phalam .. 13 ..
14.11.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्याद्विशेषाद्ब्राह्मणस्य च ..
दर्शनं ये करिष्यंति तेषां च तीर्थजं फलम् .. 13 ..
14.11.m: The venerable Mahādeva said: / 'Sight of me cannot be in vain, especially for a brahmin; / for those who have sight of me, there shall be the fruit born of the sacred ford.' / 13

14.11.s:
.. munaya ūcuḥ .. ..
avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyo varo'smākaṃ maheśvara ..
ekaṃ koṭimayaṃ liṃgaṃ kriyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja .. 14 ..
14.11.d:
.. मुनय ऊचुः .. ..
अवश्यं यदि दातव्यो वरोऽस्माकं महेश्वर ..
एकं कोटिमयं लिंगं क्रियतां वृषभध्वज .. 14 ..
14.11.m: The sages said: / 'If a boon must certainly be granted to us, O Maheśvara, / let one single liṅga consisting of a crore be made, O bull-bannered lord, / 14

14.11.s:
yasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ nṛṇāṃ jāyate koṭiliṃgajam ..
evameṣa varo'smākaṃ dīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja .. .. 15 ..
14.11.d:
यस्मिन्दृष्टे फलं नृणां जायते कोटिलिंगजम् ..
एवमेष वरोऽस्माकं दीयतां वृषभध्वज .. .. 15 ..
14.11.m: upon seeing which the fruit born of a crore of liṅgas arises for men; / grant us this boon, O bull-bannered lord!' / 15

14.11.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ saprārthamānānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..
nirbhidya parvataśreṣṭhaṃ sahasā liṃgamudgatam .. 16 ..
14.11.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवं सप्रार्थमानानां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ..
निर्भिद्य पर्वतश्रेष्ठं सहसा लिंगमुद्गतम् .. 16 ..
14.11.m: Pulastya said: / As the sages of purified souls were praying thus, / having burst through the excellent mountain, a liṅga suddenly arose. / 16

14.11.s:
etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
kṛpayā parayā sarvāṃstānṛṣīnvasudhādhipa .. 17 ..
14.11.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
कृपया परया सर्वांस्तानृषीन्वसुधाधिप .. 17 ..
14.11.m: At that very moment, an unembodied voice spoke / with supreme compassion to all those seers, O lord of the earth:

14.11.s:
.. vāguvāca .. ..
koṭīśvarākhyaṃ me liṃgaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati ..
māghakṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati .. 18 ..
14.11.d:
.. वागुवाच .. ..
कोटीश्वराख्यं मे लिंगं लोके ख्यातिं गमिष्यति ..
माघकृष्णचतुर्द्दश्यां यश्चैनं पूजयिष्यति .. 18 ..
14.11.m: The voice said: / "My liṅga shall become known in the world by the name Koṭīśvara; / and whoever worships it on the fourteenth day of the dark fortnight of Māgha,

14.11.s:
sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya phalaṃ viprā bhaviṣyati ..
dākṣiṇātyo naro yastu śrāddhamatra kariṣyati .. 19 ..
14.11.d:
सर्वं कोटिगुणं तस्य फलं विप्रा भविष्यति ..
दाक्षिणात्यो नरो यस्तु श्राद्धमत्र करिष्यति .. 19 ..
14.11.m: all the fruit for him, O brahmins, shall be ten-million-fold. / Moreover, whatever man from the south performs a śrāddha here,

14.11.s:
phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya gayāśrāddhasamaṃ bhavet ..
tasmādviśeṣataḥ pūjyaṃ mama liṃgaṃ ca mānavaiḥ .. 7.3.11.20 ..
14.11.d:
फलं कोटिगुणं तस्य गयाश्राद्धसमं भवेत् ..
तस्माद्विशेषतः पूज्यं मम लिंगं च मानवैः .. 7.3.11.20 ..
14.11.m: his fruit shall be ten-million-fold, equal to a śrāddha at Gayā. / Therefore, my liṅga should be especially worshipped by human beings."

14.11.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā tu sā vāṇī virarāma mahīpate ..
tataste munayaḥ sarve gaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ .. 21 ..
14.11.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा वाणी विरराम महीपते ..
ततस्ते मुनयः सर्वे गंधधूपानुलेपनैः .. 21 ..
14.11.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, that voice fell silent, O lord of the earth. / Thereupon, all those sages, with perfumes, incense, and unguents,

14.11.s:
talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa ..
pūjayitvā gatāḥ siddhiṃ sarve liṃgaprasādataḥ .. 22 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhātakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 11 ..
14.11.d:
तल्लिंगं पूजयामासुः श्रद्धया परया नृप ..
पूजयित्वा गताः सिद्धिं सर्वे लिंगप्रसादतः .. 22 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभातखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे कोटीश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकादशोऽध्यायः .. 11 ..
14.11.m:
worshipped that liṅga with supreme faith, O king. / Having worshipped it, they all attained perfection through the grace of the liṅga.
Thus ends the eleventh chapter, titled 'Description of the Māhātmya of Koṭīśvara', in the Arbuda section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsa section, in the Mahāpurāṇa of Śrī Skanda, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.12.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha rūpatīrthamanuttamam ..
sarvapāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ rūpasaubhaṇyadāyakam.. 1 ..
14.12.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ रूपतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
सर्वपापहरं नॄणां रूपसौभण्यदायकम्.. 1 ..
14.12.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the unsurpassed Rūpatīrtha, / which removes all sins of men and bestows beauty and good fortune.

14.12.s:
tatra pūrvaṃ vapurnāmnā loke khyātā varāpsarāḥ ..
siddhiṃ gatā mahārāja yathā pūrvaṃ nigadyate .. 2 ..
14.12.d:
तत्र पूर्वं वपुर्नाम्ना लोके ख्याता वराप्सराः ..
सिद्धिं गता महाराज यथा पूर्वं निगद्यते .. 2 ..
14.12.m: There, formerly, an excellent apsaras named Vapuḥ, renowned in the world, / attained perfection, O great king, as is related from of old.

14.12.s:
purā''sītkācidābhīrī virūpā vikṛtānanā ..
lambodarī ca kugrīvā sthūladaṃtaśiroruhā .. 3 ..
14.12.d:
पुरा'ऽसीत्काचिदाभीरी विरूपा विकृतानना ..
लम्बोदरी च कुग्रीवा स्थूलदंतशिरोरुहा .. 3 ..
14.12.m: Long ago, there was an Ābhīra woman: deformed, with a distorted face, / pot-bellied, with a crooked neck, and with coarse teeth and hair.

14.12.s:
ekadā phalamādātuṃ bhramamāṇā'rbudācale ..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ patitā girinirjhare .. 4 ..
14.12.d:
एकदा फलमादातुं भ्रममाणाऽर्बुदाचले ..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां पतिता गिरिनिर्झरे .. 4 ..
14.12.m: Once, wandering on Mount Arbuda to gather fruit / on the third day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, she fell into a mountain waterfall.

14.12.s:
divyamālyāṃbaradharā divyairaṃgaiḥ samanvitā ..
padmanetrā sukeśāṃtā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā .. 5 ..
14.12.d:
दिव्यमाल्यांबरधरा दिव्यैरंगैः समन्विता ..
पद्मनेत्रा सुकेशांता सर्वलक्षणलक्षिता .. 5 ..
14.12.m: Wearing divine garlands and garments, endowed with celestial limbs, / with lotus eyes, lovely locks of hair, and marked with all auspicious marks,

14.12.s:
sā saṃjātā mahārāja tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
etasminneva kāle tu śakrastatra samāgataḥ .. 6 ..
14.12.d:
सा संजाता महाराज तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु शक्रस्तत्र समागतः .. 6 ..
14.12.m: she was transformed, O great king, by the power of this sacred ford. / At that very moment, Śakra arrived there

14.12.s:
krīḍārthaṃ parvataśreṣṭhe tāṃ dadarśa śubhekṣaṇām ..
tataḥ kāmaśarairviddhastāmuvāca sumadhyamām .. 7 ..
14.12.d:
क्रीडार्थं पर्वतश्रेष्ठे तां ददर्श शुभेक्षणाम् ..
ततः कामशरैर्विद्धस्तामुवाच सुमध्यमाम् .. 7 ..
14.12.m: for sport on that best of mountains, and saw her of auspicious eyes. / Then, pierced by the arrows of Kāma, he spoke to that slender-waisted woman:

14.12.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
kā tvaṃ vada varārohe kimarthaṃ tvamihāgatā ..
devī vā nāgakanyā vā siddhā vidyādharī tu vā .. 8 ..
14.12.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
का त्वं वद वरारोहे किमर्थं त्वमिहागता ..
देवी वा नागकन्या वा सिद्धा विद्याधरी तु वा .. 8 ..
14.12.m: Indra said: / "Who are you, speak, O fair-hipped woman! For what purpose have you come here? / Are you a goddess, or a Nāga maiden, or a Siddha woman, or a Vidyādharī?

14.12.s:
mano me'pahṛtaṃ subhrūstvayā ca padmanetrayā ..
śakro'haṃ sarvadeveśo bhaja māṃ cāruhāsini .. 9 ..
14.12.d:
मनो मेऽपहृतं सुभ्रूस्त्वया च पद्मनेत्रया ..
शक्रोऽहं सर्वदेवेशो भज मां चारुहासिनि .. 9 ..
14.12.m: My mind has been stolen by you, O woman of lovely brows, with eyes like lotuses! / I am Śakra, the lord of all the gods. Turn your love to me, O sweet-smiling woman!"

14.12.s:
.. nāryuvāca .. ..
ābhīrī tridaśādhīśa tathāhaṃ bahubhartṛkā ..
phalārthaṃ tu samāyātā patitā girinirjhare .. 7.3.12.10 ..
14.12.d:
.. नार्युवाच .. ..
आभीरी त्रिदशाधीश तथाहं बहुभर्तृका ..
फलार्थं तु समायाता पतिता गिरिनिर्झरे .. 7.3.12.10 ..
14.12.m: The woman said: / "I am an Ābhīra woman, O lord of the thirty [gods], and one of many husbands. / I came for the sake of fruit and fell into the mountain waterfall.

14.12.s:
snātvā rūpamidaṃ prāptā surūpaṃ ca śubhaṃ mayā ..
durllabhastvaṃ hi devānāṃ kiṃ punarmartyajanmanām .. 11 ..
14.12.d:
स्नात्वा रूपमिदं प्राप्ता सुरूपं च शुभं मया ..
दुर्ल्लभस्त्वं हि देवानां किं पुनर्मर्त्यजन्मनाम् .. 11 ..
14.12.m: Having bathed, I obtained this beautiful and auspicious form. / Indeed, you are difficult for the gods to attain, how much more so for mortal-born beings?

14.12.s:
vaśagāste surāḥ sarve mayi kiṃ kriyate spṛhā ..
bhaja māṃ tridaśādhīśa yathākāmaṃ surādhipa .. 12 ..
14.12.d:
वशगास्ते सुराः सर्वे मयि किं क्रियते स्पृहा ..
भज मां त्रिदशाधीश यथाकामं सुराधिप .. 12 ..
14.12.m: All the gods are subject to your control; why do you show longing for me? / Turn your love to me, O lord of the thirty [gods], as you desire, O chief of the gods!"

14.12.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktastayā śakraḥ kāmayāmāsa tāṃ tadā ..
nivṛttamadano bhūtvā tāmuvāca sumadhyamām .. 13 ..
14.12.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्तस्तया शक्रः कामयामास तां तदा ..
निवृत्तमदनो भूत्वा तामुवाच सुमध्यमाम् .. 13 ..
14.12.m: Pulastya said: / Addressed thus by her, Śakra then made love to her. / Having sated his passion, he spoke to that slender-waisted woman:

14.12.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yatte manasi varttate ..
vinayāttava tuṣṭo'haṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam .. 14 ..
14.12.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय कल्याणि यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..
विनयात्तव तुष्टोऽहं दास्यामि वरमुत्तमम् .. 14 ..
14.12.m: Indra said: / "Choose a boon, O auspicious lady, whatever is in your heart. / I am pleased by your humility; I will grant an excellent boon."

14.12.s:
.. nāryuvāca .. ..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naro vā vanitā tathā ..
snānaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ .. 15 ..
14.12.d:
.. नार्युवाच .. ..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां नरो वा वनिता तथा ..
स्नानं यः कुरुते भक्त्या प्रीताः स्युः सर्वदेवताः .. 15 ..
14.12.m: The woman said: / "On the third day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, whatever man or woman / performs a ritual ablution with devotion, let all the gods be pleased with them;

14.12.s:
surūpaṃ jāyatāṃ teṣāṃ durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi ..
māṃ naya tvaṃ sahasrākṣa surāvāsaṃ surādhipa ..16..
14.12.d:
सुरूपं जायतां तेषां दुर्ल्लभं त्रिदशैरपि ..
मां नय त्वं सहस्राक्ष सुरावासं सुराधिप ..16..
14.12.m: let a beautiful form be born for them, difficult to attain even for the thirty [gods]; / and take me, O thousand-eyed one, to the abode of the gods, O chief of the gods!"

14.12.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamastviti tāmuktvā gṛhītvā tāṃ surādhipaḥ ..
vimāne ca tayā sārddhaṃ jagāma tridivaṃ prati .. 17 ..
14.12.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्विति तामुक्त्वा गृहीत्वा तां सुराधिपः ..
विमाने च तया सार्द्धं जगाम त्रिदिवं प्रति .. 17 ..
14.12.m: Pulastya said: / Saying to her 'So be it', and taking her, the chief of the gods / went to heaven along with her in an aerial chariot.

14.12.s:
vapuḥ prāptaṃ tayā yasmāttasmātpā rthivasattama ..
nāmnā vapuriti khyātā sā babhūva varāpsarāḥ .. 18 ..
14.12.d:
वपुः प्राप्तं तया यस्मात्तस्मात्पा र्थिवसत्तम ..
नाम्ना वपुरिति ख्याता सा बभूव वराप्सराः .. 18 ..
14.12.m: Because a beautiful body (vapus) was obtained by her, therefore, O best of kings, / she became an excellent apsaras renowned by the name Vapuḥ.

14.12.s:
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ devāstasmiñjalāśaye ..
snānaṃ sarve prakurvaṃti prabhāte bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ..19..
14.12.d:
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां देवास्तस्मिञ्जलाशये ..
स्नानं सर्वे प्रकुर्वंति प्रभाते भक्तिसंयुताः ..19..
14.12.m: On the third day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, in that reservoir of water, / all the gods perform their ritual ablution at dawn, endowed with devotion,

14.12.s:
tatrānyā devakanyāśca siddhayakṣāṃganāstathā ..
yastatra kurute snānaṃ tasminkāle narādhipa ..7.3.12.20..
14.12.d:
तत्रान्या देवकन्याश्च सिद्धयक्षांगनास्तथा ..
यस्तत्र कुरुते स्नानं तस्मिन्काले नराधिप ..7.3.12.20..
14.12.m: as do other divine maidens and women of the Siddhas and Yakṣas. / Whoever performs a ritual ablution there at that time, O lord of men,

14.12.s:
rūpaṃ ca labhate tādṛgyādṛglabdhaṃ tayā purā ..
sarve tatra bhaviṣyaṃti siddhavidyādharoragāḥ .. 21 ..
14.12.d:
रूपं च लभते तादृग्यादृग्लब्धं तया पुरा ..
सर्वे तत्र भविष्यंति सिद्धविद्याधरोरगाः .. 21 ..
14.12.m: obtains such a form as was obtained by her in the past. / All Siddhas, Vidyādharas, and Uragas will be present there.

14.12.s:
tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge bilamasti suśobhanam ..
yatrāgatya prakurvaṃti snānaṃ pātālakanyakāḥ. ..22..
14.12.d:
तस्यैव पूर्वदिग्भागे बिलमस्ति सुशोभनम् ..
यत्रागत्य प्रकुर्वंति स्नानं पातालकन्यकाः. ..22..
14.12.m: To the eastern side of it there is a very splendid cave, / where the maidens of Pātāla come and perform ritual ablution.

14.12.s:
tatra snātvā gṛhītvāpo bile tasminvrajaṃti tāḥ ..
tatra vaināyake pīṭhe mahatpāṣāṇajaṃ jalam..23..
14.12.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा गृहीत्वापो बिले तस्मिन्व्रजंति ताः ..
तत्र वैनायके पीठे महत्पाषाणजं जलम्..23..
14.12.m: Having bathed there and taken water, they enter that cave. / There, at the seat of Vināyaka, is abundant water springing from rock.

14.12.s:
tenodakena saṃyuktaḥ siddho bhavati mānavaḥ ..
gṛhītvā tajjalaṃ yastu yatra yatrābhigacchati .. 24 ..
14.12.d:
तेनोदकेन संयुक्तः सिद्धो भवति मानवः ..
गृहीत्वा तज्जलं यस्तु यत्र यत्राभिगच्छति .. 24 ..
14.12.m: A person endowed with that water becomes perfected. / Whoever, having taken that water, goes wherever he pleases,

14.12.s:
svarge vā bhūtale vāpi na kenāpi pradhṛṣyate ..
tatrāsti vivaradvāre tilakonāma pādapaḥ .. 25 ..
14.12.d:
स्वर्गे वा भूतले वापि न केनापि प्रधृष्यते ..
तत्रास्ति विवरद्वारे तिलकोनाम पादपः .. 25 ..
14.12.m: either in heaven or on the surface of the earth, he is not overpowered by anyone. / At the opening of the cavern there is a tree named tilaka.

14.12.s:
tasya puṣpaiḥ phalaiścaiva sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prasiddhyati ..
bhakṣaṇāddhāraṇādvāpi siddho bhavati mānavaḥ ..26..
14.12.d:
तस्य पुष्पैः फलैश्चैव सर्वं कार्यं प्रसिद्ध्यति ..
भक्षणाद्धारणाद्वापि सिद्धो भवति मानवः ..26..
14.12.m: By its flowers and fruits, every undertaking is accomplished; / by eating them or by wearing them, a person becomes perfected.

14.12.s:
tasminbile tu pāṣāṇāḥ samantācchaṃkhasannibhāḥ ..
tenodakena saṃspṛṣṭā bhavaṃti ca hiraṇmayāḥ .. 27 ..
14.12.d:
तस्मिन्बिले तु पाषाणाः समन्ताच्छंखसन्निभाः ..
तेनोदकेन संस्पृष्टा भवंति च हिरण्मयाः .. 27 ..
14.12.m: Moreover, the stones inside that cave look like conch shells on all sides; / touched by that water, they become golden.

14.12.s:
vandhyā nārī jalaṃ tatra yā pibettilakānvitam ..
api varṣaśatābdā ca sadyo garbhavatī bhavet.. .. 28 ..
14.12.d:
वन्ध्या नारी जलं तत्र या पिबेत्तिलकान्वितम् ..
अपि वर्षशताब्दा च सद्यो गर्भवती भवेत्.. .. 28 ..
14.12.m: Whatever barren woman drinks the water there accompanied by [fruit/flowers of] the tilaka, / even if she is a hundred years old, immediately becomes pregnant.

14.12.s:
vyādhigrasto'pi yo marttyaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
nīrogo jāyate sadyo grahagrasto vimucyate .. 29 ..
14.12.d:
व्याधिग्रस्तोऽपि यो मर्त्त्यः स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
नीरोगो जायते सद्यो ग्रहग्रस्तो विमुच्यते .. 29 ..
14.12.m: Even a mortal afflicted with disease who performs a ritual ablution there / immediately becomes free from sickness, and one seized by evil planets is released.

14.12.s:
bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ doṣaḥ sadyaḥ praṇaśyati ..
tenodakena saṃspṛṣṭe sarvaṃ naśyati duṣkṛtam .. 7.3.12.30 ..
14.12.d:
भूतप्रेतपिशाचानां दोषः सद्यः प्रणश्यति ..
तेनोदकेन संस्पृष्टे सर्वं नश्यति दुष्कृतम् .. 7.3.12.30 ..
14.12.m: The affliction caused by bhūtas, pretas, and piśācas is instantly destroyed; / when touched by that water, all bad deeds are destroyed.

14.12.s:
api kīṭapataṃgā ye piśācāḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ ..
tenodakena ye spṛṣṭāḥ sadyo yāsyaṃti sadgatim .. 31 ..
14.12.d:
अपि कीटपतंगा ये पिशाचाः पक्षिणो मृगाः ..
तेनोदकेन ये स्पृष्टाः सद्यो यास्यंति सद्गतिम् .. 31 ..
14.12.m: Even worms, winged insects, piśācas, birds, and wild beasts / who are touched by that water will instantly go to an auspicious destination.

14.12.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
apyadbhutamidaṃ brahmanmāhātmyaṃ bhavatā mama ..
kathitaṃ rūpatīrthasya na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati .. .. 32 ..
14.12.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
अप्यद्भुतमिदं ब्रह्मन्माहात्म्यं भवता मम ..
कथितं रूपतीर्थस्य न भूतं न भविष्यति .. .. 32 ..
14.12.m: Yayāti said: / "Indeed, this wonderful māhātmya of Rūpatīrtha that has been told to me / by you, O brahmin, has never been before and will never be again.

14.12.s:
kimatra kāraṇaṃ brahmansarvebhyo'pyadhikaṃ smṛtam ..
sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me .. 33 ..
14.12.d:
किमत्र कारणं ब्रह्मन्सर्वेभ्योऽप्यधिकं स्मृतम् ..
सर्वं विस्तरतो ब्रूहि परं कौतूहलं हि मे .. 33 ..
14.12.m: What is the reason here, O brahmin, that it is considered superior to all others? / Tell me everything in detail, for my curiosity is immense."

14.12.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamadityā nṛpasattama ..
indre rājyaparibhraṣṭe balau trailokyanāyake ..
avatīrṇaścaturbāhuradityāṃ nṛpasattama .. 34 ..
14.12.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तमदित्या नृपसत्तम ..
इन्द्रे राज्यपरिभ्रष्टे बलौ त्रैलोक्यनायके ..
अवतीर्णश्चतुर्बाहुरदित्यां नृपसत्तम .. 34 ..
14.12.m: Pulastya said: / "Formerly, austerity was performed there by Aditi, O best of kings, / when Indra had fallen from his kingdom and Bali was the lord of the three worlds, / [and] the four-armed [lord] descended from Aditi, O best of kings.

14.12.s:
tasmiñjāte mahāviṣṇāvadityā cāsurāntake ..
guptayā vivaradvāre bhayāddānavasaṃbhavāt .. 35 ..
14.12.d:
तस्मिञ्जाते महाविष्णावदित्या चासुरान्तके ..
गुप्तया विवरद्वारे भयाद्दानवसंभवात् .. 35 ..
14.12.m: When that great Viṣṇu, slayer of the asuras, was born to Aditi, / [she placed him] in hiding at the entrance of a cave out of fear arising from the Dānavas.

14.12.s:
jātamātro haristasminsthāpito nirjhare tayā ..
tasmātpavitratāṃ prāptaṃ tīrthaṃ nṝṇāmabhīṣṭadam .. 36 ..
14.12.d:
जातमात्रो हरिस्तस्मिन्स्थापितो निर्झरे तया ..
तस्मात्पवित्रतां प्राप्तं तीर्थं नॄणामभीष्टदम् .. 36 ..
14.12.m: As soon as he was born, Hari was placed by her in that mountain stream. / Therefore that sacred ford attained sanctity, granting men their desires.

14.12.s:
na cānyatkāraṇaṃ rājansatyametanmayoditam ..
māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ tatra jātastrivikramaḥ .. 37 ..
14.12.d:
न चान्यत्कारणं राजन्सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम् ..
माघशुक्लतृतीयायां तत्र जातस्त्रिविक्रमः .. 37 ..
14.12.m: There is no other reason, O king; this that I have spoken is the truth. / On the third day of the bright fortnight of Māgha, Trivikrama was born there.

14.12.s:
tilakaḥ sarva vṛkṣāgryaḥ putravatparipālitaḥ ..
adityā sevito nityaṃ svahastena jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ .. 38 ..
14.12.d:
तिलकः सर्व वृक्षाग्र्यः पुत्रवत्परिपालितः ..
अदित्या सेवितो नित्यं स्वहस्तेन जलैः शुभैः .. 38 ..
14.12.m: The tilaka, the foremost of all trees, was tended like a son; / it was constantly served by Aditi with her own hands with auspicious waters.

14.12.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāmiha loke paratra ca .. 39 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe rūpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 12 ..
14.12.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं तीर्थमाहात्म्यमुत्तमम् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
सर्वकामप्रदं नॄणामिह लोके परत्र च .. 39 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे रूपतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वादशोऽध्यायः .. 12 ..
14.12.m:
All this, the supreme māhātmya of the sacred ford, has been recounted to you. / Therefore, one should perform ritual ablution there with every effort; / it grants all desires to mortals in this world and the next.
Thus ends the twelfth chapter, named 'Description of the Māhātmya of Rūpatīrtha', in the third Arbuda section, in the seventh Prabhāsa section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. // 12

14.13.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
aṃbarīṣasya rājarṣeraiśānyāṃ pāpanāśanam .. 1 ..
14.13.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
अंबरीषस्य राजर्षेरैशान्यां पापनाशनम् .. 1 ..
14.13.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the sacred ford renowned in the three worlds, / which destroys sins, in the north-east of the royal seer Ambarīṣa.

14.13.s:
yatra svayaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ kāle ca kalisaṃjñake ..
tasya vākyādṛtastīrthe svayaṃ hi paritiṣṭhati .. 2 ..
14.13.d:
यत्र स्वयं हृषीकेशः काले च कलिसंज्ञके ..
तस्य वाक्यादृतस्तीर्थे स्वयं हि परितिष्ठति .. 2 ..
14.13.m: Where Hṛṣīkeśa himself, in the period called the Kali [age], / abides in person at the sacred ford, bound by his word.

14.13.s:
purāsītpṛthivīpālo hyaṃbarīṣo yuge kṛte ..
harimārādhayāmāsa tapastepe suduṣkaram .. 3 ..
14.13.d:
पुरासीत्पृथिवीपालो ह्यंबरीषो युगे कृते ..
हरिमाराधयामास तपस्तेपे सुदुष्करम् .. 3 ..
14.13.m: In ancient times, in the Kṛta age, there was a king named Ambarīṣa; / he worshipped Hari and practiced very severe austerity.

14.13.s:
tasmiṃstīrthe sa rājendro mitabhakṣo jitendriyaḥ ..
sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tata āsītphalāśanaḥ .. 4 ..
14.13.d:
तस्मिंस्तीर्थे स राजेन्द्रो मितभक्षो जितेन्द्रियः ..
सहस्रमेकं वर्षाणां तत आसीत्फलाशनः .. 4 ..
14.13.m: At that sacred ford, that lord of kings, eating moderately and having subdued his senses, / lived eating [only] fruits for a thousand years.

14.13.s:
sahasre dve tato rājañchīrṇaparṇāśano'bhavat..
sahasre dve tato bhūyo jalāhāro babhūva ha .. 5 ..
14.13.d:
सहस्रे द्वे ततो राजञ्छीर्णपर्णाशनोऽभवत्..
सहस्रे द्वे ततो भूयो जलाहारो बभूव ह .. 5 ..
14.13.m: Then, O king, he lived for two thousand [years] eating [only] fallen leaves; / then again for two thousand [years] water became his sustenance.

14.13.s:
sahasratritayaṃ rājanvāyubhakṣo babhūva ha ..
cintayanpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃ mānase śraddhayānvitaḥ .. 6 ..
14.13.d:
सहस्रत्रितयं राजन्वायुभक्षो बभूव ह ..
चिन्तयन्पुंडरीकाक्षं मानसे श्रद्धयान्वितः .. 6 ..
14.13.m: For three thousand [years], O king, he subsisted on air, / contemplating the Lotus-eyed One in his mind with faith.

14.13.s:
daśa varṣasahasrānte tataśca nṛpasattama ..
tutoṣa bhagavānviṣṇustasyāsau darśanaṃ dadau .. 7 ..
14.13.d:
दश वर्षसहस्रान्ते ततश्च नृपसत्तम ..
तुतोष भगवान्विष्णुस्तस्यासौ दर्शनं ददौ .. 7 ..
14.13.m: Then, at the end of ten thousand years, O best of kings, / the blessed Viṣṇu was pleased, and he granted him his darśana.

14.13.s:
kṛtvā devapate rūpamāruhyairāvataṃ gajam ..
abravīdvarado'smīti aṃbarīṣaṃ narādhipam .. 8 ..
14.13.d:
कृत्वा देवपते रूपमारुह्यैरावतं गजम् ..
अब्रवीद्वरदोऽस्मीति अंबरीषं नराधिपम् .. 8 ..
14.13.m: Assuming the form of the lord of the gods, mounted on the elephant Airāvata, / he said to King Ambarīṣa, 'I am a granter of boons.'

14.13.s:
.. iṃdra uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te rājanyanmanasīpsitam ..
tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktisaṃyuktamāgato'hamasaṃśayam .. 9 .. ..
14.13.d:
.. इंद्र उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते राजन्यन्मनसीप्सितम् ..
त्वां दृष्ट्वा भक्तिसंयुक्तमागतोऽहमसंशयम् .. 9 .. ..
14.13.m: Indra said: / 'Choose a boon, hail to you, O king, whatever is desired in your heart. / Seeing you endowed with devotion, I have arrived without doubt.'

14.13.s:
.. aṃbarīṣa uvāca .. ..
muktiṃ dātumaśaktosi tvaṃ ca vṛtraniṣūdana ..
tava prasādāddeveśa trailokyaṃ mama varttate ..
svāgataṃ gaccha deveśa na varo rocate mama .. 7.3.13.10 ..
14.13.d:
.. अंबरीष उवाच .. ..
मुक्तिं दातुमशक्तोसि त्वं च वृत्रनिषूदन ..
तव प्रसादाद्देवेश त्रैलोक्यं मम वर्त्तते ..
स्वागतं गच्छ देवेश न वरो रोचते मम .. 7.3.13.10 ..
14.13.m: Ambarīṣa said: / 'You are unable to grant liberation, O slayer of Vṛtra. / By your grace, O lord of gods, my three worlds exist! / Welcome, [now] depart, O lord of gods; I take no pleasure in your boon.

14.13.s:
sarvathā dāsyate mahyaṃ varaṃ tuṣṭaścaturbhujaḥ ..
tadāhaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi gaccha deva namostu te .. 11 ..
14.13.d:
सर्वथा दास्यते मह्यं वरं तुष्टश्चतुर्भुजः ..
तदाहं प्रतिगृह्णामि गच्छ देव नमोस्तु ते .. 11 ..
14.13.m: When the four-armed one is pleased, he will grant me a boon by all means; / then I shall accept it. Depart, O god, obeisance to you!'

14.13.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya rājarṣe yatte manasi varttate ..
brahmaviṣṇutrinetrāṇāmahamīśo nṛpotama .. 12 ..
14.13.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय राजर्षे यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..
ब्रह्मविष्णुत्रिनेत्राणामहमीशो नृपोतम .. 12 ..
14.13.m: Indra said: / 'Choose a boon, O royal seer, whatever is in your mind. / I am the lord of Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and the Three-eyed One, O best of men!

14.13.s:
anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ trailokyasyāpyahaṃ vibhuḥ ..
varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ prasādānme sudurllabham .. 13 ..
14.13.d:
अन्येषां चैव देवानां त्रैलोक्यस्याप्यहं विभुः ..
वरं वरय तस्मात्त्वं प्रसादान्मे सुदुर्ल्लभम् .. 13 ..
14.13.m: And of the other gods and of the three worlds I am the master. / Therefore choose a boon very hard to attain through my favor.

14.13.s:
prasanne mayi rājendra prasannāḥ sarvadevatāḥ ..
kuru me vacanaṃ rājangṛhyatāṃ varamuttamam .. 14 ..
14.13.d:
प्रसन्ने मयि राजेन्द्र प्रसन्नाः सर्वदेवताः ..
कुरु मे वचनं राजन्गृह्यतां वरमुत्तमम् .. 14 ..
14.13.m: When I am pleased, O king of kings, all the deities are pleased. / Obey my word, O king, and accept an excellent boon!'

14.13.s:
.. aṃbarīṣa uvāca .. ..
rājā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ trailokyasya tatheśvaraḥ ..
saptadvīpavatī rājā ahaṃ vṛtraniṣūdana .. 15 ..
14.13.d:
.. अंबरीष उवाच .. ..
राजा त्वं सर्वदेवानां त्रैलोक्यस्य तथेश्वरः ..
सप्तद्वीपवती राजा अहं वृत्रनिषूदन .. 15 ..
14.13.m: Ambarīṣa said: / 'You are the king of all the gods and likewise the ruler of the three worlds. / I am the king of [the earth] possessing the seven continents, O slayer of Vṛtra.

14.13.s:
haṣīkeśasya sadbhaktaṃ viddhi māṃ tāta niścayam ..
āgataśca hṛṣīkeśo varaṃ dāsyatyasaṃśayam .. 16 ..
14.13.d:
हषीकेशस्य सद्भक्तं विद्धि मां तात निश्चयम् ..
आगतश्च हृषीकेशो वरं दास्यत्यसंशयम् .. 16 ..
14.13.m: Know me with certainty, dear sir, to be a true devotee of Hṛṣīkeśa; / and when Hṛṣīkeśa has come, he will undoubtedly grant me a boon.'

14.13.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
dadato mama bhūpāla na gṛhṇāsi varaṃ yadi ..
vajraṃ tvāṃ prerayiṣyāmi vadhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ .. 17 ..
14.13.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
ददतो मम भूपाल न गृह्णासि वरं यदि ..
वज्रं त्वां प्रेरयिष्यामि वधाय कृतनिश्चयः .. 17 ..
14.13.m: Indra said: / 'If you do not accept the boon from me while I offer it, O protector of the earth, / I, having resolved upon your slaying, will hurl my thunderbolt at you!'

14.13.s:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ sṛkkiṇī parilelihan ..
kuliśaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare .. 18 ..
14.13.d:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षः सृक्किणी परिलेलिहन् ..
कुलिशं भ्रामयामास गृहीत्वा दक्षिणे करे .. 18 ..
14.13.m: Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed one, licking the corners of his mouth, / brandished the thunderbolt, seizing it in his right hand.

14.13.s:
tasyevaṃ bhrāmyamāṇasya mahotpātā babhūvire ..
tataḥ parvataśṛṃgāṇi viśīrṇāni samaṃtataḥ .. 19 ..
14.13.d:
तस्येवं भ्राम्यमाणस्य महोत्पाता बभूविरे ..
ततः पर्वतशृंगाणि विशीर्णानि समंततः .. 19 ..
14.13.m: As it was being brandished in this way, great portents occurred; / then mountain peaks shattered on all sides.

14.13.s:
āvṛtaṃ gagana meghairvidhunvānairmahīṃ tadā ..
na kiṃciddṛśyate tatra sarvaṃ saṃtamasāvṛtam .. 7.3.13.20 ..
14.13.d:
आवृतं गगन मेघैर्विधुन्वानैर्महीं तदा ..
न किंचिद्दृश्यते तत्र सर्वं संतमसावृतम् .. 7.3.13.20 ..
14.13.m: The sky was covered then with clouds that shook the earth; / nothing could be seen there, as everything was enveloped in complete darkness.

14.13.s:
etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā harivatsalaḥ ..
nimīlya locane svīye samādhistho babhūva ha .. 21 ..
14.13.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु स राजा हरिवत्सलः ..
निमील्य लोचने स्वीये समाधिस्थो बभूव ह .. 21 ..
14.13.m: At that very time, that king devoted to Hari / closed his eyes and became absorbed in deep meditation.

14.13.s:
tatastuṣṭo jagannātha sākṣātpratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ ..
airāvataḥ sa garuḍastatkṣaṇātsamajāyata .. 22 ..
14.13.d:
ततस्तुष्टो जगन्नाथ साक्षात्प्रत्यक्षतां गतः ..
ऐरावतः स गरुडस्तत्क्षणात्समजायत .. 22 ..
14.13.m: Then, pleased, the Lord of the World became visibly manifest in person; / that Airāvata instantly became Garuḍa.

14.13.s:
tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśo meghagaṃbhīrayā girā ..
dhyānasthitaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaṃkha cakragadādharaḥ .. 23 .. ..
14.13.d:
तमुवाच हृषीकेशो मेघगंभीरया गिरा ..
ध्यानस्थितं नृपश्रेष्ठं शंख चक्रगदाधरः .. 23 .. ..
14.13.m: Hṛṣīkeśa, wielding the conch, discus, and mace, / spoke to that best of kings absorbed in meditation with a voice deep as a thundercloud:

14.13.s:
śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vatsānanyabhakta janeśvara ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 24 .. ..
14.13.d:
श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते वत्सानन्यभक्त जनेश्वर ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 24 .. ..
14.13.m: The Blessed Lord said: / 'I am highly pleased with you, dear one, O lord of men of exclusive devotion! / Choose a boon, hail to you, even if it be very hard to attain.'

14.13.s:
.. aṃbarīṣa uvāca .. ..
yadi prasanno bhagavanyadi deyo varo mama ..
saṃsārābdhestāraṇāya varado bhava me hare .. 25 ..
14.13.d:
.. अंबरीष उवाच .. ..
यदि प्रसन्नो भगवन्यदि देयो वरो मम ..
संसाराब्धेस्तारणाय वरदो भव मे हरे .. 25 ..
14.13.m: Ambarīṣa said: / 'If the Blessed Lord is pleased, if a boon is to be given to me, / then become the granter of a boon to deliver me from the ocean of worldly existence, O Hari!'

14.13.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
athāha bhagavānviṣṇuraṃbarīṣaṃ janādhipam ..
jñānayogaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ saṃsārakṣayakāraṇam .. 26 ..
14.13.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अथाह भगवान्विष्णुरंबरीषं जनाधिपम् ..
ज्ञानयोगं सुविस्तीर्णं संसारक्षयकारणम् .. 26 ..
14.13.m: Pulastya said: / Then the blessed Viṣṇu spoke to Ambarīṣa, the ruler of men, / of the extensive yoga of knowledge, which brings an end to worldly existence,

14.13.s:
yasmiñjāte naraḥ sadyaḥ saṃsārānmucyate nṛpa ..
śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ samyakpraṇamyovāca keśavam .. 27 ..
14.13.d:
यस्मिञ्जाते नरः सद्यः संसारान्मुच्यते नृप ..
श्रुत्वा स नृपतिः सम्यक्प्रणम्योवाच केशवम् .. 27 ..
14.13.m: Upon the arising of which a man is instantly liberated from worldly existence, O king. / Having heard that, the king, bowing reverently, spoke to Keśava:

14.13.s:
.. aṃbarīṣa uvāca .. ..
bhagavanyastvayā prokto yogo'yaṃ mama vistarāt ..
