durjñeyaḥ sa nṛṇāṃ deva viśeṣācca kalau yuge .. 28 ..
14.13.d:
.. अंबरीष उवाच .. ..
भगवन्यस्त्वया प्रोक्तो योगोऽयं मम विस्तरात् ..
दुर्ज्ञेयः स नृणां देव विशेषाच्च कलौ युगे .. 28 ..
14.13.m: Ambarīṣa said: / 'O Blessed Lord, this yoga which you have described to me in detail / is difficult for men to understand, O god, especially in the Kali age.

14.13.s:
api cetsuprasanno'si kriyāyogaṃ bravīhi me ..
lokānāṃ tāraṇārthāya śaṃkhacakragadādhara .. 29 ..
14.13.d:
अपि चेत्सुप्रसन्नोऽसि क्रियायोगं ब्रवीहि मे ..
लोकानां तारणार्थाय शंखचक्रगदाधर .. 29 ..
14.13.m: Moreover, if you are very pleased, speak to me of the yoga of ritual action, / for the sake of delivering the worlds, O wielder of the conch, discus, and mace!'

14.13.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tatastasmai narendrāya kriyāyogaṃ janārddanaḥ ..
yathāyogyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha kathayāmāsa keśavaḥ .. 7.3.13.30 ..
14.13.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततस्तस्मै नरेन्द्राय क्रियायोगं जनार्द्दनः ..
यथायोग्यं नृपश्रेष्ठ कथयामास केशवः .. 7.3.13.30 ..
14.13.m: Pulastya said: / Then Janārdana Keśava properly explained to that lord of men, / O best of kings, the yoga of ritual action.

14.13.s: taṃ śrutvā tuṣṭahṛdayoṃ'barīṣo vākyamabravīt .. 31 ..
14.13.d: तं श्रुत्वा तुष्टहृदयोंऽबरीषो वाक्यमब्रवीत् .. 31 ..
14.13.m: Having heard that, Ambarīṣa, his heart delighted, spoke these words:

14.13.s:
.. aṃbarīṣa uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanrūpeṇānena mādhava ..
mamāśrame tvaṃ deveśa sadā sannihito bhava .. 32 ..
14.13.d:
.. अंबरीष उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टोऽसि भगवन्रूपेणानेन माधव ..
ममाश्रमे त्वं देवेश सदा सन्निहितो भव .. 32 ..
14.13.m: Ambarīṣa said: / 'If you are pleased, O Blessed Lord, in this form, O Mādhava, / always be present in my hermitage, O lord of the gods!

14.13.s:
yatastvatpratimāmekāmarcayāmi vidhānataḥ ..
pūjayiṣyaṃti lokāstvāṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam .. 33 ..
14.13.d:
यतस्त्वत्प्रतिमामेकामर्चयामि विधानतः ..
पूजयिष्यंति लोकास्त्वां शंखचक्रगदाधरम् .. 33 ..
14.13.m: For I shall worship an image of you in accordance with the prescribed rules; / people will worship you, the wielder of the conch, discus, and mace.'

14.13.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tathokto mādhavenāsau cakāra harimaṃdiram ..
pratimāṃ pūjayāmāsa gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ .. 34 ..
14.13.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तथोक्तो माधवेनासौ चकार हरिमंदिरम् ..
प्रतिमां पूजयामास गन्धपुष्पानुलेपनैः .. 34 ..
14.13.m: Pulastya said: / Being told "So be it" by Mādhava, he constructed a temple to Hari; / he worshipped the image with fragrant pastes, flowers, and ointments.

14.13.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā bhagavānviṣṇumaṃdire ..
tenaiva vapuṣā prāptaḥ saputraḥ sahabāṃdhavaḥ .. 35 ..
14.13.d:
ततः कालेन महता भगवान्विष्णुमंदिरे ..
तेनैव वपुषा प्राप्तः सपुत्रः सहबांधवः .. 35 ..
14.13.m: Then, after a long time, the king, along with his son and relatives, / attained the abode of Viṣṇu in that very body.

14.13.s:
adyāpi bhagavānviṣṇuḥ satyavākyena bhūpateḥ ..
sadā saṃnihito viṣṇustasminnavasare kalau .. 36 ..
14.13.d:
अद्यापि भगवान्विष्णुः सत्यवाक्येन भूपतेः ..
सदा संनिहितो विष्णुस्तस्मिन्नवसरे कलौ .. 36 ..
14.13.m: Even today, the blessed Lord Viṣṇu, by the king's true promise, / is ever present there during this Kali [age], O ruler of the earth. 36.

14.13.s:
tadārabhya mahārāja kriyāyogo dharātale ..
pravṛttaḥ pratimākāraḥ kāle ca kalisaṃjñake .. 37 ..
14.13.d:
तदारभ्य महाराज क्रियायोगो धरातले ..
प्रवृत्तः प्रतिमाकारः काले च कलिसंज्ञके .. 37 ..
14.13.m: Beginning from that time, O great king, in the time named Kali, / the yoga of ritual action in the form of images was set in motion on the face of the earth. 37.

14.13.s:
yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā hṛṣīkeśe nṛpārbude ..
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ prasādācca harernṛpa .. 38 ..
14.13.d:
यस्तं पूजयते भक्त्या हृषीकेशे नृपार्बुदे ..
स याति विष्णुसालोक्यं प्रसादाच्च हरेर्नृप .. 38 ..
14.13.m: Whoever worships Hṛṣīkeśa on Arbuda with devotion, O king, / attains dwelling in the same world as Viṣṇu by the grace of Hari, O king. 38.

14.13.s:
ekādaśyāṃ mahārāja jāgaraṃ yaḥ sadā nṛpa ..
kariṣyati nirāhāro hṛṣīkeśāgrataḥ sthitaḥ ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi .. .. 39 ..
14.13.d:
एकादश्यां महाराज जागरं यः सदा नृप ..
करिष्यति निराहारो हृषीकेशाग्रतः स्थितः ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं दुर्ल्लभं त्रिदशैरपि .. .. 39 ..
14.13.m: Whoever constantly observes a night vigil on the eleventh lunar day, O great king, / standing fasting before Hṛṣīkeśa, / shall go to the supreme realm that is difficult to attain even for the gods. 39.

14.13.s:
yatpuṇyaṃ kapilādāne kārtikyāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare ..
tatphalaṃ labhate marttyo hṛṣīkeśasya darśanāt .. 7.3.13.40 ..
14.13.d:
यत्पुण्यं कपिलादाने कार्तिक्यां ज्येष्ठपुष्करे ..
तत्फलं लभते मर्त्त्यो हृषीकेशस्य दर्शनात् .. 7.3.13.40 ..
14.13.m: The merit which comes from giving a brown cow at Jyeṣṭhapuṣkara on the full moon of Kārttika, / that fruit a mortal obtains from the darśana of Hṛṣīkeśa. 40.

14.13.s:
śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe saṃprāpte harivāsare ..
yaḥ paśyati hṛṣīkeśamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet .. 41 ..
14.13.d:
शुक्ले वा यदि वा कृष्णे संप्राप्ते हरिवासरे ..
यः पश्यति हृषीकेशमश्वमेधफलं लभेत् .. 41 ..
14.13.m: Whether in the bright fortnight or in the dark, when the day of Hari has arrived, / whoever sees Hṛṣīkeśa obtains the fruit of an horse sacrifice. 41.

14.13.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayettu vidhānataḥ ..
yastatra caturo māsansamyagvrataparāyaṇaḥ ..
abhyarcayeddhṛṣīkeśaṃ na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate .. 42 ..
14.13.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन पूजयेत्तु विधानतः ..
यस्तत्र चतुरो मासन्सम्यग्व्रतपरायणः ..
अभ्यर्चयेद्धृषीकेशं न स भूयोऽभिजायते .. 42 ..
14.13.m: Therefore, one should worship [him] according to the rules with every effort. / Whoever, devoted to the rite, worships Hṛṣīkeśa properly there / for the four months is not born again. 42.

14.13.s:
ekaḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni karoti nṛpasattama ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. .. 43 ..
14.13.d:
एकः सर्वाणि तीर्थानि करोति नृपसत्तम ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. .. 43 ..
14.13.m: One person visits all sacred fords, O best of kings, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 43.

14.13.s:
eko dānāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 44 ..
14.13.d:
एको दानानि सर्वाणि ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रयच्छति ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 44 ..
14.13.m: One gives all gifts to brahmins, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 44.

14.13.s:
ekaḥ kanyāsahasraṃ tu pradadyācca yathāvidhi ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 45 ..
14.13.d:
एकः कन्यासहस्रं तु प्रदद्याच्च यथाविधि ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 45 ..
14.13.m: One gives away a thousand maidens [in marriage] according to the rite, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 45.

14.13.s:
sūryagrahe kurukṣetre dadyāddānamanuttamam ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 46 ..
14.13.d:
सूर्यग्रहे कुरुक्षेत्रे दद्याद्दानमनुत्तमम् ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 46 ..
14.13.m: One gives an unsurpassed gift at Kurukṣetra during a solar eclipse, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 46.

14.13.s:
agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairyajatyekaḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 47 ..
14.13.d:
अग्निष्टोमादिभिर्यज्ञैर्यजत्येकः सदक्षिणैः..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 47 ..
14.13.m: One sacrifices with the Agniṣṭoma and other rites accompanied by priestly fees, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 47.

14.13.s:
eko himālayaṃ gatvā tyajati sva kalevaram ..
paśyatyanyo haṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ ...48...
14.13.d:
एको हिमालयं गत्वा त्यजति स्व कलेवरम् ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः ...48...
14.13.m: One goes to the Himālaya and abandons one's own body, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 48.

14.13.s:
ekastu bhṛgupātena tyajeddehaṃ sutīrthake ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 49 ..
14.13.d:
एकस्तु भृगुपातेन त्यजेद्देहं सुतीर्थके ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 49 ..
14.13.m: One casts off one's body at an excellent sacred ford by throwing oneself from a precipice, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 49.

14.13.s:
ekaḥ prāyopaveśena prāṇāṃstyajati mānavaḥ ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 7.3.13.50 ..
14.13.d:
एकः प्रायोपवेशेन प्राणांस्त्यजति मानवः ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 7.3.13.50 ..
14.13.m: One human being casts off the vital breaths by fasting unto death, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 50.

14.13.s:
brahmajñānaṃ vadatyekaḥ śrutvā jñānavi śāradaḥ ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 51 ..
14.13.d:
ब्रह्मज्ञानं वदत्येकः श्रुत्वा ज्ञानवि शारदः ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 51 ..
14.13.m: One, hearing [the teachings] and skilled in knowledge, discourses on knowledge of Brahman, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 51.

14.13.s:
gayāśrāddhaṃ karotyekaḥ pitṛpakṣe nṛpottama ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 52 ..
14.13.d:
गयाश्राद्धं करोत्येकः पितृपक्षे नृपोत्तम ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 52 ..
14.13.m: One performs the Gayā-śrāddha during the fortnight of the ancestors, O best of kings, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 52.

14.13.s:
cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ ca karotyekaḥ samāhitaḥ ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cātumāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 53 ..
14.13.d:
चांद्रायणसहस्रं च करोत्येकः समाहितः ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुमास्यं समाहितः .. 53 ..
14.13.m: One, collected in mind, performs a thousand Cāndrāyaṇa penances, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 53.

14.13.s:
vrataṃ tapaḥ sahasrābdamekaḥ samyakcarennaraḥ ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 54 ..
14.13.d:
व्रतं तपः सहस्राब्दमेकः सम्यक्चरेन्नरः ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 54 ..
14.13.m: One human being properly observes a vow of austerity for a thousand years, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 54.

14.13.s:
ekastu caturo vedānsamyakpaṭhati brāhmaṇaḥ ..
paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ .. 55 ..
14.13.d:
एकस्तु चतुरो वेदान्सम्यक्पठति ब्राह्मणः ..
पश्यत्यन्यो हृषीकेशं चातुर्मास्यं समाहितः .. 55 ..
14.13.m: One brahmin properly recites the four Vedas, / [while] another, collected in mind, gazes upon Hṛṣīkeśa throughout the Cāturmāsya. 55.

14.13.s:
bahunā kimihoktena śṛṇu saṃkṣepato nṛpa ..
ekatastu bhavetsarvamekato haridarśanam .. 56 ..
14.13.d:
बहुना किमिहोक्तेन शृणु संक्षेपतो नृप ..
एकतस्तु भवेत्सर्वमेकतो हरिदर्शनम् .. 56 ..
14.13.m: What is the use of saying much here? Listen in brief, O king: / On one side is all [of that], on the other is the darśana of Hari. 56.

14.13.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena sthātavyaṃ harisaṃnidhau ..
ambarīṣasya rājarṣeḥ sthānake pāpanāśane .. 57 ..
14.13.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्थातव्यं हरिसंनिधौ ..
अम्बरीषस्य राजर्षेः स्थानके पापनाशने .. 57 ..
14.13.m: Therefore, with every effort one should dwell in the presence of Hari, / at the sin-destroying abode of the royal seer Ambarīṣa. 57.

14.13.s:
ekatastu hṛṣīkeśa ekataḥ karṇikeśvaraḥ ..
tayormartyā mṛtā ye ca mānavā nṛpasattama .. 58 ..
14.13.d:
एकतस्तु हृषीकेश एकतः कर्णिकेश्वरः ..
तयोर्मर्त्या मृता ये च मानवा नृपसत्तम .. 58 ..
14.13.m: On one side is Hṛṣīkeśa, on the other is Karṇikeśvara; / the mortals, the human beings who die between the two, O best of kings, 58.

14.13.s:
api kṛtvā mahatpāpaṃ gacchaṃti harisannidhau ..
hṛṣīkeśaṃ samālokya sadyo muktimavāpnuyāt .. 59 ..
14.13.d:
अपि कृत्वा महत्पापं गच्छंति हरिसन्निधौ ..
हृषीकेशं समालोक्य सद्यो मुक्तिमवाप्नुयात् .. 59 ..
14.13.m: even after committing great sin, go to the presence of Hari. / Having beheld Hṛṣīkeśa, one attains liberation immediately. 59.

14.13.s:
puṣpamekaṃ hṛṣīkeśe yaścāropayate nṛpa ..
sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyukta iha loke paratra ca .. 7.3.13.60 ..
14.13.d:
पुष्पमेकं हृषीकेशे यश्चारोपयते नृप ..
सुखसौभाग्यसंयुक्त इह लोके परत्र च .. 7.3.13.60 ..
14.13.m: And whoever offers a single flower to Hṛṣīkeśa, O king, / is endowed with happiness and good fortune in this world and the next. 60.

14.13.s:
hṛṣīkeśasya yo bhaktyā kariṣyatyanulepanam ..
sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 61 ..
14.13.d:
हृषीकेशस्य यो भक्त्या करिष्यत्यनुलेपनम् ..
स यास्यति परं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 61 ..
14.13.m: Whoever applies an ointment to Hṛṣīkeśa with devotion / will go to the supreme realm free from old age and death. 61.

14.13.s:
saṃmārjanaṃ ca tasyāgre yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ ..
yāvatyo reṇavastatra tāvadvarṣaśatāni saḥ ..
modate viṣṇulokastho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 62 ..
14.13.d:
संमार्जनं च तस्याग्रे यः करोति समाहितः ..
यावत्यो रेणवस्तत्र तावद्वर्षशतानि सः ..
मोदते विष्णुलोकस्थो नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 62 ..
14.13.m: And whoever, collected in mind, sweeps before him, / for as many dust particles as are there, for that many hundreds of years / he rejoices, dwelling in the world of Viṣṇu; no doubt should be entertained on this. 62.

14.13.s:
kārtike śuklapakṣe ca ekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama ..
dīpamāropayedyaśca hṛṣīkeśāgrato nṛpa .. 63 ..
14.13.d:
कार्तिके शुक्लपक्षे च एकादश्यां नृपोत्तम ..
दीपमारोपयेद्यश्च हृषीकेशाग्रतो नृप .. 63 ..
14.13.m: In the month of Kārttika, in the bright fortnight, on the eleventh lunar day, O best of kings, / whoever offers a lamp before Hṛṣīkeśa, O king, 63.

14.13.s:
yathāyathā prakāśeta pāpaṃ janmāṃtarārjitam ..
tathātathā vrajennāśaṃ tasya kāyādaśeṣataḥ .. 64 ..
14.13.d:
यथायथा प्रकाशेत पापं जन्मांतरार्जितम् ..
तथातथा व्रजेन्नाशं तस्य कायादशेषतः .. 64 ..
14.13.m: just as it shines, so the sin acquired in other births / goes to destruction completely from his body. 64.

14.13.s:
paṃcāmṛtena yaḥ pūjāṃ hṛṣīkeśe kariṣyati ..
dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā yastu na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate .. 65 ..
14.13.d:
पंचामृतेन यः पूजां हृषीकेशे करिष्यति ..
दध्ना क्षीरेण वा यस्तु न स भूयोऽभिजायते .. 65 ..
14.13.m: Whoever performs worship to Hṛṣīkeśa with the five nectars, / or with curd and milk, is not born again. 65.

14.13.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena hṛṣīkeśaṃ samarcayet ..
saṃsārabaṃdhato rājanmuktimāpnoti mānavaḥ .. 66 ..
14.13.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन हृषीकेशं समर्चयेत् ..
संसारबंधतो राजन्मुक्तिमाप्नोति मानवः .. 66 ..
14.13.m: Therefore, one should worship Hṛṣīkeśa with every effort. / A human being obtains liberation from the bond of worldly existence, O king. 66.

14.13.s:
hṛṣīkeśe viśeṣeṇa karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadā .. 67 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe hṛṣīkeśamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 13 ..
14.13.d:
हृषीकेशे विशेषेण कर्त्तव्यं पूजनं सदा .. 67 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे हृषीकेशमाहात्म्य वर्णनंनाम त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः .. 13 ..
14.13.m:
Worship of Hṛṣīkeśa should especially always be performed. 67.
Thus ends the thirteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Hṛṣīkeśa', in the Arbuda Section, the third [part] of the Prabhāsa Section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses. 13.

14.14.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param ..
siddhidaṃ prāṇināṃ samyaksiddhena sthāpitaṃ purā .. 1 ..
14.14.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ देवं सिद्धेश्वरं परम् ..
सिद्धिदं प्राणिनां सम्यक्सिद्धेन स्थापितं पुरा .. 1 ..
14.14.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the supreme god Siddheśvara, / the giver of perfections to living beings, properly installed in ancient times by a Siddha. 1.

14.14.s:
tatra viśvāvasurnāma siddhastepe mahātapaḥ ..
bahuvarṣāṇi saṃsthāpya śivaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ .. 2 ..
14.14.d:
तत्र विश्वावसुर्नाम सिद्धस्तेपे महातपः ..
बहुवर्षाणि संस्थाप्य शिवं भक्तिपरायणः .. 2 ..
14.14.m: There a Siddha named Viśvāvasu performed great austerity; / having installed Śiva, devoted to bhakti, [he practiced] for many years. 2.

14.14.s:
jitakrodho jitamado jitasarveṃdriyakriyaḥ ..
tāvadvarṣasahasrāṃte bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ ..
tutoṣa nṛpatestasya svayaṃ darśanamāyayau .. 3 ..
14.14.d:
जितक्रोधो जितमदो जितसर्वेंद्रियक्रियः ..
तावद्वर्षसहस्रांते भगवान्वृषभध्वजः ..
तुतोष नृपतेस्तस्य स्वयं दर्शनमाययौ .. 3 ..
14.14.m: Having conquered anger, having conquered pride, having conquered all actions of the senses, / at the end of that thousand years the blessed Lord whose emblem is the bull / was pleased, O king; he came in person to give him darśana. 3.
The Great God said to him, 'I am the giver of boons', O king. 4.

14.14.s:
.. śrībhagavānuvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi varttate ..
dāsyāmi te prasanno'haṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 5 .. ..
14.14.d:
.. श्रीभगवानुवाच .. ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..
दास्यामि ते प्रसन्नोऽहं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 5 .. ..
14.14.m: The blessed Lord said: / Choose a boon—blessing be upon you—whatever is in your mind. / Being pleased, I will grant it to you, even if it is very difficult to attain. 5.

14.14.s:
.. viśvāvasuruvāca .. ..
etalliṃgaṃ suraśreṣṭha dhyātvā manasi niścayam ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnotu prasādāttava śaṃkara .. 6..
14.14.d:
.. विश्वावसुरुवाच .. ..
एतल्लिंगं सुरश्रेष्ठ ध्यात्वा मनसि निश्चयम् ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोतु प्रसादात्तव शंकर .. 6..
14.14.m: Viśvāvasu said: / Having meditated on this liṅga with resolution in mind, O best of the gods, / let [a mortal] obtain all desires by your grace, O Śaṃkara! 6.

14.14.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamastviti sa procya tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
siddheśvaraṃ tato gatvā siddhiṃ yāti sahasraśaḥ .. 7 ..
14.14.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्विति स प्रोच्य तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
सिद्धेश्वरं ततो गत्वा सिद्धिं याति सहस्रशः .. 7 ..
14.14.m: Pulastya said: / Having said, 'So be it,' he vanished right there. / Then, having gone to Siddheśvara, [people] attain perfection by the thousands. 7.

14.14.s:
prabhāvāttasya liṃgasya kāmāniṣṭānavāpnuyuḥ ..
tato dharmakriyāḥ sarvā gatā nāśaṃ dharātale .. 8 ..
14.14.d:
प्रभावात्तस्य लिंगस्य कामानिष्टानवाप्नुयुः ..
ततो धर्मक्रियाः सर्वा गता नाशं धरातले .. 8 ..
14.14.m: Through the power of that liṅga, they obtained their cherished desires; / thereupon, all religious rites went to ruin on the surface of the earth. 8.

14.14.s:
na kaścidyajate yajñairna dānāni prayacchati ..
siddheśvaraprasādena siddhiṃ yāṃti narā bhuvi .. 9 ..
14.14.d:
न कश्चिद्यजते यज्ञैर्न दानानि प्रयच्छति ..
सिद्धेश्वरप्रसादेन सिद्धिं यांति नरा भुवि .. 9 ..
14.14.m: No one sacrificed with Vedic offerings, nor did they bestow gifts; / by the grace of Siddheśvara, men on earth attained perfection. 9.

14.14.s:
ucchinneṣu ca yajñeṣu dāneṣu nṛpasattama ..
indrādyāstridaśāḥ sarve paraṃ duḥkhamupāgatāḥ .. 7.3.14.10 ..
14.14.d:
उच्छिन्नेषु च यज्ञेषु दानेषु नृपसत्तम ..
इन्द्राद्यास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे परं दुःखमुपागताः .. 7.3.14.10 ..
14.14.m: And when sacrifices and gifts had been broken off, O best of kings, / all the thirty [gods] headed by Indra were plunged into supreme distress. 10.

14.14.s:
jñātvā yajñavighātaṃ ca tadvighātāya vāsavaḥ ..
vajreṇācchādayāmāsa yathā siddhirna jāyate .. 11 ..
14.14.d:
ज्ञात्वा यज्ञविघातं च तद्विघाताय वासवः ..
वज्रेणाच्छादयामास यथा सिद्धिर्न जायते .. 11 ..
14.14.m: And perceiving the impediment to sacrifices, Vāsava, to impede it, / covered it with his thunderbolt so that perfection would not arise.

14.14.s:
tathāpi saṃnidhau tasya siddheśasya nṛpottama ..
karmaṇo jāyate siddhiḥ pātakasya parikṣayaḥ .. 12 ..
14.14.d:
तथापि संनिधौ तस्य सिद्धेशस्य नृपोत्तम ..
कर्मणो जायते सिद्धिः पातकस्य परिक्षयः .. 12 ..
14.14.m: Even so, in the presence of that Siddheśa, O best of kings, / perfection of an action arises and sin is completely destroyed.

14.14.s:
yastu māghacaturddaśyāṃ somavāre nṛpottama ..
śuklāyāṃ vātha kṛṣṇāyāṃ spṛṣṭvā siddho bhavennaraḥ .. 13 ..
14.14.d:
यस्तु माघचतुर्द्दश्यां सोमवारे नृपोत्तम ..
शुक्लायां वाथ कृष्णायां स्पृष्ट्वा सिद्धो भवेन्नरः .. 13 ..
14.14.m: A man who touches it on the fourteenth lunar day of Māgha on a Monday, O best of kings, / whether in the light or the dark [fortnight], becomes a perfected one.

14.14.s:
adyāpi jāyate siddhiḥ satyametanmayoditam..
tasmātsiddheśvaraṃ gatvā natvā yāsyati sadgatim .. 14 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturddaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 14 ..
14.14.d:
अद्यापि जायते सिद्धिः सत्यमेतन्मयोदितम्..
तस्मात्सिद्धेश्वरं गत्वा नत्वा यास्यति सद्गतिम् .. 14 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे सिद्धेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्द्दशोऽध्यायः .. 14 ..
14.14.m:
Even today perfection arises; this has been spoken truly by me. / Therefore, having gone to Siddheśvara and bowed, one will attain the good path.
Thus ends the fourteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Siddheśvara,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh [part], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.15.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ śukreśvaraṃ gacchecchukreṇa sthāpitaṃ purā ..
yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ sadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate .. 1 ..
14.15.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः शुक्रेश्वरं गच्छेच्छुक्रेण स्थापितं पुरा ..
यं दृष्ट्वा मानवः सद्यः सर्वपापैः प्रमुच्यते .. 1 ..
14.15.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to Śukreśvara, formerly established by Śukra, / seeing which a human being is instantly freed from all sins.

14.15.s:
dṛṣṭvā daityānpurā devairnirjitānnṛpasattama ..
cintayāmāsa medhāvī bhārgavastānprati dvijaḥ .. 2 ..
14.15.d:
दृष्ट्वा दैत्यान्पुरा देवैर्निर्जितान्नृपसत्तम ..
चिन्तयामास मेधावी भार्गवस्तान्प्रति द्विजः .. 2 ..
14.15.m: Having seen the Daityas vanquished by the gods of old, O best of kings, / the intelligent Bhārgava, a twice-born, reflected with regard to them:

14.15.s:
kathaṃ daityāḥ surāñjitvā prāpsyaṃti ca mahāyaśaḥ ..
ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ siddhiṃ gacchāmi manasepsitam .. 3 ..
14.15.d:
कथं दैत्याः सुराञ्जित्वा प्राप्स्यंति च महायशः ..
आराध्य शंकरं सिद्धिं गच्छामि मनसेप्सितम् .. 3 ..
14.15.m: 'How will the Daityas, having conquered the gods, attain great fame? / Having propitiated Śaṃkara, I shall go to the perfection desired in my heart.'

14.15.s:
evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā gato'rbudamathācalam ..
bhūme vivaramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam .. 4 ..
14.15.d:
एवं स निश्चयं कृत्वा गतोऽर्बुदमथाचलम् ..
भूमे विवरमासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् .. 4 ..
14.15.m: Having thus made his resolve, he then went to the Arbuda mountain. / Entering a cleft in the earth, he performed very severe austerity.

14.15.s:
śivaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhūpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ ..
aniśaṃ pūjayāmāsa śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ .. 5 ..
14.15.d:
शिवलिंगं प्रतिष्ठाप्य धूपगंधानुलेपनैः ..
अनिशं पूजयामास श्रद्धया परयान्वितः .. 5 ..
14.15.m: Having consecrated a Śivaliṅga, with incenses, perfumes, and unguents / he worshipped it day and night, endowed with supreme faith.

14.15.s:
tato varṣasahasrāṃte tutoṣa bhagavāñchivaḥ ..
tasya saṃdarśanaṃ dattvā vākyametaduvāca ha .. 6 ..
14.15.d:
ततो वर्षसहस्रांते तुतोष भगवाञ्छिवः ..
तस्य संदर्शनं दत्त्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 6 ..
14.15.m: Then, at the end of a thousand years, the blessed Śiva was pleased. / Granting him his darśana, he spoke these words:

14.15.s:
.. śrīmahādeva uvāca .. ..
parituṣṭo'smi te vipra bhaktyā tava dvijottama ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 7 ..
14.15.d:
.. श्रीमहादेव उवाच .. ..
परितुष्टोऽस्मि ते विप्र भक्त्या तव द्विजोत्तम ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 7 ..
14.15.m: The glorious Mahādeva said: / 'I am well pleased with your devotion, O twice-born, O best of the twice-born. / Choose a boon—blessing unto you—even if it should be very difficult to obtain.'

14.15.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva vidyāṃ dehi maheśvara ..
yayā jīvaṃti saṃprāptā mṛtyuṃ saṃkhyepi jaṃtavaḥ .. 8 ..
14.15.d:
.. शुक्र उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टो महादेव विद्यां देहि महेश्वर ..
यया जीवंति संप्राप्ता मृत्युं संख्येपि जंतवः .. 8 ..
14.15.m: Śukra said: / 'If you are pleased, O Mahādeva, grant [me] the lore, O Maheśvara, / by which living beings who have met death even in battle revive.'

14.15.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
pradāya vai śivastasmai tāṃ vidyāṃ nṛpasattama ..
abravīcca punaḥ śukraṃ varamanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva me .. 9 ..
14.15.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
प्रदाय वै शिवस्तस्मै तां विद्यां नृपसत्तम ..
अब्रवीच्च पुनः शुक्रं वरमन्यं वृणीष्व मे .. 9 ..
14.15.m: Pulastya said: / Having granted him that lore, O best of kings, / Śiva spoke again to Śukra: 'Choose another boon from me.'

14.15.s:
.. śukra uvāca .. ..
etatkārtikamāsasya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu yaḥ spṛśet ..
tato liṃgaṃ pūjayecca yaḥ pumāñchraddhayānvitaḥ.. 7.3.15.10 ..
14.15.d:
.. शुक्र उवाच .. ..
एतत्कार्तिकमासस्य शुक्लाष्टम्यां तु यः स्पृशेत् ..
ततो लिंगं पूजयेच्च यः पुमाञ्छ्रद्धयान्वितः.. 7.3.15.10 ..
14.15.m: Śukra said: / 'Whoever touches this [liṅga] on the eighth day of the light half of the month of Kārttika, / and whichever man, endowed with faith, then worships the liṅga—

14.15.s:
alpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya mā bhūttava prasādataḥ ..
iṣṭānkāmānavāpnotu ihaloke paratra ca .. 11 ..
14.15.d:
अल्पमृत्युभयं तस्य मा भूत्तव प्रसादतः ..
इष्टान्कामानवाप्नोतु इहलोके परत्र च .. 11 ..
14.15.m: by your grace, let there be no fear of premature death for him, / [and] let him obtain his desired wishes in this world and the next.'

14.15.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamastviti sa procya tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
śukropi dānavānsaṃkhye hatāndevairanekaśaḥ ..12..
14.15.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमस्त्विति स प्रोच्य तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
शुक्रोपि दानवान्संख्ये हतान्देवैरनेकशः ..12..
14.15.m: Pulastya said: / Having said, "So be it," he vanished right there. / And Śukra too, [when] the Dānavas were slain in battle many times by the gods,

14.15.s:
vidyāyāśca prabhāvena jīvayāmāsa tānmuniḥ ..
tasyāgre'sminmahākuṇḍaṃ nirmalaṃ pāpanāśanam .. 13 ..
14.15.d:
विद्यायाश्च प्रभावेन जीवयामास तान्मुनिः ..
तस्याग्रेऽस्मिन्महाकुण्डं निर्मलं पापनाशनम् .. 13 ..
14.15.m: revived them by the power of that lore, the sage. / In front of it there is a great pool, stainless and destroying sins.

14.15.s:
tatra snāto naraḥ samyakpātakaiśca pramucyate ..
tatra śrāddhena rājeṃdra tuṣṭā yāṃti pitāmahāḥ .. 14 ..
14.15.d:
तत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यक्पातकैश्च प्रमुच्यते ..
तत्र श्राद्धेन राजेंद्र तुष्टा यांति पितामहाः .. 14 ..
14.15.m: A man who has bathed there is completely freed from sins. / Through a śrāddha there, O king of kings, the ancestors depart satisfied,

14.15.s:
tarpitāḥ salilenaiva kiṃ punaḥ piṃḍadānataḥ ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret .. 15 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe śukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 15 ..
14.15.d:
तर्पिताः सलिलेनैव किं पुनः पिंडदानतः ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् .. 15 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराणएकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे शुक्रेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचदशोऽध्यायः .. 15 ..
14.15.m:
satiated with mere water, so how much more from the offering of rice-balls! / Therefore, with all effort, one should perform ritual ablution there.
Thus ends the fifteenth chapter, named 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Śukreśvara,' in the third [section], the Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh [part], the Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].

14.16.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam..
maṇikarṇikasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvalokeṣu viśrutam..1..
14.16.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम्..
मणिकर्णिकसंज्ञं तु सर्वलोकेषु विश्रुतम्..1..
14.16.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the sacred ford that completely destroys sins, / named Maṇikarṇika, renowned in all the worlds,

14.16.s:
yatra siddhiṃ gatā rājanvālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ..
taistatra nirmitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ suramyaṃ giri gahvare .. 2 ..
14.16.d:
यत्र सिद्धिं गता राजन्वालखिल्या महर्षयः..
तैस्तत्र निर्मितं कुण्डं सुरम्यं गिरि गह्वरे .. 2 ..
14.16.m: where the Vālakhilyas, the great seers, attained perfection, O king. / By them a delightful pool was made there in a mountain cavern.

14.16.s:
teṣāṃ tatropaviṣṭānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..
mahāścaryamabhūttatra tattvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa .. 3 ..
14.16.d:
तेषां तत्रोपविष्टानां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ..
महाश्चर्यमभूत्तत्र तत्त्वं शृणु नराधिप .. 3 ..
14.16.m: As those sages of purified minds sat there, / a great wonder occurred there; hear of it in truth, O ruler of men.

14.16.s:
kirātavanitā kācinnāmnā ca maṇikarṇikā ..
atikṛṣṇā virūpākṣī karālā bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ .. 4 ..
14.16.d:
किरातवनिता काचिन्नाम्ना च मणिकर्णिका ..
अतिकृष्णा विरूपाक्षी कराला भीषणाकृतिः .. 4 ..
14.16.m: A certain Kirāta woman named Maṇikarṇikā, / extremely dark, with distorted eyes, dread, and of terrifying form,

14.16.s:
tṛṣārttā tatra saṃprāptā madhyaṃdinagate ravau ..
graste ca rāhuṇā sūrye praviṣṭā salile tu sā .. 5 ..
14.16.d:
तृषार्त्ता तत्र संप्राप्ता मध्यंदिनगते रवौ ..
ग्रस्ते च राहुणा सूर्ये प्रविष्टा सलिले तु सा .. 5 ..
14.16.m: arrived there tormented by thirst when the sun was at midday; / and when the sun was seized by Rāhu, she entered the water.

14.16.s:
etasminneva kāle tu divyarūpavapurdharā ..
munīnāṃ paśyatāṃ caiva viniṣkrāṃtā sumadhyamā .. 6 ..
14.16.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु दिव्यरूपवपुर्धरा ..
मुनीनां पश्यतां चैव विनिष्क्रांता सुमध्यमा .. 6 ..
14.16.m: At that very time, having assumed a heavenly form and body, / that slender-waisted woman came out even as the sages watched.

14.16.s:
atha tasyāḥ patiḥ prāptastadanveṣaṇatatparaḥ ..
papraccha tāṃ varārohāṃ patnyā duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ .. 7 ..
14.16.d:
अथ तस्याः पतिः प्राप्तस्तदन्वेषणतत्परः ..
पप्रच्छ तां वरारोहां पत्न्या दुःखेन दुःखितः .. 7 ..
14.16.m: Then her husband arrived, intent on searching for her. / Grieved with sorrow for his wife, he asked that fair-hipped woman:

14.16.s:
mama bhāryātra saṃprāptā yadi dṛṣṭā sumadhyame ..
śīghraṃ vada varārohe bālako'yaṃ tadudbhavaḥ .. 8 ..
14.16.d:
मम भार्यात्र संप्राप्ता यदि दृष्टा सुमध्यमे ..
शीघ्रं वद वरारोहे बालकोऽयं तदुद्भवः .. 8 ..
14.16.m: 'My wife arrived here; if she has been seen, O slender-waisted one, / speak quickly, O fair-hipped woman; this child born of her

14.16.s:
tṛṣārttaśca kṣudhāviṣṭo rudate ca muhurmuhuḥ ..
dṛṣṭā cetkathyatāṃ subhrūrvinā'yaṃ tāṃ mariṣyati .. 9 ..
14.16.d:
तृषार्त्तश्च क्षुधाविष्टो रुदते च मुहुर्मुहुः ..
दृष्टा चेत्कथ्यतां सुभ्रूर्विनाऽयं तां मरिष्यति .. 9 ..
14.16.m: is afflicted by thirst, seized by hunger, and weeps again and again. / If she was seen, let it be told, O fair-browed one; without her he will die.'

14.16.s:
.. stryuvāca .. ..
sā'haṃ te dayitā kānta tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ ..
divyarūpamidaṃ prāptā devairapi sudurlabham .. 7.3.16.10 ..
14.16.d:
.. स्त्र्युवाच .. ..
साऽहं ते दयिता कान्त तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः ..
दिव्यरूपमिदं प्राप्ता देवैरपि सुदुर्लभम् .. 7.3.16.10 ..
14.16.m: The woman said: / 'I am that beloved of yours, dear husband! By the power of this sacred ford / I have attained this heavenly form, very difficult even for gods to attain.

14.16.s:
tvaṃ cāpi salile hyasminkuru snānaṃ tvarānvitaḥ ..
prāpsyasi tvaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ yathā prāptaṃ mayā'nagha .. 11 ..
14.16.d:
त्वं चापि सलिले ह्यस्मिन्कुरु स्नानं त्वरान्वितः ..
प्राप्स्यसि त्वं परं रूपं यथा प्राप्तं मयाऽनघ .. 11 ..
14.16.m: And you too perform ritual ablution quickly in this water; / you will obtain a supreme form, just as has been obtained by me, O sinless one.'

14.16.s:
athāsau saha putreṇa praviṣṭastatra nirjhare ..
vimukte bhāskare rājanvirūpaścābhavatpunaḥ .. 12 ..
14.16.d:
अथासौ सह पुत्रेण प्रविष्टस्तत्र निर्झरे ..
विमुक्ते भास्करे राजन्विरूपश्चाभवत्पुनः .. 12 ..
14.16.m: Then he, together with his son, entered into that mountain stream; / [but] when the sun was released, O king, he became deformed once more.

14.16.s:
duḥkhena mṛtyumāpannastasminneva jalāśaye ..
atha sā bhartṛśokācca maraṇe kṛtaniścayā .. 13 ..
14.16.d:
दुःखेन मृत्युमापन्नस्तस्मिन्नेव जलाशये ..
अथ सा भर्तृशोकाच्च मरणे कृतनिश्चया .. 13 ..
14.16.m: Through misery he met his death in that very pool of water. / Then she, out of grief for her husband, resolved upon death.

14.16.s:
citiṃ kṛtvā samaṃ tena jvālayāmāsa pāvakam ..
atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā tathāśīlāṃ śubhāṃganām .. 14 ..
14.16.d:
चितिं कृत्वा समं तेन ज्वालयामास पावकम् ..
अथ ते मुनयो दृष्ट्वा तथाशीलां शुभांगनाम् .. 14 ..
14.16.m: Having prepared a funeral pyre, she kindled the fire together with him. / Then those sages, having seen that noble woman of such virtuous conduct,

14.16.s:
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭāstāmūcurvismayānvitāḥ ..
sarve tasyāśca saṃdṛṣṭvā sāhasaṃ ca nṛpottama .. 15 ..
14.16.d:
कृपया परयाविष्टास्तामूचुर्विस्मयान्विताः ..
सर्वे तस्याश्च संदृष्ट्वा साहसं च नृपोत्तम .. 15 ..
14.16.m: overcome with supreme compassion and filled with amazement, / having seen all of her boldness, [spoke to her], O best of kings.

14.16.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
divyarūpaṃ tvayā prāptaṃ devairapi sudurlabham ..
kasmādenaṃ supāpmānamanugacchasi bhāmini .. 16 ..
14.16.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
दिव्यरूपं त्वया प्राप्तं देवैरपि सुदुर्लभम् ..
कस्मादेनं सुपाप्मानमनुगच्छसि भामिनि .. 16 ..
14.16.m: The seers said: / 'A heavenly form, very difficult even for gods to attain, has been attained by you. / Why do you follow after this very sinful man, O lovely lady?'

14.16.s:
.. stryuvāca .. ..
pativratāhaṃ viprendrāḥ sadā bhartṛparāyaṇā ..
kiṃ rūpeṇa kariṣyāmi vinā patyā nijena ca .. 17 ..
14.16.d:
.. स्त्र्युवाच .. ..
पतिव्रताहं विप्रेन्द्राः सदा भर्तृपरायणा ..
किं रूपेण करिष्यामि विना पत्या निजेन च .. 17 ..
14.16.m: The woman said: / 'I am a devoted wife, O best of the twice-born, always dedicated to my husband. / What will I do with beauty without my own husband?

14.16.s:
virūpo vā surūpo vā daridro vā dhanādhipaḥ ..
strīṇāmekaḥ patirbharttā gatirnānyā jagattraye .. 18 ..
14.16.d:
विरूपो वा सुरूपो वा दरिद्रो वा धनाधिपः ..
स्त्रीणामेकः पतिर्भर्त्ता गतिर्नान्या जगत्त्रये .. 18 ..
14.16.m: Deformed or handsome, poor or wealthy, / for women their husband alone is their maintainer; there is no other refuge in the three worlds.

14.16.s:
bālako'yaṃ muniśreṣṭhā bhavaccharaṇamāgataḥ ..
ahaṃ kāntena saṃyuktā praviśāmi hutāśanam .. 19 ..
14.16.d:
बालकोऽयं मुनिश्रेष्ठा भवच्छरणमागतः ..
अहं कान्तेन संयुक्ता प्रविशामि हुताशनम् .. 19 ..
14.16.m: This young boy, O best of sages, has come to you for refuge. / United with my beloved, I shall enter the sacrificial fire.'

14.16.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
atha te munayaḥ sarve jñātvā tasyāḥ suniścayam ..
kṛpayā parayāviṣṭāḥ saṃvīkṣya ca parasparam .. 7.3.16.20 ..
14.16.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अथ ते मुनयः सर्वे ज्ञात्वा तस्याः सुनिश्चयम् ..
कृपया परयाविष्टाः संवीक्ष्य च परस्परम् .. 7.3.16.20 ..
14.16.m: Pulastya said: / Then all those sages, knowing her firm resolve, / overcome with supreme compassion, and looking at one another—

14.16.s:
tato jīvāpayāmāsustatpatiṃ te munīśvarāḥ ..
sadrūpeṇa samāyuktaṃ divya lakṣaṇalakṣitam .. 21 ..
14.16.d:
ततो जीवापयामासुस्तत्पतिं ते मुनीश्वराः ..
सद्रूपेण समायुक्तं दिव्य लक्षणलक्षितम् .. 21 ..
14.16.m: Then those lords among sages brought her husband back to life, / endowed with a handsome form and marked by divine characteristics.

14.16.s:
etasminneva kālaṃ tu vimānaṃ manasepsitam ..
devakanyāsamākīrṇaṃ sadyastatra samāgatam .. 22 ..
14.16.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव कालं तु विमानं मनसेप्सितम् ..
देवकन्यासमाकीर्णं सद्यस्तत्र समागतम् .. 22 ..
14.16.m: At that very moment, an aerial chariot conforming to the heart's desire, / filled with celestial maidens, immediately arrived there.

14.16.s:
atha tau daṃpatī teṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām ..
purataḥ praṇipatyātha prasthitau tridivaṃ prati .. 23 ..
14.16.d:
अथ तौ दंपती तेषां मुनीनां भावितात्मनाम् ..
पुरतः प्रणिपत्याथ प्रस्थितौ त्रिदिवं प्रति .. 23 ..
14.16.m: Then, having bowed before those sages of purified minds, / the husband and wife set out towards heaven.

14.16.s:
atha tairmunibhiḥ proktā sā nārī maṇikarṇikā ..
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi sarve tuṣṭā vayaṃ tava .. 24 ..
14.16.d:
अथ तैर्मुनिभिः प्रोक्ता सा नारी मणिकर्णिका ..
वरं वरय कल्याणि सर्वे तुष्टा वयं तव .. 24 ..
14.16.m: Then that woman Maṇikarṇikā was addressed by those sages: / 'Choose a boon, auspicious lady; we are all pleased with you.

14.16.s:
pativratatvena tuṣṭāḥ satyena ca viśeṣataḥ ..
nāsmākaṃ darśanaṃ vyarthaṃ jāyate ca kathaṃcana .. 25 ..
14.16.d:
पतिव्रतत्वेन तुष्टाः सत्येन च विशेषतः ..
नास्माकं दर्शनं व्यर्थं जायते च कथंचन .. 25 ..
14.16.m: Pleased with your devotion to your husband, and especially with your truthfulness; / our darśana never becomes fruitless in any way.'

14.16.s:
.. maṇikarṇikovāca .. ..
yadi māṃ munayastuṣṭāḥ prayacchatha varaṃ mudā ..
yadatrāsti mahāliṃgaṃ mannāmnā tadbhaviṣyati .. 26 ..
14.16.d:
.. मणिकर्णिकोवाच .. ..
यदि मां मुनयस्तुष्टाः प्रयच्छथ वरं मुदा ..
यदत्रास्ति महालिंगं मन्नाम्ना तद्भविष्यति .. 26 ..
14.16.m: Maṇikarṇikā said: / 'If you sages are pleased and gladly grant me a boon, / may the great liṅga that is here become known by my name.

14.16.s:
etadeva mamābhīṣṭaṃ nānyadasti prayojanam..
sarveṣāṃ ca prasādena svargaṃ gacchāmi sāṃpratam .. 27 ..
14.16.d:
एतदेव ममाभीष्टं नान्यदस्ति प्रयोजनम्..
सर्वेषां च प्रसादेन स्वर्गं गच्छामि सांप्रतम् .. 27 ..
14.16.m: This alone is my desire; I have no other purpose. / By the grace of you all, I now go to heaven.'

14.16.s:
.. ṛṣaya ūcuḥ .. ..
evaṃ bhavatu te khyātistīrthaliṃge varānane ..
tava nāmānvitaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ vai maṇikarṇikā .. 28 ..
14.16.d:
.. ऋषय ऊचुः .. ..
एवं भवतु ते ख्यातिस्तीर्थलिंगे वरानने ..
तव नामान्वितं जातं तीर्थं वै मणिकर्णिका .. 28 ..
14.16.m: The seers said: / 'Let your renown be so in this sacred ford and liṅga, O fair-faced lady! / This sacred ford has indeed become known by your name, Maṇikarṇikā.'

14.16.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
bhartrā saha divaṃ prāptā putreṇaiva samanvitā ..
vālakhilyāstaponiṣṭhā viśeṣāttatra saṃsthitāḥ .. 29 ..
14.16.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
भर्त्रा सह दिवं प्राप्ता पुत्रेणैव समन्विता ..
वालखिल्यास्तपोनिष्ठा विशेषात्तत्र संस्थिताः .. 29 ..
14.16.m: Pulastya said: / Together with her husband and accompanied by her son, she reached heaven. / The Vālakhilyas, steadfast in austerity, particularly remained there.

14.16.s:
tatra sūryagrahe prāpte snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
yaḥ karoti phalaṃ tasya kurukṣetra samaṃ bhavet .. 7.3.16.30 ..
14.16.d:
तत्र सूर्यग्रहे प्राप्ते स्नानदानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
यः करोति फलं तस्य कुरुक्षेत्र समं भवेत् .. 7.3.16.30 ..
14.16.m: When a solar eclipse occurs there, whoever performs rites such as ritual ablution and gifts— / his reward becomes equal to that of Kurukṣetra.

14.16.s:
yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya snānaṃ tatra karoti yaḥ ..
taṃ taṃ prāpnoti rājendra samyagdhyānasamanvitaḥ .. 31 ..
14.16.d:
यं यं काममभिध्याय स्नानं तत्र करोति यः ..
तं तं प्राप्नोति राजेन्द्र सम्यग्ध्यानसमन्वितः .. 31 ..
14.16.m: Contemplating whatever desire a person performs ritual ablution there, / he attains that very [desire], O best of kings, being endowed with proper meditation.

14.16.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
tīrthe dānaṃ yathāśaktyā devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam .. 32 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe maṇikarṇikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 16 .. ..
14.16.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
तीर्थे दानं यथाशक्त्या देवर्षिपितृतर्पणम् .. 32 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे मणिकर्णिकेश्वरमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षोडशोऽध्यायः .. 16 .. ..
14.16.m:
Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there, / give gifts at the sacred ford according to one's means, and offer libations to the gods, seers, and ancestors.
Thus ends the sixteenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Maṇikarṇikeśvara,' in the third Arbuda Section of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

14.17.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
paṃgu tīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapātakanāśanam ..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ paṃgunā brāhmaṇena ca .. 1 ..
14.17.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
पंगु तीर्थं ततो गच्छेत्सर्वपातकनाशनम् ..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं पंगुना ब्राह्मणेन च .. 1 ..
14.17.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to the Paṅgutīrtha, which destroys all sins, / where formerly austerity was performed by the lame brahmin.

14.17.s:
paṃgunāmā dvijaḥ pūrvaṃ cyavanasyānvaye'bhavat ..
aśaktaścalituṃ bhūmau paṃgubhāvānnṛpottama .. 2 ..
14.17.d:
पंगुनामा द्विजः पूर्वं च्यवनस्यान्वयेऽभवत् ..
अशक्तश्चलितुं भूमौ पंगुभावान्नृपोत्तम .. 2 ..
14.17.m: Formerly, a twice-born named Paṅgu was born in the lineage of Cyavana; / he was unable to walk on the ground due to his lameness, O best of kings.

14.17.s:
gṛhakṛtyaniyukto'sāvekadā bāndhavairnṛpa ..
paṃgurgaṃtuṃ na śakto'sau paraṃ duḥkhamavāptavān .. 3 ..
14.17.d:
गृहकृत्यनियुक्तोऽसावेकदा बान्धवैर्नृप ..
पंगुर्गंतुं न शक्तोऽसौ परं दुःखमवाप्तवान् .. 3 ..
14.17.m: Once assigned to household chores by his relatives, O king, / that lame man, unable to walk, attained supreme grief.

14.17.s:
athāsau taiḥ parityakto gatvārbudamathācalam ..
ekaṃ saraḥ samāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam .. 4 ..
14.17.d:
अथासौ तैः परित्यक्तो गत्वार्बुदमथाचलम् ..
एकं सरः समासाद्य तपस्तेपे सुदारुणम् .. 4 ..
14.17.m: Then, abandoned by them, having gone to Mount Arbuda / and reached a lake, he performed severe austerity.

14.17.s:
liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya tatraiva pūjayāmāsa taṃ vibhum ..
gandhapuṣpādinaivedyaiḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ .. 5 ..
14.17.d:
लिंगं संस्थाप्य तत्रैव पूजयामास तं विभुम् ..
गन्धपुष्पादिनैवेद्यैः सम्यक्छ्रद्धासमन्वितः .. 5 ..
14.17.m: Having installed a liṅga right there, he worshipped that all-pervading Lord / with fragrances, flowers, food offerings, and the like, endowed with complete faith.

14.17.s:
śivabhaktiparo jāto vāyubhakṣo babhūva ha ..
japahomarato nityaṃ paṃgunāmā dvijottamaḥ .. 6 ..
14.17.d:
शिवभक्तिपरो जातो वायुभक्षो बभूव ह ..
जपहोमरतो नित्यं पंगुनामा द्विजोत्तमः .. 6 ..
14.17.m: He became devoted to the worship of Śiva and lived on air alone; / that best of the twice-born named Paṅgu was constantly devoted to recitation and oblations.

14.17.s:
tatastuṣṭo mahādevo brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpasattama ..
paṃguṃ prati mahārāja vākyametaduvāca ha .. 7 ..
14.17.d:
ततस्तुष्टो महादेवो ब्राह्मणं नृपसत्तम ..
पंगुं प्रति महाराज वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 7 ..
14.17.m: Then Mahādeva, pleased with the brahmin, O best of kings, / spoke this word to Paṅgu, O great king:

14.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
paṃgo tuṣṭo mahādevo varaṃ varaya suvrata ..
tava dāsyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 8 ..
14.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
पंगो तुष्टो महादेवो वरं वरय सुव्रत ..
तव दास्याम्यहं सर्वं यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 8 ..
14.17.m: Īśvara said: / 'O Paṅgu, Mahādeva is pleased; choose a boon, O you of noble vows! / I will grant you everything, even if it should be exceedingly difficult to obtain.'

14.17.s:
.. paṃguruvāca .. ..
nāmnā me khyātimāyātu tīrthametatsureśvara ..
paṃgubhāvo'tra me yātu prasādāttava śaṃkara .. 9 ..
14.17.d:
.. पंगुरुवाच .. ..
नाम्ना मे ख्यातिमायातु तीर्थमेतत्सुरेश्वर ..
पंगुभावोऽत्र मे यातु प्रसादात्तव शंकर .. 9 ..
14.17.m: Paṅgu said: / 'O Lord of gods, let this sacred ford become famous by my name. / Let my lameness depart here by your grace, O Śaṃkara!

14.17.s:
tavāstu satataṃ cātra sāṃnidhyaṃ saha bhāryayā ..
evamuktaḥ sa tenātha vipraṃ prati vacobravīt .. 7.3.17.10 ..
14.17.d:
तवास्तु सततं चात्र सांनिध्यं सह भार्यया ..
एवमुक्तः स तेनाथ विप्रं प्रति वचोब्रवीत् .. 7.3.17.10 ..
14.17.m: And may your presence here be eternal, along with your wife.' / Being spoken to in this way by him, he then addressed these words to the brahmin:

14.17.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
nāmnā tava dvijaśreṣṭha tīrthametadbhaviṣyati ..
khyātiṃ tapaḥprabhāvena tīrthaṃ yāsyati sattama .. 11 ..
14.17.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
नाम्ना तव द्विजश्रेष्ठ तीर्थमेतद्भविष्यति ..
ख्यातिं तपःप्रभावेन तीर्थं यास्यति सत्तम .. 11 ..
14.17.m: Īśvara said: / 'O best of the twice-born, this sacred ford shall be named after you. / By the power of your austerity, O excellent one, the sacred ford shall attain renown.
Likewise, on the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra, my presence shall be [here].'

14.17.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
snānamātreṇa vipro'sau divyarūpamavāpa ha ..
tatra tasthau mahādevo gauryā saha maheśvaraḥ .. 13 ..
14.17.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
स्नानमात्रेण विप्रोऽसौ दिव्यरूपमवाप ह ..
तत्र तस्थौ महादेवो गौर्या सह महेश्वरः .. 13 ..
14.17.m: Pulastya said: / By mere ritual ablution, that brahmin attained a divine form; / Mahādeva, Maheśvara, remained there along with Gaurī.

14.17.s:
tasmindine nṛpaśreṣṭha snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
sa paṃgutvādvinirmukto divyarūpamavāpnuyāt .. 14 ..
14.17.d:
तस्मिन्दिने नृपश्रेष्ठ स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
स पंगुत्वाद्विनिर्मुक्तो दिव्यरूपमवाप्नुयात् .. 14 ..
14.17.m: On that day, O best of kings, one should perform ritual ablution there; / freed from lameness, he will obtain a divine form.

14.17.s: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe paṃgutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 17 ..
14.17.d: इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे पंगुतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम सप्तदशोऽध्यायः .. 17 ..
14.17.m: Thus ends the seventeenth chapter, named 'Description of the Glory of Paṅgutīrtha,' in the third Arbuda Section of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa containing eighty-one thousand verses.

14.18.s:
.. .. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha yamatīrthamanuttamam ..
mocakaṃ narakebhyaśca prāṇināṃ pāpanāśanam .. 1 ..
14.18.d:
.. .. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ यमतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
मोचकं नरकेभ्यश्च प्राणिनां पापनाशनम् .. 1 ..
14.18.m: Pulastya said: / Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Yamatīrtha, / which releases living beings from hells and destroys sin.

14.18.s:
purā citrāṃgado nāma rājā paramalobhavān ..
na tena sukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkṛtaṃ pārthivasattama .. 2 ..
14.18.d:
पुरा चित्रांगदो नाम राजा परमलोभवान् ..
न तेन सुकृतं किंचित्कृतं पार्थिवसत्तम .. 2 ..
14.18.m: Formerly, there was a king named Citrāṅgada who was exceedingly greedy; / not the least good deed was done by him, O best of rulers.

14.18.s:
atīva niṣṭhuro duṣṭo devabrāhmaṇapīḍakaḥ ..
paradāraharo nityaṃ paravittaharastathā .. 3 ..
14.18.d:
अतीव निष्ठुरो दुष्टो देवब्राह्मणपीडकः ..
परदारहरो नित्यं परवित्तहरस्तथा .. 3 ..
14.18.m: Exceedingly cruel and wicked, he tormented gods and brahmins; / he was constantly an abductor of others' wives as well as an embezzler of others' wealth.
Devoid of truthfulness and purity, he was full of deceit and malice; / once, addicted to hunting, he ascended Mount Arbuda.

14.18.s:
aṭanātsa pariśrāṃtaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamākulaḥ ..
tena tatra hradaḥ prāptaḥ svacchodakaprapūritaḥ .. 58 ..
padminībhiḥ samākīrṇo grāhanakrajhaṣākulaḥ ..
nānāpakṣisamāyukto manohārī suvistaraḥ .. 6 ..
tṛṣārtaḥ saṃpraviṣṭaḥ sa tasminneva jalāśaye ..
grāheṇa tatkṣaṇāddhṛtvā bhakṣito nṛpasattama .. 7 ..
tasyārthe narakā raudrā nirmitāśca yamena ca ..
yamadūtaistataḥ kṣiptaḥ sa nītvā pāpakṛttamaḥ .. 8 ..
tasya sparśena te sarve narakasthā sukhaṃ gatāḥ ..
te dūtā dharmarājāya vṛttāṃtaṃ narako dbhavam ..
ācakhyurvismayāviṣṭā narakasthānāṃ sukhodbhavam .. 9 ..
tadā vaivasvataḥ prāha bhūmāvastyarbudācalaḥ ..
tatra me'tipriyaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra taptaṃ mayā tapaḥ .. 7.3.18.10 ..
14.18.d:
अटनात्स परिश्रांतः क्षुत्पिपासासमाकुलः ..
तेन तत्र ह्रदः प्राप्तः स्वच्छोदकप्रपूरितः .. 58 ..
पद्मिनीभिः समाकीर्णो ग्राहनक्रझषाकुलः ..
नानापक्षिसमायुक्तो मनोहारी सुविस्तरः .. 6 ..
तृषार्तः संप्रविष्टः स तस्मिन्नेव जलाशये ..
ग्राहेण तत्क्षणाद्धृत्वा भक्षितो नृपसत्तम .. 7 ..
तस्यार्थे नरका रौद्रा निर्मिताश्च यमेन च ..
यमदूतैस्ततः क्षिप्तः स नीत्वा पापकृत्तमः .. 8 ..
तस्य स्पर्शेन ते सर्वे नरकस्था सुखं गताः ..
ते दूता धर्मराजाय वृत्तांतं नरको द्भवम् ..
आचख्युर्विस्मयाविष्टा नरकस्थानां सुखोद्भवम् .. 9 ..
तदा वैवस्वतः प्राह भूमावस्त्यर्बुदाचलः ..
तत्र मेऽतिप्रियं तीर्थं यत्र तप्तं मया तपः .. 7.3.18.10 ..
14.18.m:
Exhausted from wandering, agitated with hunger and thirst, / he found a lake there filled with clear water,
covered with lotuses, teeming with alligators, crocodiles, and fish, / filled with various birds, delightful, and very expansive.
Afflicted by thirst, he entered into that very body of water; / seized in an instant by an alligator, he was devoured, O best of kings.
Fierce hells had been prepared for him by Yama; / then, that greatest committer of sins was taken and thrown in by Yama's messengers.
By his touch, all those residing in hell attained happiness. / Filled with wonder, those messengers reported to Dharmarāja the event that had occurred in hell, / the arising of happiness for the hell-dwellers.
Then Vaivasvata said: 'On earth is Mount Arbuda; / there is my dearest sacred ford, where austerity was performed by me.

14.18.s:
tatrāsau mṛtyumāpanno bhātyadastviha kāraṇam ..
tairuktaṃ satyametaddhi mṛto'sāvarbudācale ..
grāheṇa sa dhṛtastatra mṛtyuṃ prāpto nṛpādhamaḥ ..11.. ..
.. yama uvāca .. ..
mucyatāmāśu tenāyaṃ nāneyāścāpare janāḥ ..
ye mṛtā mama tīrthe vai sarvapātakanāśane .. 12 ..
tatastaiḥ kiṃkarairmukto yamavākyānnṛpottama ..
triviṣṭapaṃ mudā prāptaḥ sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ.. 13 ..
yastu bhaktisamāyuktaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam .. 14 ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ yatra siddhiṃ gato yamaḥ .. 15 ..
tasminneva naraḥ samyakchrāddhakṛtyaṃ samācaret ..
ākalpaṃ pitarastasya svarge tiṣṭhaṃti pārthiva ..16..
14.18.d:
तत्रासौ मृत्युमापन्नो भात्यदस्त्विह कारणम् ..
तैरुक्तं सत्यमेतद्धि मृतोऽसावर्बुदाचले ..
ग्राहेण स धृतस्तत्र मृत्युं प्राप्तो नृपाधमः ..11.. ..
.. यम उवाच .. ..
मुच्यतामाशु तेनायं नानेयाश्चापरे जनाः ..
ये मृता मम तीर्थे वै सर्वपातकनाशने .. 12 ..
ततस्तैः किंकरैर्मुक्तो यमवाक्यान्नृपोत्तम ..
त्रिविष्टपं मुदा प्राप्तः सेव्यमानोऽप्सरोगणैः.. 13 ..
यस्तु भक्तिसमायुक्तः स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्जितम् .. 14 ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
चैत्रशुक्लत्रयोदश्यां यत्र सिद्धिं गतो यमः .. 15 ..
तस्मिन्नेव नरः सम्यक्छ्राद्धकृत्यं समाचरेत् ..
आकल्पं पितरस्तस्य स्वर्गे तिष्ठंति पार्थिव ..16..
14.18.m:
It appears that he met his death there; this indeed must be the reason.' / By them it was said: 'This is true; he died on Mount Arbuda. / Seized there by an alligator, that vilest of kings met his death.'
Yama said: / 'Quickly let him be released on account of that! And other people must not be brought [here] / who die at my sacred ford, which destroys all sins.'
Then, released by those attendants by Yama's command, O best of kings, / he joyfully reached heaven, attended by hosts of apsarases.
And whoever, endowed with devotion, performs ritual ablution there, / goes to the supreme abode, free from old age and death.
Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there / on the thirteenth day of the bright half of Caitra, where Yama attained perfection.
On that very day a person should properly perform the ancestral rites; / his ancestors remain in heaven until the end of an eon, O king.

14.18.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe yamatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 18 ..
14.18.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभास खंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे यमतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामाष्टादशोऽध्यायः .. 18 ..
14.18.m: Thus ends the eighteenth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Yamatīrtha,' in the Arbuda Section of the third Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.19.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam ..
vārāhasya hareriṣṭaṃ sadā vāsasukhapradam .. 1 ..
14.19.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं पापप्रणाशनम् ..
वाराहस्य हरेरिष्टं सदा वाससुखप्रदम् .. 1 ..
14.19.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to the sacred ford that destroys sin, / dear to Hari in his Boar incarnation, which ever grants the happiness of dwelling [near him].

14.19.s:
vārāheṇāvatāreṇa pṛthvī tatra samuddhṛtā ..
hariṇoktā sthirā tiṣṭha na bhetavyaṃ kadācana .. 2 ..
14.19.d:
वाराहेणावतारेण पृथ्वी तत्र समुद्धृता ..
हरिणोक्ता स्थिरा तिष्ठ न भेतव्यं कदाचन .. 2 ..
14.19.m: In his Boar incarnation, the Earth was lifted up there / and told by Hari: 'Remain firm; you must never fear.

14.19.s:
ahaṃ ceto gamiṣyāmi vaikuṇṭhe ca punaḥ śubhe ..
varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yadyadiṣṭaṃ sudurlabham .. 3 ..
14.19.d:
अहं चेतो गमिष्यामि वैकुण्ठे च पुनः शुभे ..
वरं वरय कल्याणि यद्यदिष्टं सुदुर्लभम् .. 3 ..
14.19.m: And I will go from here back to Vaikuṇṭha, O auspicious one. / Choose a boon, O blessed lady, whatever you desire, even if very hard to attain.'

14.19.s:
.. pṛthivyuvāca .. ..
yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādhara ..
anena vapuṣā tiṣṭha hyasmiṃstīrthe sadā hare .. 4 ..
14.19.d:
.. पृथिव्युवाच .. ..
यदि देयो वरो मह्यं शंखचक्रगदाधर ..
अनेन वपुषा तिष्ठ ह्यस्मिंस्तीर्थे सदा हरे .. 4 ..
14.19.m: The Earth said: / 'If a boon is to be given to me, O wielder of the conch, discus, and mace, / then remain forever in this sacred ford with this very form, O Hari.'

14.19.s:
.. hariruvāca .. ..
anena vapuṣā devi parvate'rbudasaṃjñake ..
ahaṃ sthāsyāmi te vākyātsadā loka hite rataḥ .. 5 ..
14.19.d:
.. हरिरुवाच .. ..
अनेन वपुषा देवि पर्वतेऽर्बुदसंज्ञके ..
अहं स्थास्यामि ते वाक्यात्सदा लोक हिते रतः .. 5 ..
14.19.m: Hari said: / 'With this form, O goddess, on the mountain named Arbuda, / I shall remain at your word, constantly delighting in the welfare of the world.

14.19.s:
mamāgre yo hradaḥ puṇyaḥ sunirmalajalānvitaḥ ..
māghamāse site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ .. 6 ..
14.19.d:
ममाग्रे यो ह्रदः पुण्यः सुनिर्मलजलान्वितः ..
माघमासे सिते पक्ष एकादश्यां समाहितः .. 6 ..
14.19.m: Before me is a holy pool filled with very clear water; / in the month of Māgha, in the bright fortnight, composed on the eleventh day,

14.19.s:
tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā mucyate brahmahatyayā ..
tatra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti manuṣyāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ .. 7 ..
14.19.d:
तत्र स्नात्वा नरो भक्त्या मुच्यते ब्रह्महत्यया ..
तत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति मनुष्याः श्रद्धयान्विताः .. 7 ..
14.19.m: having bathed there with devotion, a person is freed from the sin of killing a brahmin. / Men who are endowed with faith will perform ancestral rites there;

14.19.s:
pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ..
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret .. 8 ..
14.19.d:
पितॄणां जायते तृप्तिर्यावदाभूतसंप्लवम् ..
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् .. 8 ..
14.19.m: satisfaction arises for their ancestors until the dissolution of all beings. / Therefore, with every effort one should perform ritual ablution there.'

14.19.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
ityuktvāṃtardadhe rājangoviṃdo garuḍadhvajaḥ ..
tasmindine nṛpaśreṣṭha snātvā vrataṃ samācaret ..9..
14.19.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
इत्युक्त्वांतर्दधे राजन्गोविंदो गरुडध्वजः ..
तस्मिन्दिने नृपश्रेष्ठ स्नात्वा व्रतं समाचरेत् ..9..
14.19.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, O king, Govinda, who has Garuḍa on his banner, vanished. / On that day, O best of kings, having bathed, one should observe a vow.

14.19.s:
tarpaṇaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādbhaktitatparaḥ ..
sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ pūrvajaiḥ saha pārthiva .. 7.3.19.10 ..
14.19.d:
तर्पणं पिंडदानं च यः कुर्याद्भक्तितत्परः ..
स याति विष्णुसालोक्यं पूर्वजैः सह पार्थिव .. 7.3.19.10 ..
14.19.m: Whoever, intent on devotion, performs the water offering and the offering of rice-balls, / goes to the world of Viṣṇu along with his ancestors, O king.

14.19.s:
tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti gatvā brāhmaṇasattame ..
asmiṃstīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha godānaṃ ca karoti yaḥ .. 11 ..
14.19.d:
तत्र दानं प्रशंसंति गत्वा ब्राह्मणसत्तमे ..
अस्मिंस्तीर्थे नृपश्रेष्ठ गोदानं च करोति यः .. 11 ..
14.19.m: They praise giving gifts there after approaching the best of brahmins; / whoever performs the gift of a cow in this sacred ford, O best of kings,

14.19.s:
romasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ ..
tasmātsarvātmanā rājangodānaṃ ca samācaret .. 12 ..
14.19.d:
रोमसंख्यानि वर्षाणि स्वर्गे तिष्ठति मानवः ..
तस्मात्सर्वात्मना राजन्गोदानं च समाचरेत् .. 12 ..
14.19.m: that human dwells in heaven for as many years as the number of hairs [on the cow]. / Therefore, with all one's being, O king, one should perform the gift of a cow.

14.19.s:
ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa karttavyaṃ snānamuttamam ..
dānaṃ kuryādyathāśaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim .. 13 ..
14.19.d:
एकादश्यां विशेषेण कर्त्तव्यं स्नानमुत्तमम् ..
दानं कुर्याद्यथाशक्त्या स याति परमां गतिम् .. 13 ..
14.19.m: On the eleventh day, especially, an excellent ritual ablution must be performed; / one should give a gift according to one's ability, and one attains the supreme state.

14.19.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśodhyāyaḥ .. 19 ..
14.19.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे वाराहतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकोनविंशोध्यायः .. 19 ..
14.19.m: Thus ends the nineteenth chapter, titled 'The Description of the Māhātmya of Vārāhatīrtha,' in the Arbuda Section of the third Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the seventh part of the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.20.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gaccheta caṃdreśaṃ prabhāsaṃ nṛpasattama ..
prabhā tatra purā prāptā caṃdreṇa sumahātmanā .. 1 ..
14.20.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेत चंद्रेशं प्रभासं नृपसत्तम ..
प्रभा तत्र पुरा प्राप्ता चंद्रेण सुमहात्मना .. 1 ..
14.20.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to Candreśa at Prabhāsa; / there, in ancient times, splendor was regained by the high-souled Moon.

14.20.s:
dakṣasya kanyakā rājansaptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā ..
ūḍhāścaṃdreṇa tāḥ sarvā aśvinīpramukhāḥ purā .. 2 ..
14.20.d:
दक्षस्य कन्यका राजन्सप्तविंशतिसंख्यया ..
ऊढाश्चंद्रेण ताः सर्वा अश्विनीप्रमुखाः पुरा .. 2 ..
14.20.m: The daughters of Dakṣa, numbering twenty-seven, O king, / were all married in ancient times by the Moon, with Aśvinī at their head.

14.20.s:
tāsāṃ madhye ca rohiṇyā saha reme sa nityadā ..
tyaktāḥ sarvāśca caṃdreṇa dakṣakanyāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ..
gatvā svapitaraṃ natvā prāhurasrāvilekṣaṇāḥ .. 3 ..
14.20.d:
तासां मध्ये च रोहिण्या सह रेमे स नित्यदा ..
त्यक्ताः सर्वाश्च चंद्रेण दक्षकन्याः सुदुःखिताः ..
गत्वा स्वपितरं नत्वा प्राहुरस्राविलेक्षणाः .. 3 ..
14.20.m: Among them, he always took pleasure with Rohiṇī. / Abandoned by the Moon, all the daughters of Dakṣa were exceedingly distressed; / having gone and bowed to their father, their eyes clouded with tears, they said:

14.20.s:
vayaṃ tyaktāḥ prajānātha nirdoṣāḥ patinā tataḥ ..
śaraṇaṃ tvāmanuprāptā duḥkhena mahatānvitāḥ .. 4 ..
14.20.d:
वयं त्यक्ताः प्रजानाथ निर्दोषाः पतिना ततः ..
शरणं त्वामनुप्राप्ता दुःखेन महतान्विताः .. 4 ..
14.20.m: 'We, innocent ones, have been abandoned by our husband, O lord of creatures; / therefore we have come to you for refuge, filled with great sorrow.

14.20.s:
gatirbhava suraśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ hitaṃ kuru ..
asmākamupadiśyainaṃ caṃdraṃ ca rohiṇīratam .. 5 ..
14.20.d:
गतिर्भव सुरश्रेष्ठ सर्वेषां त्वं हितं कुरु ..
अस्माकमुपदिश्यैनं चंद्रं च रोहिणीरतम् .. 5 ..
14.20.m: Be our refuge, O best among gods; do what is good for us all, / after instructing this Moon who is devoted solely to Rohiṇī.'

14.20.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
sa tāsāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gato yatra niśākaraḥ ..
abravīcca samaṃ paśya sarvāsu tanayāsu me .. 6 ..
14.20.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
स तासां वचनं श्रुत्वा गतो यत्र निशाकरः ..
अब्रवीच्च समं पश्य सर्वासु तनयासु मे .. 6 ..
14.20.m: Pulastya said: / Hearing their words, he went where the night-maker was / and said: 'Look with equality upon all my daughters.'

14.20.s:
atha vrīḍāsamāyuktaścaṃdrastaṃ pratyabhāṣata ..
tava vākyaṃ kariṣyāmi dakṣa gaccha namostu te .. 7 ..
14.20.d:
अथ व्रीडासमायुक्तश्चंद्रस्तं प्रत्यभाषत ..
तव वाक्यं करिष्यामि दक्ष गच्छ नमोस्तु ते .. 7 ..
14.20.m: Then, filled with shame, the Moon replied to him: / 'I shall follow your word, Dakṣa; go, obeisance to you.'

14.20.s:
gate dakṣe tato bhūyaścaṃdramā rohiṇīrataḥ ..
tyaktvā ca kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatisamudbhavāḥ .. 8 ..
14.20.d:
गते दक्षे ततो भूयश्चंद्रमा रोहिणीरतः ..
त्यक्त्वा च कन्यकाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिसमुद्भवाः .. 8 ..
14.20.m: When Dakṣa had gone, the Moon again took pleasure only with Rohiṇī, / having abandoned all the daughters born of the lord of creatures.

14.20.s:
atha gatvā punaḥ sarvā dakṣamūcuḥ suduḥkhitāḥ ..
na kṛtaṃ tava vākyaṃ vai caṃdreṇaiva durātmanā .. 9 ..
14.20.d:
अथ गत्वा पुनः सर्वा दक्षमूचुः सुदुःखिताः ..
न कृतं तव वाक्यं वै चंद्रेणैव दुरात्मना .. 9 ..
14.20.m: Then all of them, going once more, spoke to Dakṣa, deeply distressed: / 'Your word was indeed not kept by that vile-minded Moon.

14.20.s:
daurbhāgyaduḥkhasaṃtaptā mariṣyāma na saṃśayaḥ ..
anena jīvitenāpi maraṇaṃ niścayaṃ bhavet .. 7.3.20.10 ..
14.20.d:
दौर्भाग्यदुःखसंतप्ता मरिष्याम न संशयः ..
अनेन जीवितेनापि मरणं निश्चयं भवेत् .. 7.3.20.10 ..
14.20.m: Afflicted by the misery of misfortune in love, we shall die without a doubt; / with such a life, death would surely be better.'

14.20.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
atha roṣasamāyukto dakṣo gatvā'bravīdvidhum ..
mama vākyaṃ tvayā caṃdra yasmātpāpa kṛtaṃ na hi .. 11 ..
14.20.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
अथ रोषसमायुक्तो दक्षो गत्वाऽब्रवीद्विधुम् ..
मम वाक्यं त्वया चंद्र यस्मात्पाप कृतं न हि .. 11 ..
14.20.m: Pulastya said: / Then Dakṣa, filled with wrath, went and spoke to the Moon: / 'Because my word was not kept by you, O sinful Moon,

14.20.s:
kṣayameṣyasi tasmāttvaṃ yakṣmaṇā nāsti saṃśayaḥ..
evaṃ dattvā tataḥ śāpaṃ gato dakṣaḥ svamālayam .. 12 ..
14.20.d:
क्षयमेष्यसि तस्मात्त्वं यक्ष्मणा नास्ति संशयः..
एवं दत्त्वा ततः शापं गतो दक्षः स्वमालयम् .. 12 ..
14.20.m: therefore you shall fall into wasting from pulmonary consumption; there is no doubt.' / Having thus pronounced the curse, Dakṣa then returned to his own home.

14.20.s:
yakṣmaṇā vyāpitaścaṃdraḥ kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine ..
kṣīṇo dyutivihīnastu ciṃtayāmāsa caṃdramāḥ .. 13 ..
14.20.d:
यक्ष्मणा व्यापितश्चंद्रः क्षयं याति दिनेदिने ..
क्षीणो द्युतिविहीनस्तु चिंतयामास चंद्रमाः .. 13 ..
14.20.m: Pervaded by pulmonary consumption, the Moon waned day by day; / wasting away and devoid of splendor, the Moon reflected:

14.20.s:
ki karttavyaṃ mayā tatra hyasmiñchāpe sudāruṇe ..
atha kiṃ pūjayiṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śivam .. 14 ..
14.20.d:
कि कर्त्तव्यं मया तत्र ह्यस्मिञ्छापे सुदारुणे ..
अथ किं पूजयिष्यामि सर्वकामप्रदं शिवम् .. 14 ..
14.20.m: 'What should be done by me in this dreadful curse? / Shall I now worship Śiva, the granter of all desires?'

14.20.s:
sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā gatorbudamathācalam ..
tapastepe jitakrodho japahomaparāyaṇaḥ .. 15 ..
14.20.d:
स एवं निश्चयं कृत्वा गतोर्बुदमथाचलम् ..
तपस्तेपे जितक्रोधो जपहोमपरायणः .. 15 ..
14.20.m: Having made such a resolve, he then went to Mount Arbuda; / with anger conquered, intent on silent recitation and oblations, he performed austerity.

14.20.s:
tasmai tuṣṭo mahādevo varṣāṇāmayute gate ..
abravīdvarado'smīti tato'smai darśanaṃ dadau .. 16 ..
14.20.d:
तस्मै तुष्टो महादेवो वर्षाणामयुते गते ..
अब्रवीद्वरदोऽस्मीति ततोऽस्मै दर्शनं ददौ .. 16 ..
14.20.m: Mahādeva, pleased with him when ten thousand years had passed, / said, 'I am ready to grant a boon,' and then granted him a darśana.

14.20.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate ..
tava dāsyāmyahaṃ caṃdra yadyapi syātsudurllabham.. 17 ..
14.20.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते यत्ते मनसि वर्तते ..
तव दास्याम्यहं चंद्र यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम्.. 17 ..
14.20.m: Īśvara said: / 'Choose a boon, hail to you, whatever is in your mind; / I shall grant it to you, O Moon, even though it may be very difficult to attain.'

14.20.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca.. ..
vyādhikṣayaṃ suraśreṣṭha kuru me tripurāṃtaka ..
yakṣmaṇā vyāpito deho mamāyaṃ ca jagatpate .. 18 ..
14.20.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच.. ..
व्याधिक्षयं सुरश्रेष्ठ कुरु मे त्रिपुरांतक ..
यक्ष्मणा व्यापितो देहो ममायं च जगत्पते .. 18 ..
14.20.m: The Moon said: / 'Grant the destruction of my disease, O best of gods, O destroyer of Tripura! / For this body of mine is pervaded by pulmonary consumption, O lord of the world.'

14.20.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
dakṣaśāpena te caṃdra yakṣmā kāye vyavasthitaḥ ..
na śakto hyanyathā kartuṃ śāpastasya mahātmanaḥ ..19..
14.20.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
दक्षशापेन ते चंद्र यक्ष्मा काये व्यवस्थितः ..
न शक्तो ह्यन्यथा कर्तुं शापस्तस्य महात्मनः ..19..
14.20.m: Īśvara said: / 'Due to Dakṣa's curse, O Moon, pulmonary consumption has settled in your body; / indeed, the curse of that great-souled one cannot be made otherwise.

14.20.s:
tasmāttvaṃ tasya tāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakā mama vākyataḥ ..
niśākara samaṃ paśya tava vyādhirgamiṣyati .. 7.3.20.20 ..
14.20.d:
तस्मात्त्वं तस्य ताः सर्वाः कन्यका मम वाक्यतः ..
निशाकर समं पश्य तव व्याधिर्गमिष्यति .. 7.3.20.20 ..
14.20.m: Therefore, at my word, O night-maker, look with equality / upon all his daughters, and your disease shall depart.

14.20.s:
kṛṣṇe kṣayaśca te caṃdra śukle vṛddhirbhaviṣyati ..
varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te anyamiṣṭaṃ sudurllabham..21 ..
14.20.d:
कृष्णे क्षयश्च ते चंद्र शुक्ले वृद्धिर्भविष्यति ..
वरं वरय भद्रं ते अन्यमिष्टं सुदुर्ल्लभम्..21 ..
14.20.m: In the dark fortnight there will be your waning, O Moon, and in the bright fortnight your waxing. / Choose another boon, hail to you, whatever else you desire that is hard to attain.'

14.20.s:
.. caṃdra uvāca .. ..
caṃdragrahe naro yo'tra somavāre ca śaṃkara ..
bhaktyā snānaṃ karotyeva sa yātu paramāṃ gatim .. 22 ..
14.20.d:
.. चंद्र उवाच .. ..
चंद्रग्रहे नरो योऽत्र सोमवारे च शंकर ..
भक्त्या स्नानं करोत्येव स यातु परमां गतिम् .. 22 ..
14.20.m: Candra said: / Whichever man performs ritual ablution with devotion here during a lunar eclipse / and on a Monday, O Śaṃkara, may he go to the highest state.

14.20.s:
piṇḍadānena deveśa svargaṃ gacchaṃtu pūrvajāḥ ..
prasādāttava deveśa tīrthaṃ bhavatu muktidam .. 23 ..
14.20.d:
पिण्डदानेन देवेश स्वर्गं गच्छंतु पूर्वजाः ..
प्रसादात्तव देवेश तीर्थं भवतु मुक्तिदम् .. 23 ..
14.20.m: By offering rice balls, O Lord of gods, may his ancestors go to heaven. / By your grace, O Lord of gods, let this sacred ford grant liberation.

14.20.s:
.. īśvara uvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyaṃti naro'traiva vipāpmāno niśākara ..
yasmātprabhā tvayā prāptā tīrthe'sminvimalodake.. 24 ..
14.20.d:
.. ईश्वर उवाच .. ..
भविष्यंति नरोऽत्रैव विपाप्मानो निशाकर ..
यस्मात्प्रभा त्वया प्राप्ता तीर्थेऽस्मिन्विमलोदके.. 24 ..
14.20.m: Īśvara said: / Men shall indeed become freed from sin right here, O night-maker. / Because radiance was attained by you at this sacred ford of clear waters,

14.20.s:
prabhāsatīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati..
yatra somagrahe prāpte somavāre viśeṣataḥ .. 25 ..
14.20.d:
प्रभासतीर्थं विख्यातं तस्मादेतद्भविष्यति..
यत्र सोमग्रहे प्राप्ते सोमवारे विशेषतः .. 25 ..
14.20.m: therefore it will be celebrated as Prabhāsatīrtha. / Where, when a lunar eclipse occurs, especially on a Monday,

14.20.s:
kariṣyaṃti narāḥ snānaṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim ..
ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti piṃḍadānaṃ tathā narāḥ .. .. 26 ..
14.20.d:
करिष्यंति नराः स्नानं ते यास्यंति परां गतिम् ..
येऽत्र श्राद्धं करिष्यंति पिंडदानं तथा नराः .. .. 26 ..
14.20.m: men will perform ritual ablution, they shall go to the highest state. / The men who perform an ancestral rite here, and likewise offer rice balls,

14.20.s:
gayāśrāddhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ caṃdra bhaviṣyati ..
tathā dānaṃ prakartavyaṃ soma lokairgrahe tava .. 27 ..
14.20.d:
गयाश्राद्धसमं पुण्यं तेषां चंद्र भविष्यति ..
तथा दानं प्रकर्तव्यं सोम लोकैर्ग्रहे तव .. 27 ..
14.20.m: their merit, O Candra, will be equal to the ancestral rite at Gayā. / Likewise, gifts must be offered by people during your eclipse, O Soma.

14.20.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā virūpākṣastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
candro'pi bubhuje sarvāḥ patnīśca dakṣasaṃbhavāḥ .. 28 ..
iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe caṃdraprabhāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 20 .. ..
14.20.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा विरूपाक्षस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
चन्द्रोऽपि बुभुजे सर्वाः पत्नीश्च दक्षसंभवाः .. 28 ..
इति श्रीस्कान्दे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां सहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे चंद्रप्रभासतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम विंशोऽध्यायः .. 20 .. ..
14.20.m:
Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, the Odd-Eyed One vanished right there. / And Candra enjoyed all his wives born of Dakṣa.
Thus, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the third Arbudakhaṇḍa, the twentieth chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Candraprabhāsatīrtha."

14.21.s:
.. pulastya uvāca.. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha piṇḍodakamanuttamam ..
tīrthaṃ yatra tapastaptaṃ piṇḍodakadvijātinā .. 1 ..
14.21.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच.. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ पिण्डोदकमनुत्तमम् ..
तीर्थं यत्र तपस्तप्तं पिण्डोदकद्विजातिना .. 1 ..
14.21.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to Piṇḍodaka, an unsurpassed / sacred ford where austerity was performed by the twice-born Piṇḍodaka.

14.21.s:
purā piṇḍodakonāma brāhmaṇo'bhūnmahāmate ..
mandaprajño'lpamedhāvī sopādhyāyena pāṭhitaḥ .. 2 ..
14.21.d:
पुरा पिण्डोदकोनाम ब्राह्मणोऽभून्महामते ..
मन्दप्रज्ञोऽल्पमेधावी सोपाध्यायेन पाठितः .. 2 ..
14.21.m: Long ago, O wise one, there was a brahmin named Piṇḍodaka. / Dull-witted and of small intellect, he was instructed by a teacher,

14.21.s:
aśakto'dhyayanaṃ kartuṃ jāḍyabhāvānmahīpate ..
sa vairāgyaṃ paraṃ gatvā saṃprāpto girigahvare .. 3 ..
14.21.d:
अशक्तोऽध्ययनं कर्तुं जाड्यभावान्महीपते ..
स वैराग्यं परं गत्वा संप्राप्तो गिरिगह्वरे .. 3 ..
14.21.m: [yet] unable to study due to his sluggish state, O king. / Having reached supreme dispassion, he went into a mountain cave.

14.21.s:
etasminneva kāletu tatraiva ca sarasvatī..
vīṇāvinodasaṃyuktā vivikte tamupasthitā .. 4 ..
14.21.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव कालेतु तत्रैव च सरस्वती..
वीणाविनोदसंयुक्ता विविक्ते तमुपस्थिता .. 4 ..
14.21.m: At that very time, Sarasvatī, / engaged in delighting with her vīṇā, approached him in that solitary place.

14.21.s:
taṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ khinnaṃ vairāgyeṇa samanvitam ..
kṛpāviṣṭā mahādevī vākyametaduvāca ha .. 5 ..
14.21.d:
तं दृष्ट्वा ब्राह्मणं खिन्नं वैराग्येण समन्वितम् ..
कृपाविष्टा महादेवी वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह .. 5 ..
14.21.m: Seeing that brahmin despondent and filled with dispassion, / the great goddess, overcome with compassion, uttered these words:

14.21.s:
.. sarasvatyuvāca .. ..
kasmāttvaṃ khidyase vipra virakta iva bhāsase ..
kasmānna hṛṣyasi hṛdā kasmādatra tvamāgataḥ ..
vada śīghraṃ mahābhāga tavāṃtike vasāmyaham .. 6 ..
14.21.d:
.. सरस्वत्युवाच .. ..
कस्मात्त्वं खिद्यसे विप्र विरक्त इव भाससे ..
कस्मान्न हृष्यसि हृदा कस्मादत्र त्वमागतः ..
वद शीघ्रं महाभाग तवांतिके वसाम्यहम् .. 6 ..
14.21.m: Sarasvatī said: / Why are you grieving, O brahmin? You seem like one who has renounced. / Why are you not glad at heart? For what reason have you come here? / Speak quickly, O fortunate one; I dwell near you.

14.21.s:
.. piṇḍodaka uvāca .. ..
ahaṃ vairāgyamāpanna upādhyāyatiraskṛtaḥ ..
jñānahīno mahābhāge mṛtyuṃ vāṃchāmi sāṃpratam .. 7 ..
14.21.d:
.. पिण्डोदक उवाच .. ..
अहं वैराग्यमापन्न उपाध्यायतिरस्कृतः ..
ज्ञानहीनो महाभागे मृत्युं वांछामि सांप्रतम् .. 7 ..
14.21.m: Piṇḍodaka said: / Having met with dispassion, rebuked by my teacher, / [and] devoid of knowledge, O noble lady, I now desire death.

14.21.s:
na me sarasvatī devī jihvāgre parivartate ..
kāraṇaṃ nānyadastīha mṛtyormama varānane .. ..
dṛṣṭo'kasmāttvayā cāhaṃ tato yāsyāmi cānyataḥ ..
maraṇaṃ hi mama śreyo mūkabhāvānna jīvitam .. 9 ..
14.21.d:
न मे सरस्वती देवी जिह्वाग्रे परिवर्तते ..
कारणं नान्यदस्तीह मृत्योर्मम वरानने .. ..
दृष्टोऽकस्मात्त्वया चाहं ततो यास्यामि चान्यतः ..
मरणं हि मम श्रेयो मूकभावान्न जीवितम् .. 9 ..
14.21.m: Goddess Sarasvatī does not turn upon the tip of my tongue. / There is no other reason for my death, O fair-faced one. / And seen suddenly by you, I shall go elsewhere from here. / For death is better for me, not life in the condition of a mute.

14.21.s:
.. sarasvatyuvāca ... ..
ahaṃ sarasvatī devī sadāsminvaraparvate..
niśāsukhe trayodaśyāṃ karomi vasatiṃ dvija ..
tasmāttvaṃ prārthaya varaṃ yadabhīṣṭaṃ sudurlabham .. 7.3.21.10 ..
14.21.d:
.. सरस्वत्युवाच ... ..
अहं सरस्वती देवी सदास्मिन्वरपर्वते..
निशासुखे त्रयोदश्यां करोमि वसतिं द्विज ..
तस्मात्त्वं प्रार्थय वरं यदभीष्टं सुदुर्लभम् .. 7.3.21.10 ..
14.21.m: Sarasvatī said: / I am Goddess Sarasvatī. On this excellent mountain, / I always make my dwelling at nightfall on the thirteenth day [of the lunar fortnight], O twice-born. / Therefore, ask for a boon, whatever is desired and hard to obtain.

14.21.s:
.. piṇḍodaka uvāca .. ..
prasādāttava vai vāṇi sarvajñatvaṃ mamepsitam ..
etattīrthaṃ tu mannāmnā khyātiṃ yātu śucismite .. 11 ..
14.21.d:
.. पिण्डोदक उवाच .. ..
प्रसादात्तव वै वाणि सर्वज्ञत्वं ममेप्सितम् ..
एतत्तीर्थं तु मन्नाम्ना ख्यातिं यातु शुचिस्मिते .. 11 ..
14.21.m: Piṇḍodaka said: / By your grace, O Vāṇī, omniscience is desired by me, / and may this sacred ford attain renown through my name, O smiling one.

14.21.s:
.. sarasvatyuvāca .. ..
adyaprabhṛti sarvajño hyatra loke bhaviṣyasi ..
nāmnā tava tathā tīrthametatkhyātiṃ prayāsyati ..12..
14.21.d:
.. सरस्वत्युवाच .. ..
अद्यप्रभृति सर्वज्ञो ह्यत्र लोके भविष्यसि ..
नाम्ना तव तथा तीर्थमेतत्ख्यातिं प्रयास्यति ..12..
14.21.m: Sarasvatī said: / From this day onward you will be omniscient in this world, / and likewise this sacred ford will attain renown through your name.

14.21.s:
niśāmukhe trayodaśyāṃ yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati ..
bhaviṣyati sa sarvajño yadyapi syātsumandadhīḥ .. 13 ..
14.21.d:
निशामुखे त्रयोदश्यां योऽत्र स्नानं करिष्यति ..
भविष्यति स सर्वज्ञो यद्यपि स्यात्सुमन्दधीः .. 13 ..
14.21.m: Whoever performs ritual ablution here at nightfall on the thirteenth day, / he will become omniscient even if he were very dull-minded.

14.21.s:
atra me satataṃ vāso bhaviṣyati dvijottama ..
yasmāttasmātsadā snānaṃ kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ .. 14 ..
14.21.d:
अत्र मे सततं वासो भविष्यति द्विजोत्तम ..
यस्मात्तस्मात्सदा स्नानं कर्तव्यं सुसमाहितैः .. 14 ..
14.21.m: My perpetual dwelling will be here, O best of the twice-born. / Therefore, ritual ablution should always be performed [here] by the self-composed.

14.21.s:
evamuktvā tato devī tatraivāṃtaradhīyata ..
piṇḍodako hi sarvajño bhūtvātha svagṛhaṃ yayau ..
vyasmāpayajjanānsarvāṃstattīrthasya samāśrayāt .. 15 ..
14.21.d:
एवमुक्त्वा ततो देवी तत्रैवांतरधीयत ..
पिण्डोदको हि सर्वज्ञो भूत्वाथ स्वगृहं ययौ ..
व्यस्मापयज्जनान्सर्वांस्तत्तीर्थस्य समाश्रयात् .. 15 ..
14.21.m: Having spoken thus, the goddess then vanished right there. / Piṇḍodaka, having indeed become omniscient, then went to his home / and amazed all the people by taking refuge in that sacred ford.

14.21.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe piṇḍodakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 21 ..
14.21.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीति साहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे पिण्डोदकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनामैकविंशोऽध्यायः .. 21 ..
14.21.m: Thus, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, in the collection of eighty-one thousand [verses], in the seventh Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the third Arbudakhaṇḍa, the twenty-first chapter, named "Description of the Greatness of Piṇḍodakatīrtha."

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha śrīmātāṃ devavaṃditām ..
sarvakāmapradāṃ nṛṇāmihaloke paratra ca ..1..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ श्रीमातां देववंदिताम् ..
सर्वकामप्रदां नृणामिहलोके परत्र च ..1..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, to Śrīmātā, praised by the gods, / who grants all desires to mortals in this world and in the hereafter.

14.22.s:
yā ca sarvamayī śaktiryayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat ..
sā tasminparvate sākṣātsvayaṃ vāsamarocayat ..2..
14.22.d:
या च सर्वमयी शक्तिर्यया व्याप्तमिदं जगत् ..
सा तस्मिन्पर्वते साक्षात्स्वयं वासमरोचयत् ..2..
14.22.m: And she who is the all-pervading Śakti, by whom this universe is pervaded, / she herself chose to dwell visibly upon that mountain.

14.22.s:
purā devayuge rājā kaliṃgonāma dānavaḥ ..
jarāmaraṇahīnosau devānāṃ ca bhayaṃkaraḥ..3..
14.22.d:
पुरा देवयुगे राजा कलिंगोनाम दानवः ..
जरामरणहीनोसौ देवानां च भयंकरः..3..
14.22.m: Long ago, in the age of the gods, there was a dānava king named Kaliṅga. / He was free from old age and death, and terrifying to the gods.

14.22.s:
tena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram..
balaprabhāvataḥ svargo jitastena surādhipaḥ ..
brahmalokamanuprāpto devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..4..
14.22.d:
तेन सर्वमिदं व्याप्तं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम्..
बलप्रभावतः स्वर्गो जितस्तेन सुराधिपः ..
ब्रह्मलोकमनुप्राप्तो देवैः सर्वैः समन्वितः ..4..
14.22.m: All this world of the three realms, with moving and unmoving beings, was pervaded by him. / By his strength and might, heaven was conquered by him, and the sovereign of the gods, / together with all the gods, reached Brahmaloka.

14.22.s:
tena daityena sarve'pi trāsitāḥ suramānavāḥ ..
kaliṃgonāma daityaḥ sa svayamindro babhūva ha .. 5 ..
14.22.d:
तेन दैत्येन सर्वेऽपि त्रासिताः सुरमानवाः ..
कलिंगोनाम दैत्यः स स्वयमिन्द्रो बभूव ह .. 5 ..
14.22.m: All gods and men were terrified by that Daitya. / That Daitya named Kaliṅga himself became Indra.

14.22.s:
vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ surarṣayaḥ ..
tena sarve kṛtā daityā yathāyogyaṃ narādhipa .. 6 ..
14.22.d:
वसवो मरुतः साध्या विश्वेदेवाः सुरर्षयः ..
तेन सर्वे कृता दैत्या यथायोग्यं नराधिप .. 6 ..
14.22.m: The Vasus, Maruts, Sādhyas, Viśvedevas, and divine seers— / all were appointed as Daityas by him according to their proper stations, O lord of men.

14.22.s:
yajñabhāgānsvayaṃ sarve bubhujuste ca dānavāḥ ..
tapo'rthe ca tato devā gatāḥ sarve'rbudācalam .. 7 ..
14.22.d:
यज्ञभागान्स्वयं सर्वे बुभुजुस्ते च दानवाः ..
तपोऽर्थे च ततो देवा गताः सर्वेऽर्बुदाचलम् .. 7 ..
14.22.m: Those dānavas themselves consumed all the sacrificial shares. / And then, for the sake of austerity, all the gods went to Mount Arbuda.

14.22.s:
adyāpi devatākhātaṃ trailokye khyātimāgatam ..
tatra vrataparāḥ sarve patramūlaphalāśinaḥ .. 8 ..
14.22.d:
अद्यापि देवताखातं त्रैलोक्ये ख्यातिमागतम् ..
तत्र व्रतपराः सर्वे पत्रमूलफलाशिनः .. 8 ..
14.22.m: Even today Devatākhāta has attained renown in the three worlds. / There, all were devoted to vows, eating leaves, roots, and fruits.

14.22.s:
avyaktāḥ paramatrāsāddhyāyaṃtaste ca saṃsthitāḥ ..
paṃcāgnisādhakāḥ kecittatra vrataparāyaṇāḥ .. 9 ..
14.22.d:
अव्यक्ताः परमत्रासाद्ध्यायंतस्ते च संस्थिताः ..
पंचाग्निसाधकाः केचित्तत्र व्रतपरायणाः .. 9 ..
14.22.m: Hidden, out of extreme fear, they remained meditating. / Some were practitioners of the five fires, devoted to their vows there.

14.22.s:
ekāhārā nirāhārā vāyubhakṣāstathā pare ..
anye māsopavāsāśca cāndrāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ .. 7.3.22.10 ..
14.22.d:
एकाहारा निराहारा वायुभक्षास्तथा परे ..
अन्ये मासोपवासाश्च चान्द्रायणपरायणाः .. 7.3.22.10 ..
14.22.m: Others took food once a day, fasted completely, or subsisted on air; / others fasted for a month, devoted to the cāndrāyaṇa vow.

14.22.s:
kṛcchrasāṃtapane niṣṭhā mahāpārākiṇaḥ pare ..
aṃbubhakṣā vāyubhakṣāḥ phenapāścoṣmapāḥ pare .. 11 ..
14.22.d:
कृच्छ्रसांतपने निष्ठा महापाराकिणः परे ..
अंबुभक्षा वायुभक्षाः फेनपाश्चोष्मपाः परे .. 11 ..
14.22.m: Others were steadfast in the kṛcchra and sāṃtapana [penances], or performers of the great parāka vow; / some drank water, some subsisted on air, some drank foam, and others drank steam.

14.22.s:
japahomaparāścānye dhyānāsaktāstathā pare ..
balinaivadyadānaiśca gaṃdhadhūpairnarādhipa .. 12 ..
14.22.d:
जपहोमपराश्चान्ये ध्यानासक्तास्तथा परे ..
बलिनैवद्यदानैश्च गंधधूपैर्नराधिप .. 12 ..
14.22.m: Others were devoted to recitation and oblations, and others intent on meditation, / with offerings of food, oblations, perfumes, and incenses, O lord of men,

14.22.s:
pūjayaṃtaḥ parāṃ śaktiṃ devīṃ svakāryahetave ..
evaṃ teṣāṃ vratasthānāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām ..
vimuktirabhavadrājansarveṣāṃ karmabandhanāt .. 13 ..
14.22.d:
पूजयंतः परां शक्तिं देवीं स्वकार्यहेतवे ..
एवं तेषां व्रतस्थानां तपसा भावितात्मनाम् ..
