विमुक्तिरभवद्राजन्सर्वेषां कर्मबन्धनात् .. 13 ..
14.22.m: worshipping the supreme Śakti, the Goddess, for the sake of their purpose. / Thus, for those established in vows, whose souls were purified through austerity, / there came release, O king, from the bondage of karma for all of them.

14.22.s:
tataḥ pūrṇe sahasrāṃte varṣāṇāṃ nṛpasattama..
devī pratyakṣatāṃ prāptā kanyakārūpadhāriṇī.. 14..
14.22.d:
ततः पूर्णे सहस्रांते वर्षाणां नृपसत्तम..
देवी प्रत्यक्षतां प्राप्ता कन्यकारूपधारिणी.. 14..
14.22.m: Then, at the end of a full thousand years, O best of kings, / the goddess became visible, bearing the form of a young maiden.

14.22.s:
pūrvaṃ jātā mahārāja dhūmamūrtirbhayāvahā..
tato jvālā tataḥ kanyā śuklavāso'nulepanā..
dṛṣṭvā tāṃ tuṣṭuvurdevāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāstataḥ.. 15..
14.22.d:
पूर्वं जाता महाराज धूममूर्तिर्भयावहा..
ततो ज्वाला ततः कन्या शुक्लवासोऽनुलेपना..
दृष्ट्वा तां तुष्टुवुर्देवाः कृतांजलिपुटास्ततः.. 15..
14.22.m: First arose a terrifying form of smoke, O great king, / then a flame, and then a maiden clothed and anointed in white. / Seeing her, the gods then praised her with palms joined in reverence: 15

14.22.s:
namo'stu sarvage devi namaste sarvapūjite..
kāmage'cintye namaste tridaśāśraye .. 16 ..
14.22.d:
नमोऽस्तु सर्वगे देवि नमस्ते सर्वपूजिते..
कामगेऽचिन्त्ये नमस्ते त्रिदशाश्रये .. 16 ..
14.22.m: “Homage be to you, O all-pervading Goddess! Homage to you who are worshipped by all! / Homage to you who go wherever you wish, who are beyond thought, O refuge of the thirty [gods]! 16

14.22.s:
namaste paramādevi brahmayone namonamaḥ ..
ardhamātrekṣare caiva tasyārdhārdhe namonamaḥ .. 17 ..
14.22.d:
नमस्ते परमादेवि ब्रह्मयोने नमोनमः ..
अर्धमात्रेक्षरे चैव तस्यार्धार्धे नमोनमः .. 17 ..
14.22.m: Homage to you, supreme Goddess! Homage, homage to the source of Brahmā! / Homage, homage to the half-mora in the syllable [Oṃ], and to its very half! 17

14.22.s:
namaste padmapatrākṣi viśvamātarnamonamaḥ ..
namaste varade devi rajaḥsattvatamomayi .. 18 ..
14.22.d:
नमस्ते पद्मपत्राक्षि विश्वमातर्नमोनमः ..
नमस्ते वरदे देवि रजःसत्त्वतमोमयि .. 18 ..
14.22.m: Homage to you whose eyes are lotus petals! Homage, homage to the Mother of the universe! / Homage to you who grant boons, O Goddess, composed of rajas, sattva, and tamas! 18

14.22.s:
svasvarūpasthite devi tvaṃ ca saṃsāralakṣaṇam ..
tvaṃ buddhistvaṃ dhṛtiḥ kṣāṃtistvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā kṣamā .. 19 ..
14.22.d:
स्वस्वरूपस्थिते देवि त्वं च संसारलक्षणम् ..
त्वं बुद्धिस्त्वं धृतिः क्षांतिस्त्वं स्वाहा त्वं स्वधा क्षमा .. 19 ..
14.22.m: O Goddess established in your own essential nature, you are the mark of worldly existence. / You are intellect, you are resolve, patience; you are svāhā, you are svadhā, forgiveness. 19

14.22.s:
tvaṃ vṛddhistvaṃ gatiḥ kartrī śacī lakṣmīśca pārvatī ..
sāvitrī tvaṃ ca gāyatrī ajeyā pāpanāśinī ..7.3.22.20..
14.22.d:
त्वं वृद्धिस्त्वं गतिः कर्त्री शची लक्ष्मीश्च पार्वती ..
सावित्री त्वं च गायत्री अजेया पापनाशिनी ..7.3.22.20..
14.22.m: You are prosperity, you are the path, the creator, Śacī, Lakṣmī, and Pārvatī. / You are Sāvitrī, and Gāyatrī, the invincible destroyer of sin. 20

14.22.s:
yaccānyadatra deveśi trailokye'stītisaṃjñitam ..
tadrūpaṃ tāvakaṃ devi parvateṣu ca saṃsthitam .. 21 ..
14.22.d:
यच्चान्यदत्र देवेशि त्रैलोक्येऽस्तीतिसंज्ञितम् ..
तद्रूपं तावकं देवि पर्वतेषु च संस्थितम् .. 21 ..
14.22.m: Whatever else here in the three worlds is designated as ‘existent,’ / that is your form, O Goddess, and [you are] abiding in the mountains. 21

14.22.s:
vahninā ca yathā kāṣṭhaṃ taṃtunā ca yathā paṭaḥ ..
tathā tvayā jagadvyāptaṃ guptā tvaṃ sarvataḥ sthitā .. 22 ..
14.22.d:
वह्निना च यथा काष्ठं तंतुना च यथा पटः ..
तथा त्वया जगद्व्याप्तं गुप्ता त्वं सर्वतः स्थिता .. 22 ..
14.22.m: Just as wood is pervaded by fire and cloth by thread, / so is the world pervaded by you; concealed, you abide everywhere.” 22

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ stutā jaganmātā tānuvāca surottamān ..
varo me yācyatāṃ śīghramabhīṣṭaḥ surasattamāḥ .. 23 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवं स्तुता जगन्माता तानुवाच सुरोत्तमान् ..
वरो मे याच्यतां शीघ्रमभीष्टः सुरसत्तमाः .. 23 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Praised in this manner, the Mother of the universe said to those foremost of the gods: / “Quickly ask of me the boon you desire, O best of the gods! 23

14.22.s:
kimatra guptabhāvena tiṣṭhatha śvabhramadhyagāḥ ..
madbhaktānāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti trailokyepi carācare .. 24 .. ..
14.22.d:
किमत्र गुप्तभावेन तिष्ठथ श्वभ्रमध्यगाः ..
मद्भक्तानां भयं नास्ति त्रैलोक्येपि चराचरे .. 24 .. ..
14.22.m: Why do you remain here in hiding, dwelling inside a pit? / My devotees have no fear, even in the three worlds of moving and unmoving beings.” 24

14.22.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ ..
kaliṃgena vayaṃ devi nirastāḥ saṃgare muhuḥ ..
tena vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram .. 25 ..
14.22.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः ..
कलिंगेन वयं देवि निरस्ताः संगरे मुहुः ..
तेन व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं त्रैलोक्यं सचराचरम् .. 25 ..
14.22.m: The gods said: / “O Goddess, we have been repeatedly repulsed in battle by the Kaliṅga [demon]; / by him all this threefold world, moving and unmoving, has been pervaded. 25

14.22.s:
yajñabhāgo hṛto'smākaṃ daityānāṃ sa prakalpitaḥ ..
tena svargaḥ samākrāntaḥ surāḥ sarve nirākṛtāḥ .. 26 ..
14.22.d:
यज्ञभागो हृतोऽस्माकं दैत्यानां स प्रकल्पितः ..
तेन स्वर्गः समाक्रान्तः सुराः सर्वे निराकृताः .. 26 ..
14.22.m: Our sacrificial share has been seized and allotted to the Daityas. / By him heaven has been overrun, and all the gods driven away. 26

14.22.s:
hatvā daityānyathā bhūyaḥ śakraḥ svapadamāpnuyāt ..
tathā kuru mahābhāge vara eṣo'smadīpsitaḥ .. 27 ..
14.22.d:
हत्वा दैत्यान्यथा भूयः शक्रः स्वपदमाप्नुयात् ..
तथा कुरु महाभागे वर एषोऽस्मदीप्सितः .. 27 ..
14.22.m: Act in such a way, O highly fortunate one, that Śakra may slay the Daityas and regain his abode; / this is the boon we desire.” 27

14.22.s:
.. devyuvāca .. ..
yathā yūyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭāstathaivāyaṃ mahāsuraḥ ..
viśeṣo nāsti me kaścidubhayoḥ surasattamāḥ .. 28 ..
14.22.d:
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
यथा यूयं मया सृष्टास्तथैवायं महासुरः ..
विशेषो नास्ति मे कश्चिदुभयोः सुरसत्तमाः .. 28 ..
14.22.m: The Goddess said: / “Just as you were created by me, even so was this great Asura; / I have no partiality between the two of you, O best of the gods. 28

14.22.s:
tasmāttānvārayiṣyāmi śakrādyāṃstridivātpunaḥ ..
evamuktvā varārohā preṣayāmāsa pārthiva .. 29 ..
14.22.d:
तस्मात्तान्वारयिष्यामि शक्राद्यांस्त्रिदिवात्पुनः ..
एवमुक्त्वा वरारोहा प्रेषयामास पार्थिव .. 29 ..
14.22.m: Therefore, I shall ward them off from heaven again, starting with Śakra.” / Having spoken thus, O king, she of fair hips dispatched 29

14.22.s:
dūtaṃ kaliṃgadaityāya tyaja tvaṃ tridivaṃ drutam ..
sa gatvā bāṣkaliṃ daityaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ vaco'bravīt .. 7.3.22.30 ..
14.22.d:
दूतं कलिंगदैत्याय त्यज त्वं त्रिदिवं द्रुतम् ..
स गत्वा बाष्कलिं दैत्यं सामपूर्वं वचोऽब्रवीत् .. 7.3.22.30 ..
14.22.m: a messenger to the Kaliṅga Daitya: “Leave heaven at once!” / He went and addressed concilatory words to the Daitya Bāṣkali: 30

14.22.s:
.. dūta uvāca .. ..
yā sā sarvagatā devī śaktirūpā śuci smitā ..
śrīmātā jagatāṃ mātā devairārādhitā parā ..
teṣāṃ tuṣṭā ca devī tvāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt .. 31 ..
14.22.d:
.. दूत उवाच .. ..
या सा सर्वगता देवी शक्तिरूपा शुचि स्मिता ..
श्रीमाता जगतां माता देवैराराधिता परा ..
तेषां तुष्टा च देवी त्वामिदं वचनमब्रवीत् .. 31 ..
14.22.m: The messenger said: / “That all-pervading Goddess who is the embodiment of Śakti, of pure smile, / Śrīmātā, the Mother of the worlds, the supreme one worshipped by the gods, / being pleased with them, has addressed this word to you: 31

14.22.s:
svasthānaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ śakro yātu triviṣṭapam ..
madvākyāddānavaśreṣṭha devatvaṃ na bhavettava .. 32 ..
14.22.d:
स्वस्थानं गच्छ शीघ्रं त्वं शक्रो यातु त्रिविष्टपम् ..
मद्वाक्याद्दानवश्रेष्ठ देवत्वं न भवेत्तव .. 32 ..
14.22.m: ‘Go swiftly to your own abode! Let Śakra go to heaven! / At my word, O foremost of Dānavas, godhead shall not belong to you.’” 32

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
sa dūtavacanaṃ śrutvā dānavo madagarvitaḥ .. 34 ..
ahaṃ lokeśvaro matvā sagarvamidamabravīt .. 33 ..
.. bāṣkaliruvāca .. ..
kā śrīmāteti ke devā nāsmātsvargaṃ tyajāmyaham ..
na tāṃ jānāmi tāṃścaiva gatvā brūhi mamājñayā .. 34 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
स दूतवचनं श्रुत्वा दानवो मदगर्वितः .. 34 ..
अहं लोकेश्वरो मत्वा सगर्वमिदमब्रवीत् .. 33 ..
.. बाष्कलिरुवाच .. ..
का श्रीमातेति के देवा नास्मात्स्वर्गं त्यजाम्यहम् ..
न तां जानामि तांश्चैव गत्वा ब्रूहि ममाज्ञया .. 34 ..
14.22.m:
Pulastya said: / Hearing the messenger's words, the Dānava, proud with insolence, 33
thinking, “I am the lord of the worlds,” spoke this with arrogance: 34
Bāṣkali said: / “Who is this Śrīmātā? Who are the gods? I will not abandon heaven for this! / I know neither her nor them; go and tell [her so] by my command! 34

14.22.s:
na bhavadbhyasvahaṃ svargaṃ prayacchāmi kathaṃcana ..
dūto'vadhyo bhavedrājñāmapi vaire sudāruṇe ..
etasmātkāraṇāddūta na tvāṃ prāṇairviyojaye .. 35 ..
14.22.d:
न भवद्भ्यस्वहं स्वर्गं प्रयच्छामि कथंचन ..
दूतोऽवध्यो भवेद्राज्ञामपि वैरे सुदारुणे ..
एतस्मात्कारणाद्दूत न त्वां प्राणैर्वियोजये .. 35 ..
14.22.m: I will by no means give up heaven to you. / A messenger must not be killed by kings, even in the fiercest enmity; / for this reason, O messenger, I do not deprive you of your life. 35

14.22.s:
śrīmātāṃ yadi me dūta darśayiṣyasi cettataḥ ..
abhīṣṭānsaṃpradāsyāmi satyameva bravīmyaham .. 36 ..
14.22.d:
श्रीमातां यदि मे दूत दर्शयिष्यसि चेत्ततः ..
अभीष्टान्संप्रदास्यामि सत्यमेव ब्रवीम्यहम् .. 36 ..
14.22.m: If, O messenger, you show me Śrīmātā, / then I will grant your desires; I speak only the truth! 36

14.22.s:
ahaṃ tvayā samaṃ tatra yāsye yatra sthitā ca sā ..
nigrahaṃ ca kariṣyāmi vākyaṃ me satyakāraṇam .. 37 ..
14.22.d:
अहं त्वया समं तत्र यास्ये यत्र स्थिता च सा ..
निग्रहं च करिष्यामि वाक्यं मे सत्यकारणम् .. 37 ..
14.22.m: I shall go along with you to where she is dwelling, / and I will subdue her; my word is the truth!” 37

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā madonmatto dūtena ca sa dānavaḥ ..
arbudaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ roṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 38 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा मदोन्मत्तो दूतेन च स दानवः ..
अर्बुदं प्रययौ तूर्णं रोषेण महता वृतः .. 38 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, maddened with insolence, that Dānava / set out quickly with the messenger for Arbuda, filled with great rage. 38

14.22.s:
dṛṣṭvā bāṣkalimāyāṃtaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ ..
vāryamāṇāstadā devyā palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ .. 39 ..
14.22.d:
दृष्ट्वा बाष्कलिमायांतं देवाः शक्रपुरोगमाः ..
वार्यमाणास्तदा देव्या पलायनपरायणाः .. 39 ..
14.22.m: Seeing Bāṣkali arriving, the gods led by Śakra, / though restrained then by the Goddess, were intent on flight. 39

14.22.s:
bhayena mahatāviṣṭā diśo bhejuḥ samaṃtataḥ ..
athāsau bāṣkaliḥ prāptaḥ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ .. 7.3.22.40 ..
14.22.d:
भयेन महताविष्टा दिशो भेजुः समंततः ..
अथासौ बाष्कलिः प्राप्तः सैन्येन महता वृतः .. 7.3.22.40 ..
14.22.m: Overcome by great fear, they fled in all directions. / Then that Bāṣkali arrived, surrounded by a mighty army, 40

14.22.s:
śrīmātā tiṣṭhate yatra parvaterbudasaṃjñake ..
dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa tamuvāca narādhipaḥ .. 41 ..
14.22.d:
श्रीमाता तिष्ठते यत्र पर्वतेर्बुदसंज्ञके ..
दूतं च प्रेषयामास तमुवाच नराधिपः .. 41 ..
14.22.m: at the mountain named Arbuda where Śrīmātā was staying. / And he dispatched a messenger, whom the ruler of men addressed: 41

14.22.s:
.. bāṣkaliruvāca .. ..
gaccha dūtavara brūhi śrīmātāṃ cāruhāsinīm..
bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi ahaṃ te vaśagaḥ sadā .. 42 ..
14.22.d:
.. बाष्कलिरुवाच .. ..
गच्छ दूतवर ब्रूहि श्रीमातां चारुहासिनीम्..
भार्या मे भव सुश्रोणि अहं ते वशगः सदा .. 42 ..
14.22.m: Bāṣkali said: / “Go, excellent messenger, speak to Śrīmātā of charming smile: / ‘Become my wife, O fair-hipped one! I shall always remain obedient to you. 42

14.22.s:
bhaviṣyati hi me rājyaṃ sarvaṃ vaśagataṃ tava ..
anyathā dharṣayiṣyāmi sarvaiḥ sārddhaṃ surottamaiḥ ..43..
14.22.d:
भविष्यति हि मे राज्यं सर्वं वशगतं तव ..
अन्यथा धर्षयिष्यामि सर्वैः सार्द्धं सुरोत्तमैः ..43..
14.22.m: Indeed, my entire kingdom shall be under your control. / Otherwise, I shall overpower you along with all the foremost gods! 43

14.22.s:
kimiṃdreṇālpavīryeṇa kimanyaiśca varānane ..
sahasrākṣo na me tulyo na me tulyāḥ surāsurāḥ .. 44 ..
14.22.d:
किमिंद्रेणाल्पवीर्येण किमन्यैश्च वरानने ..
सहस्राक्षो न मे तुल्यो न मे तुल्याः सुरासुराः .. 44 ..
14.22.m: What use is Indra of little prowess? What use are the others, O lovely-faced one? / The thousand-eyed [Indra] is not my equal, nor are the gods and Asuras equal to me!’” 44

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
etacchrutvā tato gatvā sa dūtaḥ saṃnyavedayat ..
tasya sarvaṃ yathāvākyaṃ tenoktaṃ ca mahīpate ..45..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एतच्छ्रुत्वा ततो गत्वा स दूतः संन्यवेदयत् ..
तस्य सर्वं यथावाक्यं तेनोक्तं च महीपते ..45..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Hearing this, the messenger then went and reported / everything to her exactly according to the words spoken by him, O lord of the earth. 45

14.22.s:
tataḥ śrutvā smitaṃ kṛtvā ciṃtayāmāsa bhāminī ..
jarā maraṇahīnoyaṃ daityendraḥ śaṃbhunā kṛtaḥ .. 46 ..
14.22.d:
ततः श्रुत्वा स्मितं कृत्वा चिंतयामास भामिनी ..
जरा मरणहीनोयं दैत्येन्द्रः शंभुना कृतः .. 46 ..
14.22.m: Then, having heard it and smiled, the passionate lady reflected: / “This lord of Daityas was made free from old age and death by Śambhu; 46

14.22.s:
kathamasya mayā kāryo nigraho devatākṛte ..
punaściṃtayate yāvatsā devī dānavaṃ prati ..
tāvattatrāgataḥ śīghraṃ sa kāmena pariplutaḥ .. 47 ..
14.22.d:
कथमस्य मया कार्यो निग्रहो देवताकृते ..
पुनश्चिंतयते यावत्सा देवी दानवं प्रति ..
तावत्तत्रागतः शीघ्रं स कामेन परिप्लुतः .. 47 ..
14.22.m: how is his subjugation to be accomplished by me for the sake of the gods?” / While the Goddess was thus pondering about the Dānava, / he swiftly arrived there, flooded with lust. 47

14.22.s:
atha dṛṣṭinipātena sā devī dānavādhipam ..
vyalokayattatastasyā niścayaḥ saṃbabhūva ha .. 48 ..
14.22.d:
अथ दृष्टिनिपातेन सा देवी दानवाधिपम् ..
व्यलोकयत्ततस्तस्या निश्चयः संबभूव ह .. 48 ..
14.22.m: Then, casting her gaze, the Goddess / looked upon the lord of Dānavas; thereupon her resolve was formed. 48

14.22.s:
tato jahāsa sā devīśanakairvṛpasattama ..
mukhāttasyāstataḥ sainyaṃ niṣkrāṃtamatibhīṣaṇam.. 49 ..
14.22.d:
ततो जहास सा देवीशनकैर्वृपसत्तम ..
मुखात्तस्यास्ततः सैन्यं निष्क्रांतमतिभीषणम्.. 49 ..
14.22.m: Then that Goddess laughed softly, O best of kings. / From her mouth then issued a most terrifying army: 49

14.22.s:
hastino hayavaryāśca pādātāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ ..
rathasāhasramārūḍhā yodhāścāpi sahasraśaḥ .. 7.3.22.50 ..
14.22.d:
हस्तिनो हयवर्याश्च पादाताश्च पृथग्विधाः ..
रथसाहस्रमारूढा योधाश्चापि सहस्रशः .. 7.3.22.50 ..
14.22.m: elephants, excellent horses, foot-soldiers of various kinds, / warriors mounted upon a thousand chariots, and thousands of others. 50

14.22.s:
taiḥ sainyaṃ dānaveśasya sarvaṃ śastrairnipātitam ..
paśyatastasya daityasya niścalasyāsurasya ca .. 51 ..
14.22.d:
तैः सैन्यं दानवेशस्य सर्वं शस्त्रैर्निपातितम् ..
पश्यतस्तस्य दैत्यस्य निश्चलस्यासुरस्य च .. 51 ..
14.22.m: By them the entire army of the lord of Dānavas was struck down with weapons, / while that Daitya, that Asura, looked on motionless. 51

14.22.s:
hate sainya bale tasminniṃdrādyāstridivaukasaḥ ..
tāmūcurvacanaṃ devi dānavaṃ hantumarhasi ..
nāsmiñjīvati no rājyaṃ svarge devi bhaviṣyati .. 52 ..
14.22.d:
हते सैन्य बले तस्मिन्निंद्राद्यास्त्रिदिवौकसः ..
तामूचुर्वचनं देवि दानवं हन्तुमर्हसि ..
नास्मिञ्जीवति नो राज्यं स्वर्गे देवि भविष्यति .. 52 ..
14.22.m: When that army and its force were slain, the dwellers of heaven led by Indra / addressed these words to her: “O Goddess, you should kill the Dānava! / While he lives, our sovereignty in heaven cannot be, O Goddess.” 52

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
śrutvā tadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ jñātvā taṃ mṛtyuvarjitam ..
parvatasya mahāśṛṃgaṃ dattvā tasyopari svayam .. 53 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
श्रुत्वा तद्वचनं तेषां ज्ञात्वा तं मृत्युवर्जितम् ..
पर्वतस्य महाशृंगं दत्त्वा तस्योपरि स्वयम् .. 53 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Hearing those words of theirs, knowing him to be free from death, / she placed a great peak of the mountain upon him herself… 53

14.22.s:
niviṣṭā sā jaganmātā śrīmātā kāmarūpiṇī ..
hitāya jagatāṃ rājannadyāpi varaparvate ..
tatraiva vasate sākṣānnṛṇāṃ kāmapradāyinī .. 54 ..
14.22.d:
निविष्टा सा जगन्माता श्रीमाता कामरूपिणी ..
हिताय जगतां राजन्नद्यापि वरपर्वते ..
तत्रैव वसते साक्षान्नृणां कामप्रदायिनी .. 54 ..
14.22.m: She, the Mother of the Universe, Śrīmātā, who assumes any form at will, seated herself [there]. / Even today, O king, for the welfare of the worlds, upon that excellent mountain, / right there she dwells visibly, granting all desires to mankind.

14.22.s:
etasminneva kāle tu sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ ..
tuṣṭuvustāṃ mahāśaktiṃ bhayahantrīṃ praharṣitāḥ .. 55 ..
14.22.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु सर्वे देवाः सवासवाः ..
तुष्टुवुस्तां महाशक्तिं भयहन्त्रीं प्रहर्षिताः .. 55 ..
14.22.m: At that very time, all the gods along with Indra, / highly delighted, praised that Great Power, the destroyer of fear.

14.22.s:
prasannā'bhūttato devī teṣāṃ tatra narādhipa ..
svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ surāḥ sarve pariyāṃtu gatavyathāḥ ..
gatvā sthānaṃ svakaṃ sarve paripāṃtu gatavyathāḥ .. 56 ..
14.22.d:
प्रसन्नाऽभूत्ततो देवी तेषां तत्र नराधिप ..
स्वंस्वं स्थानं सुराः सर्वे परियांतु गतव्यथाः ..
गत्वा स्थानं स्वकं सर्वे परिपांतु गतव्यथाः .. 56 ..
14.22.m: Then the goddess was pleased with them there, O king: / ‘Let all the gods depart to their respective abodes, free from sorrow; / having reached their own abode, let them all protect [the worlds], free from sorrow.

14.22.s:
varaṃ varaya devendra brūhi yatte manogatam ..
tatsarvaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi tuṣṭāhaṃ bhaktitastava .. 57 .. ..
14.22.d:
वरं वरय देवेन्द्र ब्रूहि यत्ते मनोगतम् ..
तत्सर्वं संप्रदास्यामि तुष्टाहं भक्तितस्तव .. 57 .. ..
14.22.m: Choose a boon, O lord of the gods; speak what is in your heart. / I shall grant all that to you; I am pleased with your devotion.’

14.22.s:
.. indra uvāca .. ..
yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi śāśvate bhaktivatsale ..
atraiva sthīyatāṃ tāvatsvarge yāvadahaṃ vibhuḥ .. 58 ..
14.22.d:
.. इन्द्र उवाच .. ..
यदि तुष्टासि मे देवि शाश्वते भक्तिवत्सले ..
अत्रैव स्थीयतां तावत्स्वर्गे यावदहं विभुः .. 58 ..
14.22.m: Indra said: / ‘If you are pleased with me, O eternal goddess, affectionate to your devotees, / please remain right here so long as I am the sovereign in heaven.

14.22.s:
praśāsmi rājyaṃ deveśi śāśvate bhaktavatsale ..
ajaraścāmaraścaiva yato daityaḥ sureśvari .. 59 ..
14.22.d:
प्रशास्मि राज्यं देवेशि शाश्वते भक्तवत्सले ..
अजरश्चामरश्चैव यतो दैत्यः सुरेश्वरि .. 59 ..
14.22.m: I rule the kingdom, O ruler of gods, O eternal one, affectionate to your devotees! / Since the demon is ageless and immortal, O sovereign of the gods,

14.22.s:
hareṇa nirmitaḥ pūrvaṃ yena tiṣṭhati niścalaḥ ..
prasādāttava lokāśca trayaḥ saṃtu nirāmayāḥ ..7.3.22.60..
14.22.d:
हरेण निर्मितः पूर्वं येन तिष्ठति निश्चलः ..
प्रसादात्तव लोकाश्च त्रयः संतु निरामयाः ..7.3.22.60..
14.22.m: having been created formerly by Hara, by which he remains motionless, / may the three worlds be free from affliction through your grace.

14.22.s:
atra tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve sametya ca ..
caitraśuklacaturddaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ yāṃtu sadgatim .. 61 ..
14.22.d:
अत्र त्वां पूजयिष्यामो वयं सर्वे समेत्य च ..
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यां दृष्ट्वा त्वां यांतु सद्गतिम् .. 61 ..
14.22.m: Here, all of us having assembled together, will worship you; / and having beheld you on the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, may people attain the supreme state.’

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaḥ ..
hṛṣṭastriviṣṭapaṃ prāpto devyāstasyāḥ prabhāvataḥ .. 62 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षः सर्वदेवैः समन्वितः ..
हृष्टस्त्रिविष्टपं प्राप्तो देव्यास्तस्याः प्रभावतः .. 62 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, the thousand-eyed [Indra], accompanied by all the gods, / attained heaven rejoicing, by the power of that goddess.

14.22.s: sāpi tatra sthitā devī devānāṃ hitakāmyayā .. ... 63 ..
14.22.d: सापि तत्र स्थिता देवी देवानां हितकाम्यया .. ... 63 ..
14.22.m: She too, the goddess, remained there wishing for the welfare of the gods.

14.22.s:
yastāṃ paśyati caitrasya caturddaśyāṃ site nṛpa ..
sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjjitam .. 64 ..
14.22.d:
यस्तां पश्यति चैत्रस्य चतुर्द्दश्यां सिते नृप ..
स याति परमं स्थानं जरामरणवर्ज्जितम् .. 64 ..
14.22.m: Whoever beholds her on the fourteenth day of the bright half of Caitra, O king, / goes to the supreme realm, free from old age and death.

14.22.s:
kiṃ vratairniyamairvāpi dānairdatte narādhipa ..
sarve taddarśanasyāpi kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm .. 65 ..
14.22.d:
किं व्रतैर्नियमैर्वापि दानैर्दत्ते नराधिप ..
सर्वे तद्दर्शनस्यापि कलां नार्हंति षोडशीम् .. 65 ..
14.22.m: What need of observances, or self-restraints, or given gifts, O lord of men? / All of them are not worth a sixteenth part of the darśana of her.

14.22.s:
tatraiva pāduke divye tayā nyaste narādhipa ..
yaste paśyati bhūyo'sau saṃsāraṃ na hi paśyati ..
sarvānkāmānavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca .. 66 ..
14.22.d:
तत्रैव पादुके दिव्ये तया न्यस्ते नराधिप ..
यस्ते पश्यति भूयोऽसौ संसारं न हि पश्यति ..
सर्वान्कामानवाप्नोति इह लोके परत्र च .. 66 ..
14.22.m: Right there her two divine sandals were deposited by her, O ruler of men; / whoever beholds those two does not see worldly existence again, / and attains all desires in this world and in the next.

14.22.s:
.. yayātiruvāca .. ..
kasminkāle dvijaśreṣṭha devyā mukte'tra pāduke ..
kasmācca kāraṇādbrūhi sarvaṃ vistarato mama .. 67 ..
14.22.d:
.. ययातिरुवाच .. ..
कस्मिन्काले द्विजश्रेष्ठ देव्या मुक्तेऽत्र पादुके ..
कस्माच्च कारणाद्ब्रूहि सर्वं विस्तरतो मम .. 67 ..
14.22.m: Yayāti said: / At what time, O best of the twice-born, were the two sandals left here by the goddess, / and for what reason? Tell me everything in full detail.

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tāṃ devīṃ mānavāḥ sarve saṃvīkṣya nṛpasattama ..
prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ dvividhāṃ dharmakāriṇaḥ .. 68 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तां देवीं मानवाः सर्वे संवीक्ष्य नृपसत्तम ..
प्राप्नुवंति परां सिद्धिं द्विविधां धर्मकारिणः .. 68 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / All mortal men, having gazed upon that goddess, O best of kings, / who practice righteousness, attain the two kinds of supreme perfection.

14.22.s:
etasminneva kāle tu yajñadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ ..
praṇaṣṭā bhūtale rājaṃstīrthayātrāvratodbhavāḥ .. 69 ..
14.22.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु यज्ञदानादिकाः क्रियाः ..
प्रणष्टा भूतले राजंस्तीर्थयात्राव्रतोद्भवाः .. 69 ..
14.22.m: At that very time, the rites consisting of sacrifices, gifts, and the like, / arising from pilgrimages to sacred fords and observances, perished on the surface of the earth, O king.

14.22.s:
śūnyāste narakāḥ sarve saṃbabhūvuryamasya ye ..
yajñabhāgavihīnāśca devāḥ kaṣṭamupāgatāḥ .. 7.3.22.70 ..
14.22.d:
शून्यास्ते नरकाः सर्वे संबभूवुर्यमस्य ये ..
यज्ञभागविहीनाश्च देवाः कष्टमुपागताः .. 7.3.22.70 ..
14.22.m: All those hells of Yama became empty, / and deprived of their sacrificial portions, the gods met with distress.

14.22.s:
atha sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha devāstatra samāgatāḥ ..
ūcurgatvā'rbudaṃ tatra śrīmātāṃ parame śvarīm.. 71 ..
14.22.d:
अथ सर्वे नृपश्रेष्ठ देवास्तत्र समागताः ..
ऊचुर्गत्वाऽर्बुदं तत्र श्रीमातां परमे श्वरीम्.. 71 ..
14.22.m: Then all the gods, O best of kings, assembled there, / and having gone to Arbuda, spoke there to the Supreme Sovereign, Śrīmātā:

14.22.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭāḥ sureśvari ..
martyaloke vayaṃ tena karmaṇātīva pīḍitāḥ .. 72 ..
14.22.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
अग्निष्टोमादिकाः सर्वाः क्रिया नष्टाः सुरेश्वरि ..
मर्त्यलोके वयं तेन कर्मणातीव पीडिताः .. 72 ..
14.22.m: The gods said: / ‘All rites such as the Agniṣṭoma have perished, O sovereign of the gods, / in the mortal world; therefore we are exceedingly tormented by this state of affairs.

14.22.s:
dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ devi pāpmānaḥ siddhiṃ yāṃti sapūrvajāḥ ..
tasmādyathā vayaṃ puṣṭiṃ vrajāmaste prasādataḥ .. 73 ..
14.22.d:
दृष्ट्वा त्वां देवि पाप्मानः सिद्धिं यांति सपूर्वजाः ..
तस्माद्यथा वयं पुष्टिं व्रजामस्ते प्रसादतः .. 73 ..
14.22.m: Having beheld you, O goddess, even sinful men attain perfection along with their ancestors. / Therefore, so act that we may attain nourishment through your grace,

14.22.s: na niṣkrāmati daityaśca bāṣkalistvaṃ tathā kuru .. 74 ..
14.22.d: न निष्क्रामति दैत्यश्च बाष्कलिस्त्वं तथा कुरु .. 74 ..
14.22.m: and the demon Bāṣkali may not emerge.’

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃciṃtya suciraṃ tadā ..
muktvā sve pāduke tatra kṛtvā cāśmasamudbhave ..
devānuvāca rājeṃdra sarvānarttimupāgatān .. 75 ..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा संचिंत्य सुचिरं तदा ..
मुक्त्वा स्वे पादुके तत्र कृत्वा चाश्मसमुद्भवे ..
देवानुवाच राजेंद्र सर्वानर्त्तिमुपागतान् .. 75 ..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Having heard their word, and having reflected for a long time then, / leaving her own two sandals there, having made them out of stone, / she spoke, O lord of kings, to the gods, all of whom had fallen into affliction.

14.22.s:
.. śrīdevyuvāca .. ..
yuṣmadvākyena tyakto hi mayā'yaṃ parvatottamaḥ ..
vinyaste pāduke tasya rakṣārthaṃ bāṣkaleḥ surāḥ .. 76 ..
14.22.d:
.. श्रीदेव्युवाच .. ..
युष्मद्वाक्येन त्यक्तो हि मयाऽयं पर्वतोत्तमः ..
विन्यस्ते पादुके तस्य रक्षार्थं बाष्कलेः सुराः .. 76 ..
14.22.m: The holy Goddess said: / ‘By your request, indeed, this best of mountains is abandoned by me; / the two sandals have been placed, O gods, to guard against that Bāṣkali.

14.22.s:
matpādukābharākrāṃto na sa daityaḥ surottamāḥ ..
sthānātpracalituṃ śaktaḥ staṃbhitaḥ syādyathā mayā .. 77 ..
14.22.d:
मत्पादुकाभराक्रांतो न स दैत्यः सुरोत्तमाः ..
स्थानात्प्रचलितुं शक्तः स्तंभितः स्याद्यथा मया .. 77 ..
14.22.m: Oppressed by the weight of my sandals, O best of gods, that demon / will not be able to stir from his place, just as he was paralyzed by me.

14.22.s:
etacchāstraṃ mayā kṛtsnaṃ pādukārthaṃ vinirmitam ..
adhyātmakaṃ hitārthāya prāṇināṃ pṛthivītale .. 78 ..
14.22.d:
एतच्छास्त्रं मया कृत्स्नं पादुकार्थं विनिर्मितम् ..
अध्यात्मकं हितार्थाय प्राणिनां पृथिवीतले .. 78 ..
14.22.m: This entire treatise has been composed by me concerning the sandals, / dealing with the Supreme Self, for the welfare of living beings on the surface of the earth.

14.22.s:
śāstramārgeṇa cānena bhaktyā yaḥ pāduke mama ..
pūjayiṣyati siddhiḥ syāttasya maddarśanodbhavā .. 79 ..
14.22.d:
शास्त्रमार्गेण चानेन भक्त्या यः पादुके मम ..
पूजयिष्यति सिद्धिः स्यात्तस्य मद्दर्शनोद्भवा .. 79 ..
14.22.m: And whoever with devotion worships my two sandals in accordance with the path of this scripture, / to him will belong the perfection arising from the darśana of me.

14.22.s:
caitraśuklacaturddaśyāmahamatrārbude sadā ..
ahorātre vasiṣyāmi suguptā girigahvare .. .. 7.3.22.80 ..
14.22.d:
चैत्रशुक्लचतुर्द्दश्यामहमत्रार्बुदे सदा ..
अहोरात्रे वसिष्यामि सुगुप्ता गिरिगह्वरे .. .. 7.3.22.80 ..
14.22.m: On the fourteenth day of the bright fortnight of Caitra, I shall always, here on Arbuda, / dwell for a day and night, well-hidden in a mountain cave.

14.22.s:
parvato'yaṃ mamābhīṣṭo na ca tyaktuṃ mano dadhe ..
tathāpi saṃparityakto yuṣmākaṃ hitakāmyayā .. 81 ..
14.22.d:
पर्वतोऽयं ममाभीष्टो न च त्यक्तुं मनो दधे ..
तथापि संपरित्यक्तो युष्माकं हितकाम्यया .. 81 ..
14.22.m: This mountain is dear to me, and my mind was not set on leaving it; / nevertheless, it has been completely abandoned by me out of a desire for your welfare.’

14.22.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā tu sā devī samaṃtāddevakiṃnaraiḥ ..
stūyamānā yayau svargaṃ muktvā te pāduke śubhe .. 82..
14.22.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा तु सा देवी समंताद्देवकिंनरैः ..
स्तूयमाना ययौ स्वर्गं मुक्त्वा ते पादुके शुभे .. 82..
14.22.m: Pulastya said: / Having spoken thus, that goddess, being praised on all sides / by gods and kiṃnaras, went to heaven, having left behind those two auspicious sandals.

14.22.s:
adyāpi siddhimāyāṃti yogino dhyānatatparāḥ ..
tanniṣṭhāstadgataprāṇā yathā devyāḥ pradarśanāt.. 83 ..
14.22.d:
अद्यापि सिद्धिमायांति योगिनो ध्यानतत्पराः ..
तन्निष्ठास्तद्गतप्राणा यथा देव्याः प्रदर्शनात्.. 83 ..
14.22.m: Even today yogins, intent on meditation, attain perfection, / steadfast in them, their vital breaths absorbed in them, just as from the sight of the goddess.

14.22.s:
etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tva paripṛcchasi ..
śrīmātāsaṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ pādukābhyāṃ ca bhūmipa ..84..
14.22.d:
एतत्ते सर्वमाख्यातं यन्मां त्व परिपृच्छसि ..
श्रीमातासंभवं पुण्यं पादुकाभ्यां च भूमिप ..84..
14.22.m: All this has been recounted to you which you ask of me, / the holy origin of Śrīmātā and of the two sandals, O protector of the earth.

14.22.s:
yastvetatpaṭhate bhaktyā ślāghate vā'tha yo naraḥ ..
sarvapāpairmahārāja mucyate jñānatatparaḥ .. 85 ..
iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śrīmātāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 22 ..
14.22.d:
यस्त्वेतत्पठते भक्त्या श्लाघते वाऽथ यो नरः ..
सर्वपापैर्महाराज मुच्यते ज्ञानतत्परः .. 85 ..
इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे श्रीमातामाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः .. 22 ..
14.22.m:
The man who recites this with devotion, or who praises it, / is freed from all sins, O great king, and becomes intent on knowledge.
Thus ends the twenty-second chapter, entitled ‘The Description of the Māhātmya of Śrīmātā’, in the Arbuda section, the third [part] of the seventh [book], the Prabhāsa section, in the holy Skanda Mahāpurāṇa consisting of eighty-one thousand verses.

14.23.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha śuklatīrthamanuttamam ..
yatkhyātimagamatpūrvaṃ sakāśāddāśavargataḥ .. 1 ..
14.23.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ शुक्लतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
यत्ख्यातिमगमत्पूर्वं सकाशाद्दाशवर्गतः .. 1 ..
14.23.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should proceed, O best of kings, to the unsurpassed Śuklatīrtha, / which formerly attained fame through the fishermen.

14.23.s:
purā''sīdrajako nāmnā śamilākṣo mahīpate ..
nīlīmadhye tu vastrāṇi prakṣiptāni mahīpate .. 2 ..
14.23.d:
पुरा'ऽसीद्रजको नाम्ना शमिलाक्षो महीपते ..
नीलीमध्ये तु वस्त्राणि प्रक्षिप्तानि महीपते .. 2 ..
14.23.m: Formerly, O ruler of the earth, there was a washerman named Śamilākṣa; / clothes were thrown into indigo dye by him, O lord of the earth.

14.23.s:
athāsau bhayamāpanno jñātvā vastraviḍaṃbanam..
deśāṃtaraṃ prasthito'sau svakuṭumbasamāvṛtaḥ .. 3 ..
14.23.d:
अथासौ भयमापन्नो ज्ञात्वा वस्त्रविडंबनम्..
देशांतरं प्रस्थितोऽसौ स्वकुटुम्बसमावृतः .. 3 ..
14.23.m: Then, overtaken by fear upon realizing the ruin of the clothes, / he set out for another land, surrounded by his family.

14.23.s:
atha tasya sutā rājandāśakanyāsakhī śubhā ..
duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭā dāśyaṃtikamupādravat .. 4 ..
14.23.d:
अथ तस्य सुता राजन्दाशकन्यासखी शुभा ..
दुःखेन महताविष्टा दाश्यंतिकमुपाद्रवत् .. 4 ..
14.23.m: Then his fair daughter, O king, a friend of a fisherman’s daughter, / seized with great sorrow, ran to the fisherman's daughter.

14.23.s:
tasyai nivedayāmāsa bhayaṃ vastrasamudbhavam ..
videśacalanaṃ caiva bāṣpagadgadayā girā .. 5 ..
14.23.d:
तस्यै निवेदयामास भयं वस्त्रसमुद्भवम् ..
विदेशचलनं चैव बाष्पगद्गदया गिरा .. 5 ..
14.23.m: She reported to her the fear arising from the clothes / and their departure for a foreign land, in a voice choked with tears.

14.23.s:
dāśakanyāpi duḥkhena tasyā duḥkhasamanvitā ..
abravīdvāṣsaṃklinnāṃ niśvasaṃtī muhurmuhuḥ .. 6 ..
14.23.d:
दाशकन्यापि दुःखेन तस्या दुःखसमन्विता ..
अब्रवीद्वाष्संक्लिन्नां निश्वसंती मुहुर्मुहुः .. 6 ..
14.23.m: The fisherman’s daughter also, distressed with grief on account of her sorrow, / sighed repeatedly and said to the girl who was wet with tears:

14.23.s:
.. dāśakanyovāca .. ..
astyupāyo mahānatra vidito mama śobhane ..
dhruvaṃ tena kṛtenaiva nirbhayaṃ te ca te pituḥ .. 7 ..
14.23.d:
.. दाशकन्योवाच .. ..
अस्त्युपायो महानत्र विदितो मम शोभने ..
ध्रुवं तेन कृतेनैव निर्भयं ते च ते पितुः .. 7 ..
14.23.m: The fisherman’s daughter said: / ‘There is a great means here known to me, O beautiful one; / surely, once that is performed, there will be fearlessness for you and for your father.’

14.23.s:
atrāsti nirjharaṃ subhrūrarbude varavarṇini ..
tatra me bhrātaraścaiva tathānye matsyajīvinaḥ .. 8 ..
14.23.d:
अत्रास्ति निर्झरं सुभ्रूरर्बुदे वरवर्णिनि ..
तत्र मे भ्रातरश्चैव तथान्ये मत्स्यजीविनः .. 8 ..
14.23.m: “Here on Arbuda, O fair-browed one, O woman of lovely complexion, there is a stream; / there my brothers and other fishermen [dwell]. 8

14.23.s:
yaccānyadapi tatraiva kṣipyate salile śubhe ..
tatsarvaṃ śuklatāmeti paśya me vapurīdṛśam .. 9 ..
14.23.d:
यच्चान्यदपि तत्रैव क्षिप्यते सलिले शुभे ..
तत्सर्वं शुक्लतामेति पश्य मे वपुरीदृशम् .. 9 ..
14.23.m: Whatever else is cast into that auspicious water, / all that turns white; behold my body, how it is like this! 9

14.23.s:
sarveṣāmeva dāśānāṃ tasya toyasya majjanāt ..
tāni vastrāṇi tatraiva tātastava sumadhyame ..
jale prakṣālayetkṣipraṃ prayāsyaṃti suśuklatām .. 7.3.23.10 ..
14.23.d:
सर्वेषामेव दाशानां तस्य तोयस्य मज्जनात् ..
तानि वस्त्राणि तत्रैव तातस्तव सुमध्यमे ..
जले प्रक्षालयेत्क्षिप्रं प्रयास्यंति सुशुक्लताम् .. 7.3.23.10 ..
14.23.m: Because of dipping into that water, all the fishermen [became white]. / O slender-waisted lady, let your father quickly wash those clothes / right there in that water; they will become exceedingly white. 10

14.23.s:
tvayā'tra na bhayaṃ kāryaṃ gatvā tātaṃ nivāraya ..
prasthitaṃ paradeśāya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā .. 11 ..
14.23.d:
त्वयाऽत्र न भयं कार्यं गत्वा तातं निवारय ..
प्रस्थितं परदेशाय नात्र कार्या विचारणा .. 11 ..
14.23.m: You need have no fear here; go and stop your father / who has set out for a foreign land; there should be no hesitation here.” 11

14.23.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
sā tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā gatvā sarvaṃ nyavedayat ..
janakāya sutā tūrṇaṃ tato'sau tuṣṭimāptavān.. 12 ..
14.23.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
सा तस्या वचनं श्रुत्वा गत्वा सर्वं न्यवेदयत् ..
जनकाय सुता तूर्णं ततोऽसौ तुष्टिमाप्तवान्.. 12 ..
14.23.m: Pulastya said: / Having heard her words, the daughter went quickly and reported everything / to her father; then he attained satisfaction. 12

14.23.s:
prātarutthāya tūrṇaṃ sa nirjharaṃ tamupādravat..
kṣiptamātrāṇi rājendra tāni vastrāṇi tena vai .. .. 13 ..
14.23.d:
प्रातरुत्थाय तूर्णं स निर्झरं तमुपाद्रवत्..
क्षिप्तमात्राणि राजेन्द्र तानि वस्त्राणि तेन वै .. .. 13 ..
14.23.m: Rising early in the morning, he ran quickly to that stream; / as soon as those clothes were cast into it by him, O best of kings, 13

14.23.s:
tasmiṃstoyetiśuklatvaṃ gatāni bahulāṃ tataḥ ..
kāṃtimāpuśca paramāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvāṃbarāṇi ca .. 14 ..
14.23.d:
तस्मिंस्तोयेतिशुक्लत्वं गतानि बहुलां ततः ..
कांतिमापुश्च परमां तथा दृष्ट्वांबराणि च .. 14 ..
14.23.m: they attained extreme whiteness in that water, and then / acquired great, supreme luster; and seeing the garments thus, 14

14.23.s:
athāsau vismayāviṣṭastāni cādāya satvaraḥ ..
rājñe nivedayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ ca tadudbhavam .. 15 ..
14.23.d:
अथासौ विस्मयाविष्टस्तानि चादाय सत्वरः ..
राज्ञे निवेदयामास वृत्तांतं च तदुद्भवम् .. 15 ..
14.23.m: then, overcome with amazement, he swiftly took them / and presented them to the king, along with the story of how it came about. 15

14.23.s:
tato vismayamāpannaḥ sa rājā tatra nirjhare ..
anyāni nīlīraktāni vastrāṇi cākṣipajjale .. 16 ..
14.23.d:
ततो विस्मयमापन्नः स राजा तत्र निर्झरे ..
अन्यानि नीलीरक्तानि वस्त्राणि चाक्षिपज्जले .. 16 ..
14.23.m: Then, filled with wonder, that king threw other clothes, / indigo and red, into the water of that stream. 16

14.23.s:
sarvāṇi śuklatāṃ yāṃti viśiṣṭāni bhavaṃti ca ..
jñātvā tataḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ snānaṃ cakre yathāvidhi .. 17 ..
14.23.d:
सर्वाणि शुक्लतां यांति विशिष्टानि भवंति च ..
ज्ञात्वा ततः परं तीर्थं स्नानं चक्रे यथाविधि .. 17 ..
14.23.m: They all turned white and became superior. / Recognizing it then as a supreme sacred ford, he performed ritual ablution according to rule. 17

14.23.s:
tyaktvā rājyaṃ sa tatraiva tapastepe mahīpatiḥ ..
tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptastīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 18 ..
14.23.d:
त्यक्त्वा राज्यं स तत्रैव तपस्तेपे महीपतिः ..
ततः सिद्धिं परां प्राप्तस्तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 18 ..
14.23.m: Abandoning his kingdom right there, the ruler of the earth performed austerity; / then, through the power of this sacred ford, he attained the supreme perfection. 18

14.23.s:
ekādaśyāṃ narastatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute nṛpa ..
sa kulāni samuddhṛtya daśa yāti divaṃ tataḥ ..
snānenava vipāpatvaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva jāyate .. 19 ..
14.23.d:
एकादश्यां नरस्तत्र यः श्राद्धं कुरुते नृप ..
स कुलानि समुद्धृत्य दश याति दिवं ततः ..
स्नानेनव विपापत्वं तत्क्षणादेव जायते .. 19 ..
14.23.m: O king, that man who performs a śrāddha there on the eleventh day, / having redeemed ten families, goes thence to heaven; / and by ritual ablution alone freedom from sin arises that very instant. 19

14.23.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 23 ..
14.23.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखंडे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे शुक्लतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः .. 23 ..
14.23.m: Thus ends the twenty-third chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Śuklatīrtha,' in the third section, Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 23

14.24.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha guhāmadhyanivāsinī ..
devī kātyāyanī yatra śuṃbhadānavanāśinī .. 1 ..
14.24.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ गुहामध्यनिवासिनी ..
देवी कात्यायनी यत्र शुंभदानवनाशिनी .. 1 ..
14.24.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go, O best of kings, where the goddess Kātyāyanī, / the destroyer of the dānava Śumbha, dwells within a cave. 1

14.24.s:
śuṃbhonāma mahādaityaḥ purā''sītpṛthivītale ..
tena sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ jitvā devānraṇājire .. 2 ..
14.24.d:
शुंभोनाम महादैत्यः पुरा'ऽसीत्पृथिवीतले ..
तेन सर्वं जगद्व्याप्तं जित्वा देवान्रणाजिरे .. 2 ..
14.24.m: Long ago on the surface of the earth there was a great daitya named Śumbha; / having defeated the gods on the field of battle, he encompassed the entire universe. 2

14.24.s:
sa śaṃkaravarāddaityo devadānavarakṣasām..
avadhyo yoṣitaṃ muktvā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi .. 3 ..
14.24.d:
स शंकरवराद्दैत्यो देवदानवरक्षसाम्..
अवध्यो योषितं मुक्त्वा सर्वेषां प्राणिनां भुवि .. 3 ..
14.24.m: By a boon from Śaṃkara, that daitya was invulnerable to gods, dānavas, / and rakṣasas, and to all living beings on earth, except a woman. 3

14.24.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve gatvā'rbudamathācalam ..
tapastepurvadhārthāya śuṃbhasya jagatīpate ..
devīmārādhayāmāsurvyaktarūpāṃ sureśvarīm .. 4 ..
14.24.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे गत्वाऽर्बुदमथाचलम् ..
तपस्तेपुर्वधार्थाय शुंभस्य जगतीपते ..
देवीमाराधयामासुर्व्यक्तरूपां सुरेश्वरीम् .. 4 ..
14.24.m: Then all the hosts of gods, having gone to Mount Arbuda, / performed austerity for the slaying of Śumbha, O lord of the earth; / they worshipped the goddess, the sovereign of the gods, in manifest form. 4

14.24.s:
atha teṣāṃ prasannā sā dṛṣṭigocaramāgatā ..
abravīdvaradāsmīti brūta kiṃ karavāṇi ca .. 5 ..
14.24.d:
अथ तेषां प्रसन्ना सा दृष्टिगोचरमागता ..
अब्रवीद्वरदास्मीति ब्रूत किं करवाणि च .. 5 ..
14.24.m: Then, pleased with them, she came within the range of their sight; / she said, “I grant boons; speak, what shall I do?” 5

14.24.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
sarvaṃ no'pahṛtaṃ devi śuṃbhena sudurātmanā ..
taṃ niṣūdaya kalyāṇi sovadhyonyaiḥ sadā raṇe .. 6 ..
14.24.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
सर्वं नोऽपहृतं देवि शुंभेन सुदुरात्मना ..
तं निषूदय कल्याणि सोवध्योन्यैः सदा रणे .. 6 ..
14.24.m: The gods said: / “O goddess, everything of ours has been seized by the very wicked Śumbha; / slay him, O auspicious one! He is always invulnerable to others in battle. 6

14.24.s:
tvayā saṃrakṣitā devi purā bāṣkalito vayam .. 7 ..
nānyā'smākaṃ gatirmātastvāṃ muktvā cāruhāsinīm ..
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktā surairdevī gatvā śuṃbhaniketanam..
ājuhāva raṇe kruddhā bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ .. 7 ..
14.24.d:
त्वया संरक्षिता देवि पुरा बाष्कलितो वयम् .. 7 ..
नान्याऽस्माकं गतिर्मातस्त्वां मुक्त्वा चारुहासिनीम् ..
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ता सुरैर्देवी गत्वा शुंभनिकेतनम्..
आजुहाव रणे क्रुद्धा भर्त्सयित्वा मुहुर्मुहुः .. 7 ..
14.24.m:
Formerly we were protected by you from Bāṣkali, O goddess. 7
We have no other refuge, O mother, except you of lovely smile.” / Pulastya said: / Thus addressed by the gods, the goddess went to Śumbha's abode; / enraged, she repeatedly scolded him and challenged him to battle. 8

14.24.s:
sa tayā yācite yuddhe jñātvā tāṃ yoṣitaṃ nṛpa ..
avajñāya tato daityaḥ preṣayāmāsa dānavān .. 9 ..
14.24.d:
स तया याचिते युद्धे ज्ञात्वा तां योषितं नृप ..
अवज्ञाय ततो दैत्यः प्रेषयामास दानवान् .. 9 ..
14.24.m: When battle was demanded by her, knowing her to be a woman, O king, / the daitya despised her and sent forth his dānavas: 9

14.24.s:
jīvagrāheṇa duṣṭeyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ paruṣasvanā ..
kriyatāṃ dāruṇo daṃḍo mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ .. 7.3.24.10 ..
14.24.d:
जीवग्राहेण दुष्टेयं गृह्यतां परुषस्वना ..
क्रियतां दारुणो दंडो मम वाक्यान्न संशयः .. 7.3.24.10 ..
14.24.m: “Let this wicked woman of harsh cries be seized alive! / Severe punishment must be inflicted upon her by my command, no doubt.” 10

14.24.s:
atha tasya samādeśāddānavāstāṃ tato drutam ..
gatvā nirbhartsayāmāsurveṣṭayitvā diśo daśa .. 11 ..
14.24.d:
अथ तस्य समादेशाद्दानवास्तां ततो द्रुतम् ..
गत्वा निर्भर्त्सयामासुर्वेष्टयित्वा दिशो दश .. 11 ..
14.24.m: Then, by his command, the dānavas swiftly / went, surrounded the ten directions, and threatened her. 11

14.24.s:
tato'valokanāddaityāstayā te bhasmasātkṛtāḥ ..
tataḥ śuṃbhaḥ prakupitaḥ svayameva samāyayau ..12..
14.24.d:
ततोऽवलोकनाद्दैत्यास्तया ते भस्मसात्कृताः ..
ततः शुंभः प्रकुपितः स्वयमेव समाययौ ..12..
14.24.m: Then, merely by her glance, those daityas were reduced to ashes by her; / then Śumbha, greatly infuriated, came forth in person. 12

14.24.s:
abravīttiṣṭhatiṣṭheti khaṅgamudyamya bhīṣaṇaḥ ..
so'pidevyā mahārāja tathā caivāvalokitaḥ ..13..
14.24.d:
अब्रवीत्तिष्ठतिष्ठेति खङ्गमुद्यम्य भीषणः ..
सोऽपिदेव्या महाराज तथा चैवावलोकितः ..13..
14.24.m: Lifting his sword, the terrifying [demon] cried out, “Halt! Halt!” / He too, O great king, was merely glanced at by the goddess in the same way, 13

14.24.s:
abhavadbhasmasātsadyaḥ pataṃga iva pāvakam..
hate tasmiṃstato daityāḥ śeṣāḥ pārthivasattama..
bhittvā rasātalaṃ jagmuḥ pātālaṃ bhayasaṃyutāḥ ..14..
14.24.d:
अभवद्भस्मसात्सद्यः पतंग इव पावकम्..
हते तस्मिंस्ततो दैत्याः शेषाः पार्थिवसत्तम..
भित्त्वा रसातलं जग्मुः पातालं भयसंयुताः ..14..
14.24.m: and instantly turned to ashes like a moth in fire. / When he was slain, the remaining daityas, O best of kings, / pierced Rasātala and went to Pātāla, seized with terror. 14

14.24.s:
tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvustāṃ sureśvarīm..
abruvaṃśca varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi varttate ..15..
14.24.d:
ततो देवगणाः सर्वे तुष्टुवुस्तां सुरेश्वरीम्..
अब्रुवंश्च वरं ब्रूहि यत्ते मनसि वर्त्तते ..15..
14.24.m: Then all the hosts of gods praised that sovereign of the gods, / and they said, “State the boon that is in your heart.” 15

14.24.s:
devyuvāca .. ..
tatraiva parvate sthāsye hyarbude'haṃ surottamāḥ ..
abhīṣṭaḥ parvato'smākaṃ saṃ sadā'rbudasaṃjñitaḥ ..16..
14.24.d:
देव्युवाच .. ..
तत्रैव पर्वते स्थास्ये ह्यर्बुदेऽहं सुरोत्तमाः ..
अभीष्टः पर्वतोऽस्माकं सं सदाऽर्बुदसंज्ञितः ..16..
14.24.m: The goddess said: / “Right there on the mountain, on Arbuda, I shall dwell, O best of gods; / that mountain named Arbuda has always been dear to me.” 16

14.24.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
tatrasthāṃ tvāṃ samālokya marttyā yāṃti triviṣṭapam ..
vinā yajñaistathā dānaiḥ svargaḥ saṃkīrṇatāṃ gataḥ..
nānyatkāraṇamastīha niṣedhasya sureśvari ..17..
.. devyuvāca .. ..
tatrāhaṃ vijane ramye guhāmadhye sureśvarāḥ ..
sthāsyāmi viralāḥ kecidyāsyaṃti prāṇino mama ..
dṛṣṭigocaramārge hi gatvā taṃ parvataṃ prati ..17..
14.24.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
तत्रस्थां त्वां समालोक्य मर्त्त्या यांति त्रिविष्टपम् ..
विना यज्ञैस्तथा दानैः स्वर्गः संकीर्णतां गतः..
नान्यत्कारणमस्तीह निषेधस्य सुरेश्वरि ..17..
.. देव्युवाच .. ..
तत्राहं विजने रम्ये गुहामध्ये सुरेश्वराः ..
स्थास्यामि विरलाः केचिद्यास्यंति प्राणिनो मम ..
दृष्टिगोचरमार्गे हि गत्वा तं पर्वतं प्रति ..17..
14.24.m:
The gods said: / “Beholding you residing there, mortals will go to heaven; / without sacrifices and gifts, heaven will become overcrowded; / there is no other reason for our objection here, O sovereign of the gods.” 17
The goddess said: / “There in a solitary, delightful cave, O sovereigns of the gods, / I shall dwell; only rare living beings, having gone towards that mountain, / will come into the path of my sight.” 18

14.24.s:
.. devā ūcuḥ .. ..
yadyevaṃ devi te'bhīṣṭamevaṃ kuru śucismite ..
vayaṃ tvāṃ tatra drakṣyāmaḥ śuklāṣṭamyāṃ sadā śuceḥ .. 19 ..
14.24.d:
.. देवा ऊचुः .. ..
यद्येवं देवि तेऽभीष्टमेवं कुरु शुचिस्मिते ..
वयं त्वां तत्र द्रक्ष्यामः शुक्लाष्टम्यां सदा शुचेः .. 19 ..
14.24.m: The gods said: / “If this is your desire, O goddess, do so, O lady of pure smile! / We shall always behold you there on the bright eighth lunar day of Śuci.” 19

14.24.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktāḥ surā devyā prahṛṣṭāstridivaṃ yayuḥ ..
sāpi devī girau tatra gatvā caivārbude nṛpa .. 7.3.24.20 ..
14.24.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्ताः सुरा देव्या प्रहृष्टास्त्रिदिवं ययुः ..
सापि देवी गिरौ तत्र गत्वा चैवार्बुदे नृप .. 7.3.24.20 ..
14.24.m: Pulastya said: / Thus addressed by the goddess, the gods, filled with joy, went to heaven; / and that goddess, having gone to that mountain Arbuda, O king, 20

14.24.s:
guhāmadhyaṃ samāsādya nityaṃ jagaddhitāya vai ..
vivikte nyavasatprītā durllabhā suramānavaiḥ .. 21 ..
14.24.d:
गुहामध्यं समासाद्य नित्यं जगद्धिताय वै ..
विविक्ते न्यवसत्प्रीता दुर्ल्लभा सुरमानवैः .. 21 ..
14.24.m: and reached the interior of a cave for the eternal welfare of the world, / resided happily in solitude, hard to reach for gods and mortals. 21

14.24.s:
yastāṃ paśyati rājendra śuklāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ ..
abhīṣṭaṃ sa sadāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurllabham ..22..
14.24.d:
यस्तां पश्यति राजेन्द्र शुक्लाष्टम्यां समाहितः ..
अभीष्टं स सदाप्नोति यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्ल्लभम् ..22..
14.24.m: Whoever beholds her with concentrated mind on the bright eighth lunar day, O best of kings, / always attains his desired wish, even if it is exceedingly difficult to attain. 22

14.24.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kātyāyanīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 24 ..
14.24.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे कात्यायनीमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः .. 24 ..
14.24.m: Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter, titled 'Description of the Glory of Kātyāyanī,' in the third section, Arbudakhaṇḍa, of the seventh section, Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the Skanda Mahāpurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. 24

14.25.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataḥ piṃḍārakaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛpa ..
yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ maṃkinā brāhmaṇena ca ..
siddhiṃ gatastathā rājaṃstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ .. 1 ..
14.25.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततः पिंडारकं गच्छेत्तीर्थं पापहरं नृप ..
यत्र पूर्वं तपस्तप्तं मंकिना ब्राह्मणेन च ..
सिद्धिं गतस्तथा राजंस्तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावतः .. 1 ..
14.25.m: Pulastya said: / Then one should go to the sacred ford Piṇḍāraka, which removes sins, O king, / where formerly austerity was performed by the brahmin Maṅki, / and who, through the power of this sacred ford, attained perfection, O king. 1

14.25.s:
purā maṃkirabhūdvipro nāmamātreṇa bhūpate ..
mūrkho brāhmaṇakṛtyānāmanabhijñaḥ sumandadhīḥ .. 2 ..
14.25.d:
पुरा मंकिरभूद्विप्रो नाममात्रेण भूपते ..
मूर्खो ब्राह्मणकृत्यानामनभिज्ञः सुमन्दधीः .. 2 ..
14.25.m: Long ago, O ruler of the earth, Maṅki was a brahmin in name only, / foolish, ignorant of the duties of a brahmin, and very dull-witted. 2

14.25.s:
athāsau parvate ramye lokānāṃ nṛpasattama ..
mahiṣī rakṣayāmāsa tataḥ piṃḍārakarmaṇi ..3..
14.25.d:
अथासौ पर्वते रम्ये लोकानां नृपसत्तम ..
महिषी रक्षयामास ततः पिंडारकर्मणि ..3..
14.25.m: Then, O best of kings, on that lovely mountain, he tended the buffaloes / of the people, engaged in the occupation of a herdsman. // 3

14.25.s:
kasyacittvatha kālasya tena vittamupārjitam..
dūrātkṛcchreṇa ca stokaṃ jagṛhe goyugaṃ tataḥ .. 4...
14.25.d:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य तेन वित्तमुपार्जितम्..
दूरात्कृच्छ्रेण च स्तोकं जगृहे गोयुगं ततः .. 4...
14.25.m: After some time, he acquired wealth; / with difficulty from afar he acquired a little, and then bought a pair of bullocks. // 4

14.25.s:
tatastaddamayāmāsa goyugaṃ nṛpasattama ..
atha daivavaśādrājandamitaṃ tasya goyugam.. 5 ..
14.25.d:
ततस्तद्दमयामास गोयुगं नृपसत्तम ..
अथ दैववशाद्राजन्दमितं तस्य गोयुगम्.. 5 ..
14.25.m: Then he trained that pair of bullocks, O best of kings. / Now, by the power of destiny, O king, that trained pair of bullocks of his, // 5

14.25.s:
nibaddhamuṣṭramāsādya grīvādeśe balātsthitam ..
athoṣṭrastvarayā rājannutthitastrāsatatparaḥ ..6..
14.25.d:
निबद्धमुष्ट्रमासाद्य ग्रीवादेशे बलात्स्थितम् ..
अथोष्ट्रस्त्वरया राजन्नुत्थितस्त्रासतत्परः ..6..
14.25.m: approaching a tied camel, forcefully remained attached to its neck. / Then, O king, the camel hastily rose up, seized with terror, // 6

14.25.s:
goyugena hi grīvāyāṃ lambamānena bhūpate ..
taddṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ vināśaṃ goyugasya tu .. 7 ..
14.25.d:
गोयुगेन हि ग्रीवायां लम्बमानेन भूपते ..
तद्दृष्ट्वा सुमहाश्चर्यं विनाशं गोयुगस्य तु .. 7 ..
14.25.m: with the pair of bullocks hanging from its neck, O king. / Seeing that great wonder—the destruction of the pair of bullocks— // 7

14.25.s:
maṃkirvairāgyamāpannastyaktvā grāmaṃ vanaṃ yayau ..
sa gatvā nirjharaṃ kañcidarbude nṛpasattama ..8..
14.25.d:
मंकिर्वैराग्यमापन्नस्त्यक्त्वा ग्रामं वनं ययौ ..
स गत्वा निर्झरं कञ्चिदर्बुदे नृपसत्तम ..8..
14.25.m: Maṅki attained dispassion; abandoning the village, he went to the forest. / Having gone to a certain mountain stream on Arbuda, O best of kings, // 8

14.25.s:
trikālaṃ kurute snānaṃ gāyatrījapamuttamam ..
tenāsau gatapāpo'bhūddivyadarśī ca bhūmipa ..9..
14.25.d:
त्रिकालं कुरुते स्नानं गायत्रीजपमुत्तमम् ..
तेनासौ गतपापोऽभूद्दिव्यदर्शी च भूमिप ..9..
14.25.m: he performed ritual ablution at the three divisions of the day and practiced the supreme recitation of the Gāyatrī. / By that, O king, he became freed from sin and endowed with divine vision. // 9

14.25.s:
etasminneva kāle tu tena mārgeṇa śaṃkaraḥ ..
saha gauryā viniṣkrāṃtaḥ krīḍārthaṃ ramyaparvate ..7.3.25.10..
14.25.d:
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु तेन मार्गेण शंकरः ..
सह गौर्या विनिष्क्रांतः क्रीडार्थं रम्यपर्वते ..7.3.25.10..
14.25.m: At that very time, Śaṃkara, along that path, / came out together with Gaurī for sport upon the lovely mountain. // 10

14.25.s:
sa dṛṣṭaḥ sahasā tena piṃḍāreṇa mahātmanā ..
praṇāmamakarodrājaṃstatastaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt .. 11 ..
14.25.d:
स दृष्टः सहसा तेन पिंडारेण महात्मना ..
प्रणाममकरोद्राजंस्ततस्तं शंकरोऽब्रवीत् .. 11 ..
14.25.m: He was suddenly seen by that high-souled Piṇḍāra. / He made a bow, O king, and then Śaṃkara said to him: // 11

14.25.s:
na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādvaro me gṛhyatāṃ dvija ..
yadabhīṣṭaṃ mahārāja yadyapi syātsudurlabham .. 12 ..
14.25.d:
न वृथा दर्शनं मे स्याद्वरो मे गृह्यतां द्विज ..
यदभीष्टं महाराज यद्यपि स्यात्सुदुर्लभम् .. 12 ..
14.25.m: “My darśana should not be in vain; accept a boon from me, O twice-born! / Whatever is desired, O great king, even if it be very difficult to obtain.” // 12

14.25.s:
.. piṃḍāraka uvāca .. ..
gaṇo'haṃ tava deveśa bhavāni tripurāṃtaka ..
yathā tathā kuru vibho nānyanme hṛdi vartate .. 13 ..
14.25.d:
.. पिंडारक उवाच .. ..
गणोऽहं तव देवेश भवानि त्रिपुरांतक ..
यथा तथा कुरु विभो नान्यन्मे हृदि वर्तते .. 13 ..
14.25.m:
Piṇḍāraka said:
“May I become your attendant, O Lord of gods, O destroyer of Tripura! / Make it so, O all-pervading Lord; nothing else resides in my heart. // 13

14.25.s: etatpiṇḍārakaṃ tīrtha mama nāmnā prasidhyatu .. 14 ..
14.25.d: एतत्पिण्डारकं तीर्थ मम नाम्ना प्रसिध्यतु .. 14 ..
14.25.m: May this Piṇḍāraka sacred ford become famous by my name!” // 14

14.25.s:
.. bhagavānuvāca .. ..
bhaviṣyasi gaṇo'smākaṃ dehāṃte tvaṃ dvijottama ..
etatpiṃḍārakaṃnāma tīrthamatra bhaviṣyati .. 15 ..
14.25.d:
.. भगवानुवाच .. ..
भविष्यसि गणोऽस्माकं देहांते त्वं द्विजोत्तम ..
एतत्पिंडारकंनाम तीर्थमत्र भविष्यति .. 15 ..
14.25.m:
The Blessed Lord said:
“You shall become our attendant at the end of your body, O best of brahmins! / This sacred ford here shall be known by the name Piṇḍāraka. // 15

14.25.s:
ahamatra mahāṣṭamyāṃ nivekṣyāmi mahāmate ..
ye ca snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti saṃprāpte cāṣṭamīdine ..
te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ nityasaṃsthitaḥ .. 16 ..
14.25.d:
अहमत्र महाष्टम्यां निवेक्ष्यामि महामते ..
ये च स्नानं करिष्यंति संप्राप्ते चाष्टमीदिने ..
ते यास्यंति परं स्थानं यत्राहं नित्यसंस्थितः .. 16 ..
14.25.m: I shall enter here on the great eighth day, O noble-minded one; / and those who perform ritual ablution when the eighth day has arrived / shall go to the supreme abode where I am eternally present.” // 16

14.25.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ...
maṃkiḥ piṃḍārakastatra tapastepe divāniśam .. 17 ..
14.25.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवमुक्त्वा महादेवस्तत्रैवांतरधीयत ...
मंकिः पिंडारकस्तत्र तपस्तेपे दिवानिशम् .. 17 ..
14.25.m:
Pulastya said:
Having spoken thus, Mahādeva vanished right there. / Maṅki Piṇḍāraka performed tapas there day and night. // 17

14.25.s:
tataḥ kālena mahatā tyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ gataḥ ..
yatrāste bhagavānrudro gaṇastatra babhūva ha .. 18 ...
14.25.d:
ततः कालेन महता त्यक्त्वा देहं दिवं गतः ..
यत्रास्ते भगवान्रुद्रो गणस्तत्र बभूव ह .. 18 ...
14.25.m: Then, after a long time, casting off his body, he went to heaven; / where the blessed Lord Rudra resides, there he became an attendant. // 18

14.25.s: tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ mantreṇa cācaret ..19..
14.25.d: तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं मन्त्रेण चाचरेत् ..19..
14.25.m: Therefore, with every effort, one should perform ritual ablution with mantras, // 19

14.25.s:
rājendra mahiṣīdānamathāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ ..
ya icchati sadā'bhīṣṭamiha loke paratra ca ..7.3.25.20..
14.25.d:
राजेन्द्र महिषीदानमथाष्टम्यां विशेषतः ..
य इच्छति सदाऽभीष्टमिह लोके परत्र च ..7.3.25.20..
14.25.m: O lord of kings, and especially the gift of a buffalo on the eighth day, / whoever always desires what is wished for in this world and in the next. // 20

14.25.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe piṃḍārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ.. 25..
14.25.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखण्डे पिंडारकतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम पंचविंशोऽध्यायः.. 25..
14.25.m: Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Piṇḍāraka Sacred Ford’, in the Arbuda Section, the third part of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. // 25

14.26.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam ..
tasminkanakhalaṃnāma parvate pāpanāśane .. 1 ..
14.26.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ तीर्थं त्रैलोक्यविश्रुतम् ..
तस्मिन्कनखलंनाम पर्वते पापनाशने .. 1 ..
14.26.m:
Pulastya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the sacred ford renowned in the three worlds / on that sin-destroying mountain, named Kanakhala. // 1

14.26.s:
śṛṇu tatrā'bhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahīpate ..
pārthivaḥ sumatirnāma saṃprāpto'rbudaparvate ..2..
14.26.d:
शृणु तत्राऽभवत्पूर्वं यदाश्चर्यं महीपते ..
पार्थिवः सुमतिर्नाम संप्राप्तोऽर्बुदपर्वते ..2..
14.26.m: Hear, O ruler of the earth, the wonder that occurred there in the past: / A king named Sumati arrived at Mount Arbuda. // 2

14.26.s:
sūryagrahe mahīpāla tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ gataḥ ..
tena viprārthamānītaṃ suvarṇaṃ jātyameva hi ..3..
14.26.d:
सूर्यग्रहे महीपाल तीर्थं कनखलं गतः ..
तेन विप्रार्थमानीतं सुवर्णं जात्यमेव हि ..3..
14.26.m: During a solar eclipse, O protector of the earth, he went to the Kanakhala sacred ford. / By him, genuine gold was brought for the sake of brahmins. // 3

14.26.s:
prabhūtaṃ patitaṃ toye pramādāttasya bhūpateḥ ..
na labdhaṃ tena bhūpāla anveṣaṇapareṇa ca .. 4 ..
14.26.d:
प्रभूतं पतितं तोये प्रमादात्तस्य भूपतेः ..
न लब्धं तेन भूपाल अन्वेषणपरेण च .. 4 ..
14.26.m: An abundance of it fell into the water through the carelessness of that king. / It was not found by that ruler of the earth, though he was intent upon searching. // 4

14.26.s:
tataḥ snātvā gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ paścāttāpasamanvitaḥ ..
tataḥ kālena mahatā sa bhūyastatra cāgataḥ .. 5 ..
14.26.d:
ततः स्नात्वा गृहं प्राप्तः पश्चात्तापसमन्वितः ..
ततः कालेन महता स भूयस्तत्र चागतः .. 5 ..
14.26.m: Then, having bathed, he returned home, filled with remorse. / Then, after a long time, he came there once again, // 5

14.26.s:
snānārthaṃ bhāskare graste taṃ ca deśamapaśyata ..
ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī hyasmindeśe tadā mama .. 6 ..
14.26.d:
स्नानार्थं भास्करे ग्रस्ते तं च देशमपश्यत ..
चिंतयामास मेधावी ह्यस्मिन्देशे तदा मम .. 6 ..
14.26.m: for the sake of bathing during a solar eclipse, and he saw that place. / The wise king reflected: “In this place, back then, // 6

14.26.s: suvarṇaṃ patitaṃ hastānna ca labdhaṃ kathaṃcana .. 7 ..
14.26.d: सुवर्णं पतितं हस्तान्न च लब्धं कथंचन .. 7 ..
14.26.m: gold fell from my hand and was not found in any way.” // 7

14.26.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya vāguvācāśarīriṇī ..
nātra nāśo'sti rājendra iha loke paratra ca .. 8 ..
14.26.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
एवं चिंतयतस्तस्य वागुवाचाशरीरिणी ..
नात्र नाशोऽस्ति राजेन्द्र इह लोके परत्र च .. 8 ..
14.26.m:
Pulastya said:
While he was thinking thus, a bodiless voice spoke: / “There is no loss here, O lord of kings, in this world or in the next! // 8

14.26.s:
atra koṭiguṇaṃ jātaṃ suvarṇaṃ yatpurātanam ..
paścāttāpastvayā bhūri kṛto yaddravyanāśane .. 9 ..
14.26.d:
अत्र कोटिगुणं जातं सुवर्णं यत्पुरातनम् ..
पश्चात्तापस्त्वया भूरि कृतो यद्द्रव्यनाशने .. 9 ..
14.26.m: Here, that former gold has become multiplied ten-millionfold. / Great remorse was felt by you over the loss of wealth; // 9

14.26.s:
tasmātsaṃkhyā ca saṃjātā tathaivākalpitasya ca ..
ye'tra śraddhāsamāyuktāḥ suvarṇairnṛpasattama ..
yatnācchrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti suvarṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 7.3.26.10 ..
14.26.d:
तस्मात्संख्या च संजाता तथैवाकल्पितस्य च ..
येऽत्र श्रद्धासमायुक्ताः सुवर्णैर्नृपसत्तम ..
यत्नाच्छ्राद्धं करिष्यंति सुवर्णं च विशेषतः .. 7.3.26.10 ..
14.26.m: therefore, it has attained this measure, even unimaginable. / Those endowed with faith who, with gold, O best of kings, / carefully perform a śrāddha here, and especially [give] gold, // 10

14.26.s:
brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyaṃti saṃkhyā tasya na vidyate ..
atrānveṣaya deśe tvaṃ prāpsyase nā'tra saṃśayaḥ .. 11 ..
14.26.d:
ब्राह्मणेभ्यः प्रदास्यंति संख्या तस्य न विद्यते ..
अत्रान्वेषय देशे त्वं प्राप्स्यसे नाऽत्र संशयः .. 11 ..
14.26.m: shall give to brahmins—its measure cannot be known. / Search in this place: you will obtain it, there is no doubt about this.” // 11

14.26.s:
sa śrutvā bhāratī tatra hyākāśādutthitāṃ nṛpa ..
anveṣamāṇo'smindeśe suvarṇaṃ tacca labdhavān .. 12 ..
14.26.d:
स श्रुत्वा भारती तत्र ह्याकाशादुत्थितां नृप ..
अन्वेषमाणोऽस्मिन्देशे सुवर्णं तच्च लब्धवान् .. 12 ..
14.26.m: Hearing that voice arisen from the sky there, O king, / searching in that place, he found that gold— // 12

14.26.s:
śubhraṃ koṭiguṇaṃ prājyaṃ tatastuṣṭiṃ samāgataḥ ..
jñātvā tīrthaprabhāvaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ ..
pradadau ca dayāyukta uddiśya pitṛdevatāḥ .. 13 ..
14.26.d:
शुभ्रं कोटिगुणं प्राज्यं ततस्तुष्टिं समागतः ..
ज्ञात्वा तीर्थप्रभावं तं ब्राह्मणेभ्यः सहस्रशः ..
प्रददौ च दयायुक्त उद्दिश्य पितृदेवताः .. 13 ..
14.26.m: bright, multiplied ten-millionfold, abundant; then he attained satisfaction. / Having realized the power of that sacred ford, filled with compassion, he gave it by the thousands / to brahmins, dedicating it to the ancestors and the deities. // 13

14.26.s:
tatastasya prabhāveṇa sa dānasya mahīpatiḥ ..
saṃjāto dhanadonāma yakṣo nānādhanapradaḥ .. 14 ..
14.26.d:
ततस्तस्य प्रभावेण स दानस्य महीपतिः ..
संजातो धनदोनाम यक्षो नानाधनप्रदः .. 14 ..
14.26.m: Then, by the power of that gift, that ruler of the earth / became a Yakṣa named Dhanada, a giver of various kinds of wealth. // 14

14.26.s:
tatra yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ grahe sūryasya bhūmipa ..
ākalpaṃ pitarastasya tṛptiṃ yāṃti sutarpitāḥ .. 15 ..
14.26.d:
तत्र यः कुरुते श्राद्धं ग्रहे सूर्यस्य भूमिप ..
आकल्पं पितरस्तस्य तृप्तिं यांति सुतर्पिताः .. 15 ..
14.26.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there during a solar eclipse, O ruler of the earth, / his ancestors, well-gratified, attain satisfaction until the end of an eon. // 15

14.26.s:
snānena ṛṣayo devāstuṣṭiṃ yāṃti mahoragāḥ ..
nāśaḥ saṃjāyate sadyaḥ pāpasya pṛthivīpate .. 16 ..
14.26.d:
स्नानेन ऋषयो देवास्तुष्टिं यांति महोरगाः ..
नाशः संजायते सद्यः पापस्य पृथिवीपते .. 16 ..
14.26.m: By ritual ablution, the seers, gods, and great serpents attain satisfaction; / instantaneous destruction of sin occurs, O lord of the earth. // 16

14.26.s:
tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret ..
yathāśaktyā tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca nṛpasattama .. 17 ..
14.26.d:
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन स्नानं तत्र समाचरेत् ..
यथाशक्त्या तथा दानं श्राद्धं च नृपसत्तम .. 17 ..
14.26.m: Therefore, with all effort, one should perform ritual ablution there, / as well as gifts according to one's capacity, and śrāddha, O best of kings. // 17

14.26.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kanakhalatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṅviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. .. 26 .. ..
14.26.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे कनखलतीर्थमाहात्म्यवर्णनंनाम षङ्विंशोऽध्यायः .. .. 26 .. ..
14.26.m: Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter, titled ‘Description of the Māhātmya of Kanakhala Sacred Ford’, in the Arbuda Section, the third part of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. // 26

14.27.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha cakratīrthamanuttamam ..
yatra cakraṃ purā muktaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā .. 1 ..
14.27.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ चक्रतीर्थमनुत्तमम् ..
यत्र चक्रं पुरा मुक्तं विष्णुना प्रभविष्णुना .. 1 ..
14.27.m:
Pulastya said:
Then, O best of kings, one should go to the unsurpassed Cakra sacred ford, / where formerly the discus was hurled by Viṣṇu, the almighty lord. // 1

14.27.s:
nihatya dānavānsaṃkhye kṛtvā snānaṃ sunirjhare ..
viṣṇuḥ prākṣālayattoyaṃ tena tanmedhyatāṃ gatam .. 2 ..
14.27.d:
निहत्य दानवान्संख्ये कृत्वा स्नानं सुनिर्झरे ..
विष्णुः प्राक्षालयत्तोयं तेन तन्मेध्यतां गतम् .. 2 ..
14.27.m: Having slain the Dānavas in battle, and having bathed in the beautiful mountain stream, / Viṣṇu washed [the discus] in the water; by that, it became pure. // 2

14.27.s:
tatra śrāddhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryācchayane bodhane hareḥ ..
ākalpaṃ pitarastasya tṛptiṃ yāṃti narādhipa .. 3 ..
14.27.d:
तत्र श्राद्धं तु यः कुर्याच्छयने बोधने हरेः ..
आकल्पं पितरस्तस्य तृप्तिं यांति नराधिप .. 3 ..
14.27.m: Whoever performs a śrāddha there on the occasion of the sleeping or waking of Hari, / his ancestors attain satisfaction until the end of an eon, O ruler of men. // 3

14.27.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe cakratīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 27 ..
14.27.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे चक्रतीर्थप्रभाववर्णनंनाम सप्तविंशोऽध्यायः .. 27 ..
14.27.m: Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, titled ‘Description of the Power of Cakra Sacred Ford’, in the Arbuda Section, the third part of the seventh Prabhāsa Section, in the Skandapurāṇa comprising eighty-one thousand verses. // 27

14.28.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supuṇyaṃ mānuṣaṃ hradam ..
yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmanuṣyo jāyate sadā .. 1 ..
14.28.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततो गच्छेन्नृपश्रेष्ठ सुपुण्यं मानुषं ह्रदम् ..
यत्र स्नातो नरः सम्यङ्मनुष्यो जायते सदा .. 1 ..
14.28.m:
Pulastya said:
Then one should go, O best of kings, to the very holy pool Mānuṣahrada,
where a man, properly bathed, is always born as a human.

14.28.s:
na tiryaktvamavāpnoti kṛtvā'pi bahupātakam ..
tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattacchṛṇu narādhipa .. 2 ..
14.28.d:
न तिर्यक्त्वमवाप्नोति कृत्वाऽपि बहुपातकम् ..
तत्राश्चर्यमभूत्पूर्वं यत्तच्छृणु नराधिप .. 2 ..
14.28.m:
Even having committed great sins, he does not attain an animal state.
A wonder happened there formerly; listen to that, O lord of men.

14.28.s:
mṛgayūthamanuprāpta vyādhavyāptaṃ samantataḥ ..
te mṛgā bhayasantrastāḥ praviṣṭā jalamadhyataḥ .. 3 ..
14.28.d:
मृगयूथमनुप्राप्त व्याधव्याप्तं समन्ततः ..
ते मृगा भयसन्त्रस्ताः प्रविष्टा जलमध्यतः .. 3 ..
14.28.m:
A herd of deer arrived, completely surrounded by hunters.
Those deer, terrified with fear, entered into the midst of the water.

14.28.s:
sadyo manuṣyatāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvajātismarāstathā ..
etasminneva kāle tu vyādhāste samupāgatāḥ .. 4 ..
14.28.d:
सद्यो मनुष्यतां प्राप्ताः पूर्वजातिस्मरास्तथा ..
एतस्मिन्नेव काले तु व्याधास्ते समुपागताः .. 4 ..
14.28.m:
Immediately they attained human state, and also remembered their previous births.
Just at that moment, those hunters arrived,

14.28.s:
cāpabāṇadharāḥ sarve yathā vai yamakiṃkarāḥ ..
papracchuśca mṛgānbhūpa mānuṣatvamupāgatān .. 5 ..
14.28.d:
चापबाणधराः सर्वे यथा वै यमकिंकराः ..
पप्रच्छुश्च मृगान्भूप मानुषत्वमुपागतान् .. 5 ..
14.28.m:
all holding bows and arrows, just like the servants of Yama.
And they asked the deer, O king, who had attained human state:

14.28.s:
mṛgayūthamanu prāptamasminsthāne jalāśraye ..
kena mārgeṇa tadyātaṃ vadadhvaṃ satvaraṃ hi naḥ ..
vayaṃ sarve pariśrāṃtāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ .. 6 ..
14.28.d:
मृगयूथमनु प्राप्तमस्मिन्स्थाने जलाश्रये ..
केन मार्गेण तद्यातं वदध्वं सत्वरं हि नः ..
वयं सर्वे परिश्रांताः क्षुत्तृड्भ्यां च विशेषतः .. 6 ..
14.28.m:
"A herd of deer reached this place beside the water.
By which path did it go? Tell us quickly!
We are all exhausted, especially from hunger and thirst."

14.28.s:
.. manuṣyā ūcuḥ .. ..
vayaṃ te hariṇāḥ sarve mānuṣyaṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ ..
tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa satyametadasaṃśayam .. 7 ..
14.28.d:
.. मनुष्या ऊचुः .. ..
वयं ते हरिणाः सर्वे मानुष्यं भावमाश्रिताः ..
तीर्थस्यास्य प्रभावेण सत्यमेतदसंशयम् .. 7 ..
14.28.m:
The men said:
"We are all those deer who have assumed human state
by the power of this sacred ford; this is the truth, without doubt."

14.28.s:
.. pulastya uvāca .. ..
tataste śabarāḥ sarve tyaktvā cāpāni pārthiva ..
kṛtvā snānaṃ jale tasminsadyaḥ siddhiṃ gatā nṛpa .. 8 ..
14.28.d:
.. पुलस्त्य उवाच .. ..
ततस्ते शबराः सर्वे त्यक्त्वा चापानि पार्थिव ..
कृत्वा स्नानं जले तस्मिन्सद्यः सिद्धिं गता नृप .. 8 ..
14.28.m:
Pulastya said:
Then all those Śabaras, casting away their bows, O king,
and performing a ritual ablution in that water, immediately attained perfection, O ruler of men.

14.28.s:
tataḥ śakrastu taddṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛpa ..
pūrayāmāsa sarvatra pāṃsubhirnṛpasattama .. 9 ..
14.28.d:
ततः शक्रस्तु तद्दृष्ट्वा तीर्थं पापहरं नृप ..
पूरयामास सर्वत्र पांसुभिर्नृपसत्तम .. 9 ..
14.28.m:
Then Śakra, seeing that sin-removing sacred ford, O king,
filled it everywhere with dust, O best of kings.

14.28.s:
adyāpi manujāstatra budhāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa ..
snānaṃ ye prakariṣyaṃti tiryaktvaṃ na vrajaṃti te .. 7.3.28.10 ..
14.28.d:
अद्यापि मनुजास्तत्र बुधाष्टम्यां नराधिप ..
स्नानं ये प्रकरिष्यंति तिर्यक्त्वं न व्रजंति ते .. 7.3.28.10 ..
14.28.m:
Even today, O lord of men, the humans who will perform a ritual ablution
there on a Wednesday eighth day [of the lunar fortnight] do not go to an animal state.
They obtain the entire fruit of a sacrifice to the ancestors from gifts and ancestral rites.

14.28.s: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe manuṣyatīrthaprabhāva varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ .. 28 ..
14.28.d: इति श्रीस्कांदे महापुराण एकाशीतिसाहस्र्यां संहितायां सप्तमे प्रभासखण्डे तृतीयेऽर्बुदखंडे मनुष्यतीर्थप्रभाव वर्णनंनामाष्टाविंशोऽध्यायः .. 28 ..
14.28.m: Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter, named 'Description of the Power of Manuṣyatīrtha', in the third [section], Arbudakhaṇḍa, in the seventh [section], Prabhāsakhaṇḍa, in the glorious Skanda Mahāpurāṇa, a collection of eighty-one thousand [verses].
